import subprocess, sys
if 'google.colab' in sys.modules:
    # Colab preinstalls an older torchao; the PEFT version of the [train] extra needs torchao >= 0.16
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '-q', 'torchao>=0.16.0'], check=True)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '-q', 'explRL[train] @ git+https://github.com/Positron00/explRL'], check=True)
    from google.colab import drive
    drive.mount('/content/drive')
    OUT = '/content/drive/MyDrive/explRL_rl'
import torch
print(torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'no GPU: use a GPU runtime')
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

from explRL.coop_grid import MODELS, RL13_PLAN, RL_PLAN, coopHash
from explRL.rl16_grid import RL16_PLAN
from explRL.rl17_grid import PILOT17_PLAN, RL17_PLAN
from explRL.rl18_grid import RL18_PLAN
from explRL.train import demo_artifact_dir

OUT = Path(globals().get('OUT') or demo_artifact_dir('colab', 'multiagent/rl'))
BASE = MODELS['base']
SCHEME = 'credit'                      # set before each RL session: 'individual', 'team' or 'credit'
ARM, SEED = 'credit', 2                # Phase 13: set before each session, one of RL13_PLAN's runs (arm, seed)
RUNS = OUT / ('runs' if RL_PLAN['version'] == 1 else f"runs_v{RL_PLAN['version']}")   # v1 runs stay in runs/
SFT_SEEDS = range(RL_PLAN['sftData']['seeds'][0], RL_PLAN['sftData']['seeds'][1] + 1)
RUNS13 = OUT / 'runs_p13'              # Phase 13 runs: runs_p13/<arm>_s<seed>/
RUNS16 = OUT / 'runs_p16'              # Phase 16 runs: runs_p16/<arm>_s<seed>/
RUNS17 = OUT / 'runs_p17'              # Phase 17 main runs: runs_p17/<arm>_s<seed>/
RUNS18 = OUT / 'runs_p18'              # Phase 18 Part B runs: runs_p18/<arm>_s<seed>/
HOST = 'account-a'                     # Phase 17: a different name on each Colab account sharing the Drive folder
TAKEOVER = []                          # Phase 17: runs this account may take over from another (stop that runtime first)
print(f"RL_PLAN v{RL_PLAN['version']} {coopHash(RL_PLAN)} (frozen: {RL_PLAN['frozen']}); base model {BASE}; RL runs in {RUNS}")
print(f"RL13_PLAN v{RL13_PLAN['version']} {coopHash(RL13_PLAN)} (frozen: {RL13_PLAN['frozen']}); Phase 13 run {ARM}_s{SEED} in {RUNS13}")
print(f"RL16_PLAN v{RL16_PLAN['version']} {coopHash(RL16_PLAN)} (frozen: {RL16_PLAN['frozen']}); Phase 16 runs in {RUNS16}")
print(f"PILOT17_PLAN {coopHash(PILOT17_PLAN)} (frozen: {PILOT17_PLAN['frozen']}); RL17_PLAN {coopHash(RL17_PLAN)} (frozen: {RL17_PLAN['frozen']}); host {HOST}")
print(f"RL18_PLAN {coopHash(RL18_PLAN)} (frozen: {RL18_PLAN['frozen']}); Phase 18 runs in {RUNS18}")


def stream(code):
    "Run `code` in a fresh Python process, echoing its output here (GPU memory is freed when it ends); -> its exit code."
    import os, subprocess, sys
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-u', '-c', code], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    while chunk := os.read(p.stdout.fileno(), 4096):
        sys.stdout.write(chunk.decode(errors='replace'))
        sys.stdout.flush()
    return p.wait()


def packZip(name, dirs):
    "OUT / name: the files under `dirs` (no ckpt-* checkpoints)."
    import zipfile
    with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT / name, 'w') as z:
        for p in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')):
            rel = p.relative_to(OUT)
            if p.is_file() and rel.parts[0] in dirs and 'ckpt-' not in str(rel):
                z.write(p, rel)
    print(OUT / name, round((OUT / name).stat().st_size / 1e6, 1), 'MB')

section: Pilot (gpu; session 1 only, already done): step time and memory
text:
Pilot (gpu; session 1 only, already done): step time and memory

from explRL.clue_rl import RLConfig, trainRL
from explRL.clue_sft import SFTConfig, mergeAdapter, sftExamples, trainSFT
P = OUT / 'pilot'
t0 = time.time()
adapter = trainSFT(SFTConfig(BASE, str(P / 'sft'), maxSteps=20), sftExamples(range(20000, 20010), turns=20))
t1 = time.time()
mergeAdapter(BASE, adapter, P / 'warm')
trainRL(RLConfig(str(P / 'warm'), str(P / 'rl'), scheme=SCHEME, **{**RL_PLAN['rl'], 'steps': 3, 'ckptEvery': 1}))
steps = [json.loads(x) for x in open(P / 'rl' / 'metrics.jsonl')]
for x in steps:
    print(f"RL step {x['step']}: rollout {x['rolloutSeconds']:.0f} s, update {x['updateSeconds']:.0f} s, trained turns {x['samples']}")
per = sum(x['rolloutSeconds'] + x['updateSeconds'] for x in steps) / len(steps)
print(f"warm start: {(t1 - t0) / 20:.1f} s per step; RL: {per:.0f} s per step -> {per * RL_PLAN['rl']['steps'] / 3600:.1f} h "
      f"per run; peak GPU memory {torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() / 1e9:.1f} GB; session {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} h")

title: colab_clue_rl
section: RL speed check (gpu; start of session 2, before RL_PLAN is frozen)
text:
RL speed check (gpu; start of session 2, before RL_PLAN is frozen)
Three RL steps from the warm-start model with RL_PLAN’s settings (a quarter of the turns trained on, gradient checkpointing off): the time per step without vLLM’s start-up, the projected hours per run, and the peak memory. Send the printout to Claude; the step count is then fixed and RL_PLAN frozen.

import shutil
import numpy as np
from explRL.clue_rl import RLConfig, trainRL
from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter
WARM = OUT / 'warm_model'
if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    mergeAdapter(BASE, OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter', WARM)
SC = OUT / 'speedcheck'
shutil.rmtree(SC, ignore_errors=True)
trainRL(RLConfig(str(WARM), str(SC), scheme=SCHEME, **{**RL_PLAN['rl'], 'steps': 3, 'ckptEvery': 3}))
steps = [json.loads(x) for x in open(SC / 'metrics.jsonl')]
for x in steps:
    print(f"step {x['step']}: rollout {x['rolloutSeconds']:.0f} s, update {x['updateSeconds']:.0f} s, trained turns "
          f"{x['samples']} of {x['signalTurns']}, invalid {x['invalid']:.3f}, KL {x['kl']:.4f}, "
          f"gradient checkpointing {'on (out-of-memory fallback)' if x['gradCkpt'] else 'off'}")
per = np.mean([x['rolloutSeconds'] + x['updateSeconds'] for x in steps[1:]])     # step 1 includes vLLM's start-up
print(f"steady state {per:.0f} s per step -> {per * 40 / 3600:.1f} h for 40 steps, {per * 60 / 3600:.1f} h for 60; "
      f"peak GPU memory {torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() / 1e9:.1f} GB")

title: colab_clue_rl
section: Learning-rate pilot (gpu; session 3, before RL_PLAN v2 is frozen; about 1.5 hours)
text:
Learning-rate pilot (gpu; session 3, before RL_PLAN v2 is frozen; about 1.5 hours)
The v1 runs (learning rate 1e-5) barely moved the model. Ten steps under credit at each of three fixed learning rates (the controller off), from the warm-start model: the per-step policy change (stepKL), the KL to the warm-start model, invalid replies, welfare and time per step. Send the printout to Claude; the starting and maximum learning rates are then set and RL_PLAN v2 frozen. A run already done is not redone.

import numpy as np
from explRL.clue_rl import RLConfig, trainRL
from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter
WARM = OUT / 'warm_model'
if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    mergeAdapter(BASE, OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter', WARM)
lp = RL_PLAN['lrPilot']
for lr in lp['lrs']:
    d = OUT / 'lrpilot' / f'lr{lr:g}'
    t0 = time.time()
    trainRL(RLConfig(str(WARM), str(d), scheme=lp['scheme'], **{**RL_PLAN['rl'], 'lr': lr, 'klTarget': 0.0, 'warmup': 0,
                                                                 'steps': lp['steps'], 'ckptEvery': lp['steps']}))
    m = [json.loads(x) for x in open(d / 'metrics.jsonl')]
    print(f"lr {lr:g}: per-step KL mean {np.mean([x['stepKL'] for x in m]):.4f} max {max(x['stepKL'] for x in m):.4f}; "
          f"KL to warm start, last step {m[-1]['kl']:.4f}; invalid {np.mean([x['invalid'] for x in m]):.3f}; welfare first 3 "
          f"{np.mean([x['welfare'] for x in m[:3]]):.3f}, last 3 {np.mean([x['welfare'] for x in m[-3:]]):.3f}; "
          f"{np.mean([x['rolloutSeconds'] + x['updateSeconds'] for x in m[1:]]):.0f} s per step; this run {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} h")

title: colab_clue_rl
section: Evaluation (gpu; after the three RL runs; about 1.5-2 hours)
text:
Evaluation (gpu; after the three RL runs; about 1.5-2 hours)
RL_PLAN’s evaluation boards (40 turns, held-out seeds) for the five models: the untrained base model, the warm-start model and the three RL adapters on it. Cross-play with Claude Haiku needs the API key, which stays off Colab: it runs on the Mac afterwards (demo_rl), which merges it with these rows. Each model’s rows are saved to Drive when it finishes, so after a disconnect a rerun continues with the next model. Then run Pack.

import numpy as np
from explRL.bench_grid import rowKey, writeCSV
from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels
from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter
from explRL.coop_grid import evalSuite
assert RL_PLAN['frozen'], 'the evaluation uses the frozen RL_PLAN'
WARM = OUT / 'warm_model'
if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    mergeAdapter(BASE, OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter', WARM)
E = OUT / 'eval'
cells = [c for c in evalSuite() if not c['level'].endswith(('cross1', 'cross3'))]      # cross-play (Haiku): on the Mac
models = dict(untrained=(BASE, None), warm=(str(WARM), None),
              **{sc: (str(WARM), str(RUNS / sc / 'final')) for sc in RL_PLAN['schemes']})
t0 = time.time()
rows = evalModels(cells, models, E, cache='/content/evalcache', logDir=E / 'turns')
writeCSV(rows, E / 'runs.csv')
for m in models:
    w = [float(r['welfare']) for r in rows if r['level'] == f'{m}|main']
    print(f"{m:10s} main boards: welfare per agent-turn {np.mean(w):.3f} ({len(w)} boards)")
print(f'{len(rows)} boards in all; this session {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours. Next: Pack.')

title: colab_clue_rl
section: Phase 13 RL run (gpu; one session per run, about 3 hours)
text:
Phase 13 RL run (gpu; one session per run, about 3 hours)
One of RL13_PLAN’s five runs per session (credit seed 2, indpen seeds 1-2, credturn seeds 1-2; seed 1 = trainSeed 0, seed 2 = trainSeed 1): RL_PLAN v2’s settings with the arm’s changes (indpen: individual reward, a training-only cost of 2.5 per wrong answer, roll-back on a jump above 15% invalid replies; credturn: credit reward, per-turn advantages, the same cost and roll-back). Set ARM and SEED in the configuration cell first (restart the session between runs). A run resumes from its last checkpoint after a disconnection; a halted run (stopping rule or two roll-backs in a row) is not resumed. Note the GPU hours printed at the end.

from explRL.clue_rl import trainRL
from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter
from explRL.coop_grid import RL13_RUNS, rl13Config, rl13Name
assert RL13_PLAN['frozen'], 'freeze and commit RL13_PLAN before the Phase 13 runs'
assert (ARM, SEED) in RL13_RUNS, f'{ARM}_s{SEED} is not one of the Phase 13 runs {RL13_RUNS}'
WARM = OUT / 'warm_model'
if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    mergeAdapter(BASE, OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter', WARM)
t0 = time.time()
final = trainRL(rl13Config(ARM, SEED, str(WARM), str(RUNS13 / rl13Name(ARM, SEED))))
print(f'{rl13Name(ARM, SEED)}: {final}; this session {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours')

title: colab_clue_rl
section: Phase 13: all five runs in one session (gpu; about 15 hours; instead of the per-run section above)
text:
Phase 13: all five runs in one session (gpu; about 15 hours; instead of the per-run section above)
Trains RL13_PLAN’s five runs one after another, each in its own Python process, so each run’s GPU memory (vLLM’s engine included) is freed when it ends and no restart is needed between runs. Runs already finished (a final adapter or halted.json) are skipped, and an unfinished one resumes from its last checkpoint, so after a disconnect: restart, set-up, configuration, then this cell again. ARM and SEED are not used here. Each run’s output streams below (progress bar and one line per step); a run that fails stops the batch. To have no further manual steps, queue the Phase 13 evaluation and Pack cells after this one (Runtime -> Run after).

import os
import sys
import subprocess
from explRL.coop_grid import RL13_RUNS, rl13Name
assert RL13_PLAN['frozen'], 'freeze and commit RL13_PLAN before the Phase 13 runs'
ORDER = [('credturn', 1), ('indpen', 1), ('credturn', 2), ('indpen', 2), ('credit', 2)]   # the main test first
assert sorted(ORDER) == sorted(RL13_RUNS), (ORDER, RL13_RUNS)
WARM = OUT / 'warm_model'


def stream(code):
    "Run `code` in a fresh Python process, echoing its output (progress bar included) here; -> its exit code."
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-u', '-c', code], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    while chunk := os.read(p.stdout.fileno(), 4096):
        sys.stdout.write(chunk.decode(errors='replace'))
        sys.stdout.flush()
    return p.wait()


if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    assert stream(f"from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter; mergeAdapter({BASE!r}, {str(OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter')!r}, "
                  f"{str(WARM)!r})") == 0, 'merging the warm-start model failed'
for arm, seed in ORDER:
    name, d = rl13Name(arm, seed), RUNS13 / rl13Name(arm, seed)
    if (d / 'final').exists() or (d / 'halted.json').exists():
        print(f'{name}: already done, skipped')
        continue
    print(f'=== {name} ===', flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    rc = stream(f"from explRL.clue_rl import trainRL; from explRL.coop_grid import rl13Config; "
                f"print(trainRL(rl13Config({arm!r}, {seed}, {str(WARM)!r}, {str(d)!r})))")
    print(f'{name}: exit {rc}, {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours', flush=True)
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed (exit {rc}): restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell')
print('all five Phase 13 runs done. Next: Phase 13 evaluation, then Pack.')

text:
Phase 13 evaluation (gpu; after the five Phase 13 runs; about 2 hours)

title: colab_clue_rl
section: Phase 16: runs, evaluation and pack in one session (gpu; about 20 hours; no manual steps)
text:
Phase 16: runs, evaluation and pack in one session (gpu; about 20 hours; no manual steps)
After set-up and configuration, this one cell does all of Phase 16 (RL16_PLAN): (1) trains the six new runs in an interleaved order (individual_s2, indpen_s3, individual_s3, indpen_s4, individual_s4, indpen_s5), each in its own Python process so its GPU memory (vLLM’s engine included) is freed when it ends; (2) evaluates the six adapters on the 15 main boards in its own process; (3) writes explRL_rl16.zip (runs_p16, eval_p16; Phase 13’s explRL_rl.zip is left as it is) to Google Drive; (4) prints each adapter’s welfare, clues shared per clue held and solo share. Finished or halted runs and evaluated adapters are skipped, and an unfinished run resumes from its last checkpoint, so after a disconnect: restart, set-up, configuration, then this cell again. A 20-hour batch needs background execution (Colab Pro+) or a tab that stays connected.

import os
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile
import numpy as np
from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV
from explRL.rl16_grid import RL16_PLAN, RL16_RUNS, rl16Name
assert RL16_PLAN['frozen'], 'freeze, commit and push RL16_PLAN before the Phase 16 runs'
ORDER = list(RL16_RUNS)                                     # interleaved: individual and indpen alternate
WARM, E16 = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / 'eval_p16'
RESUME = 'restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again (finished steps are skipped)'


def stream(code):
    "Run `code` in a fresh Python process, echoing its output (progress bar included) here; -> its exit code."
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-u', '-c', code], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    while chunk := os.read(p.stdout.fileno(), 4096):
        sys.stdout.write(chunk.decode(errors='replace'))
        sys.stdout.flush()
    return p.wait()


t00 = time.time()
if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    assert stream(f"from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter; mergeAdapter({BASE!r}, {str(OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter')!r}, "
                  f"{str(WARM)!r})") == 0, f'merging the warm-start model failed: {RESUME}'
# 1. training, one process per run
for arm, seed in ORDER:
    name, d = rl16Name(arm, seed), RUNS16 / rl16Name(arm, seed)
    if (d / 'final').exists() or (d / 'halted.json').exists():
        print(f'{name}: already done, skipped')
        continue
    print(f'=== {name} ===', flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    rc = stream(f"from explRL.clue_rl import trainRL; from explRL.rl16_grid import rl16Config; "
                f"print(trainRL(rl16Config({arm!r}, {seed}, {str(WARM)!r}, {str(d)!r})))")
    print(f'{name}: exit {rc}, {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours', flush=True)
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed (exit {rc}): {RESUME}')
names = [rl16Name(a, s) for a, s in ORDER]
missing = [m for m in names if not (RUNS16 / m / 'final').exists()]
if missing:
    raise RuntimeError(f'no final adapter for {missing}: {RESUME}')
for m in names:
    if (RUNS16 / m / 'halted.json').exists():
        print(f"{m}: halted ({json.loads((RUNS16 / m / 'halted.json').read_text())['reason']}); evaluated from its final adapter")
# 2. evaluation, in its own process (adapters already evaluated are read back)
models = {m: (str(WARM), str(RUNS16 / m / 'final')) for m in names}
rc = stream("from explRL.bench_grid import writeCSV; from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.rl16_grid import rl16Suite; "
            f"rows = evalModels(rl16Suite({names!r}), {models!r}, {str(E16)!r}, cache='/content/evalcache', "
            f"logDir={str(E16 / 'turns')!r}); writeCSV(rows, {str(E16 / 'runs.csv')!r}); print(len(rows), 'boards')")
if rc:
    raise RuntimeError(f'evaluation failed (exit {rc}): {RESUME}')
# 3. pack to Google Drive (its own zip: Phase 13's explRL_rl.zip is left as it is)
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT / 'explRL_rl16.zip', 'w') as z:
    for p in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')):
        rel = p.relative_to(OUT)
        if p.is_file() and rel.parts[0] in ('runs_p16', 'eval_p16') and 'ckpt-' not in str(rel):
            z.write(p, rel)
# 4. summary
rows = readCSV(E16 / 'runs.csv')
for m in names:
    rs = [r for r in rows if r['level'] == f'{m}|main']
    v = lambda k: np.nanmean([float(r[k]) for r in rs])
    print(f"{m:14s} welfare {v('welfare'):.3f}  shared per held {v('sharePerHeld'):.2f}  solo {v('soloShare'):.2f}  ({len(rs)} boards)")
print(f"{OUT / 'explRL_rl16.zip'} ({(OUT / 'explRL_rl16.zip').stat().st_size / 1e6:.1f} MB); this session {(time.time() - t00) / 3600:.2f} "
      'hours. Next, on the Mac: download the zip, unzip into results/multiagent/rl/colab/, run demo_rl16 (flag train).')

title: colab_clue_rl
section: Phase 17 step 0: every trained adapter on the team-size grid (gpu; one cell; about 8 hours)
text:
Phase 17 step 0: every trained adapter on the team-size grid (gpu; one cell; about 8 hours)
The warm start and the 14 Phase 12-16 adapters on teamSizeSuite (clean boards at 4, 8, 16 and 32 agents, and boards with a quarter of the agents liars), 40 turns, in one process; models already evaluated are read back after a disconnect. Writes eval_p17s0/ and explRL_rl17s0.zip. An L4 runtime also works.
Models are claimed one at a time, so two accounts can share step 0 (run the cell on both); models not yet on Drive are skipped; the account that finds all 15 evaluated writes runs.csv and the zip.

from explRL.rl17_grid import STEP0_MODELS, claim
WARM, E0 = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / 'eval_p17s0'
if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    assert stream(f"from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter; mergeAdapter({BASE!r}, {str(OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter')!r}, {str(WARM)!r})") == 0
models = {m: (str(WARM), None if d is None else str(OUT / d / 'final')) for m, d in STEP0_MODELS.items()}
missing = [m for m, (_, a) in models.items() if a and not Path(a).exists()]
if missing:
    print(f'not on Drive yet (Phase 16 still running?): {missing}; rerun this cell later for these')
t0 = time.time()
for m, v in models.items():                                    # one model at a time, claimed, so two accounts can share step 0
    if m in missing or (E0 / f'{m}.csv').exists() or not claim(E0 / 'claims' / m, HOST, TAKEOVER):
        continue

text:
Phase 17 main: claimed runs, then the evaluation (gpu; one cell per account)
Run this cell on every Colab account that shares the Drive folder (each with its own HOST). It trains every RL17_RUNS run that is not finished and not claimed by another account, each in its own process (an unfinished run resumes from its last checkpoint). When every run has its final adapter, one account wins the evaluation claim, evaluates all runs on teamSizeSuite and writes explRL_rl17.zip; rerun the cell on any account after the last run finishes. To move a run to another account: stop the first runtime, put the run’s name in TAKEOVER on the other, rerun.
Long runs: with background execution the cell keeps going with the browser closed, but Colab ends a session after about 24 hours, and one run takes days. Runs checkpoint every step, so when a session ends: restart, set-up, configuration, this cell again; the run in progress resumes from its last step, finished runs are skipped, and the batch continues.

from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN, RL17_RUNS, claim
assert RL17_PLAN['frozen'] and RL17_PLAN['recipe'] and RL17_PLAN['userConfirmed'], \
    'freeze RL17_PLAN with the pilot-chosen recipe and the confirmed hours, commit and push first'
WARM, E17 = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / 'eval_p17'
names = [f'{a}_s{s}' for a, s in RL17_RUNS]
for (arm, seed), name in zip(RL17_RUNS, names):
    d = RUNS17 / name
    if (d / 'final').exists():
        print(f'{name}: done')
        continue
    if not claim(d, HOST, TAKEOVER):
        print(f"{name}: held by {json.loads((d / 'claim.json').read_text())['host']}, skipped")
        continue
    print(f'=== {name} on {HOST} ===', flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    rc = stream("from explRL.rl17_train import trainRL17; from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN, rl17Config; "
                f"print(trainRL17(rl17Config({arm!r}, {seed}, {str(WARM)!r}, {str(d)!r}, RL17_PLAN['recipe'])))")
    print(f'{name}: exit {rc}, {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours', flush=True)
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed (exit {rc}): ' + 'restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again (finished steps are skipped)')
pending = [n for n in names if not (RUNS17 / n / 'final').exists()]
if pending:
    print(f'waiting for {pending} (other accounts): rerun this cell after they finish')
elif not claim(E17, HOST, TAKEOVER):
    print(f"the evaluation is held by {json.loads((E17 / 'claim.json').read_text())['host']}")
else:
    models = {n: (str(WARM), str(RUNS17 / n / 'final')) for n in names}
    rc = stream("from explRL.bench_grid import writeCSV; from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.rl17_grid import teamSizeSuite; "
                f"rows = evalModels(teamSizeSuite({names!r}), {models!r}, {str(E17)!r}, cache='/content/evalcache', "
                f"logDir={str(E17 / 'turns')!r}); writeCSV(rows, {str(E17 / 'runs.csv')!r}); print(len(rows), 'boards')")
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'evaluation failed (exit {rc}): ' + 'restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again (finished steps are skipped)')
    packZip('explRL_rl17.zip', ('runs_p17', 'eval_p17'))

text:
Phase 18 speed check (gpu; one account; about 1 hour)
specs/multiagent/phase18/, Part B. Three steps of c18team (team reward on the colony board, two holders per clue, Phase 17’s frozen recipe and mix) with a 4,096-token window, into speed_p18/. Prints seconds per step, the longest prompt plus reply, cut prompts, the proposed training window (maxLenRule) and the projected GPU hours (projectHours18) for RL18_PLAN’s 30 steps (Part B lite, 5 runs): report them on the Mac, where the user confirms them and RL18_PLAN is frozen. Needs RL17_PLAN frozen with its recipe.

from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN
from explRL.rl18_grid import RL18_RUNS, RL18_STEPS, maxLenRule, projectHours18, speedConfig
assert RL17_PLAN['frozen'] and RL17_PLAN['recipe'], 'Part B needs Phase 17\'s frozen recipe'
WARM, SP = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / 'speed_p18'
rc = stream("from explRL.rl17_train import trainRL17; from explRL.rl18_grid import speedConfig; from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN; "
            f"print(trainRL17(speedConfig({str(WARM)!r}, {str(SP)!r}, RL17_PLAN['recipe'])))")
if rc:
    raise RuntimeError(f'speed check failed (exit {rc}): restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again')
m = [json.loads(x) for x in open(SP / 'metrics.jsonl')]
sec = sum(x['rolloutSeconds'] + x['updateSeconds'] for x in m[1:]) / max(1, len(m) - 1)   # step 1 includes engine start-up
longest, cut = max(x['longest'] for x in m), sum(x['cut'] for x in m)
h = projectHours18(sec, RL18_STEPS)
print(f"seconds per step {sec:.0f}; longest prompt plus reply {longest} tokens; cut prompts {cut}; invalid {[round(x['invalid'], 3) for x in m]}")
print(f"proposed maxLen {maxLenRule(longest)}; projected GPU hours at {RL18_STEPS} steps: {h['perRun']:.1f} per run, {h['total']:.0f} for all {len(RL18_RUNS)} runs")

section: Phase 18 main: claimed runs, then the evaluation (gpu; one cell per account)
text:
Phase 18 main: claimed runs, then the evaluation (gpu; one cell per account)
Run this cell on every Colab account that shares the Drive folder (each with its own HOST). It trains every RL18_RUNS run (Part B lite: c18team, 5 seeds, 30 steps) that is not finished and not claimed by another account, each in its own process (an unfinished run resumes from its last checkpoint). When every run has its final adapter, evaluation models (the warm start and the 5 adapters on colonySuite: the colony board, 8 and 32 agents with liars, 5 seeds) are claimed one at a time, so both accounts evaluate in parallel; the account that finds them all evaluated writes runs.csv and explRL_rl18.zip. Rerun the cell on any account when it says others still hold work. To move a run: stop the first runtime, add the run’s name to TAKEOVER on the other, rerun. The same 24-hour session rule as Phase 17.

from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN, claim
from explRL.rl18_grid import RL18_PLAN, RL18_RUNS, adapterReady, rl18Config, runDone
assert RL18_PLAN['frozen'] and RL18_PLAN['userConfirmed'] and RL18_PLAN['steps'] and RL18_PLAN['maxLen'], \
    'freeze RL18_PLAN with the steps, window and confirmed hours (after the speed check), commit and push first'
WARM, E18 = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / 'eval_p18'
names = [f'{a}_s{s}' for a, s in RL18_RUNS]
for (arm, seed), name in zip(RL18_RUNS, names):
    d = RUNS18 / name
    if runDone(d):                                          # halted, or the final adapter's weights saved (not just the folder)
        print(f'{name}: done')
        continue
    if not claim(d, HOST, TAKEOVER):
        print(f"{name}: held by {json.loads((d / 'claim.json').read_text())['host']}, skipped")
        continue
    print(f'=== {name} on {HOST} ===', flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    rc = stream("from explRL.rl17_train import trainRL17; from explRL.rl18_grid import RL18_PLAN, rl18Config; from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN; "
                f"print(trainRL17(rl18Config({arm!r}, {seed}, {str(WARM)!r}, {str(d)!r}, RL17_PLAN['recipe'], RL18_PLAN['steps'], RL18_PLAN['maxLen'])))")
    print(f'{name}: exit {rc}, {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours', flush=True)
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed (exit {rc}): restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again (finished steps are skipped)')
pending = [n for n in names if not runDone(RUNS18 / n)]
if pending:
    print(f'waiting for {pending} (other accounts): rerun this cell after they finish')
else:
    from explRL.rl18_grid import evalAdapter               # a halted run: the checkpoint before its halting streak (RL18_PLAN)
    models = {'warm': (str(WARM), None), **{n: (str(WARM), evalAdapter(RUNS18 / n)) for n in names}}
    print('evaluated adapters:', {n: v[1] for n, v in models.items()})
    for mname, v in models.items():                         # one model at a time, claimed: two accounts share the evaluation
        if v[1] and not adapterReady(v[1]):                # Drive has not delivered the weights here yet
            print(f'{mname}: adapter weights not in {v[1]} yet (still syncing from the other account?): rerun this cell later')
            continue
        if (E18 / f'{mname}.csv').exists() or not claim(E18 / 'claims' / mname, HOST, TAKEOVER):
            continue
        print(f'=== evaluating {mname} on {HOST} ===', flush=True)
        rc = stream("from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.rl18_grid import colonySuite; "
                    f"evalModels(colonySuite([{mname!r}]), {{{mname!r}: {v!r}}}, {str(E18)!r}, cache='/content/evalcache', logDir={str(E18 / 'turns')!r})")
        if rc:
            raise RuntimeError(f'evaluation of {mname} failed (exit {rc}): restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again')
    left = [m for m in models if not (E18 / f'{m}.csv').exists()]
    if left:
        print(f'evaluation not complete yet: {left} (other account): rerun this cell later')
    elif claim(E18 / 'claims' / '_pack', HOST, TAKEOVER):
        assert stream("from explRL.bench_grid import writeCSV; from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.rl18_grid import colonySuite; "
                      f"rows = evalModels(colonySuite({list(models)!r}), {models!r}, {str(E18)!r}); "
                      f"writeCSV(rows, {str(E18 / 'runs.csv')!r}); print(len(rows), 'boards')") == 0       # all read back
        packZip('explRL_rl18.zip', ('runs_p18', 'eval_p18'))
        print('Next, on the Mac: download explRL_rl18.zip, unzip into results/multiagent/rl/colab/, run demo_rl18 (flag train).')

def ringActivity(
    a, N, symmetric
):
Ring-neuron activity at arena heading a (one or two bumps).



from math import pi
import math
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_close, test_fail
from explRL.params import Params

N = 32
p = Params()
th = grid(N)
reb = rEB(5, N, p.kappaEB)
test_close(reb.min(), 0.0)
test_close(reb.max(), 1.0)
test_close(reb[5], 1.0)
test_close(fbNorm(32), 12.0)

wG = sinGoal(0.5, th[8], N)
gs = goalStats(wG)
test_close(gs['thetaG'], th[8], eps=1e-9)
test_close(gs['rG'], 0.5 * N / 2, eps=1e-9)
test_fail(lambda: sinGoal(0.6, 0.0, N), contains='g must')
test_fail(lambda: sinGoal(-0.1, 0.0, N), contains='g must')

# AC-2 closed form
D = fbNorm(N)
rG = gs['rG']
thetaG = gs['thetaG']
for c in range(N):
    out = outputs(wG, c, p)
    tc = th[c]
    dS_cf = 0.5 + rG / (2 * D) * np.sin(tc - thetaG)
    test_close(out['dS'], dS_cf, eps=1e-9)
ds_all = np.array([outputs(wG, c, p)['dS'] for c in range(N)])
test_eq(int(ds_all.argmax()), 16)
test_close(ds_all.min(), 1/6, eps=1e-9)
test_close(ds_all.max(), 5/6, eps=1e-9)
nu_all = np.array([outputs(wG, c, p)['nuF'] for c in range(N)])
test_eq(int(nu_all.argmin()), 8)

# section 10 table spot checks
for g, rG_exp in [(0.25, 4.0), (0.5, 8.0)]:
    w = sinGoal(g, 0.0, N)
    test_close(goalStats(w)['rG'], rG_exp, eps=1e-6)
w1 = np.ones(N)
test_close(goalStats(w1)['strength'], 0.0, eps=1e-9)
test_close(outputs(w1, 0, p)['rF'], -0.233, eps=1e-3)

# ring activity
act_a = ringActivity(0, N, False)
test_eq(int((act_a > 0).sum()), 3)
test_close(act_a[[0, 1, N-1]].tolist(), [1.0, 0.5, 0.5])
act_w = ringActivity(N - 1, N, False)
test_close(act_w[[N - 1, 0, N - 2]].tolist(), [1.0, 0.5, 0.5])
act_s = ringActivity(0, N, True)
test_eq(int((act_s > 0).sum()), 6)
wC0 = np.ones((N, N)) * 0.5
test_close(jumpProb(wC0, act_a, 0), 0.5)
test_close(jumpProb(np.zeros((N, N)), act_a, 0), 0.5)

# AC-4 goal plasticity
wG0 = sinGoal(0.3, th[0], N).copy()
c_fix = 8

def _ang_to_c(gs, c):
    return abs((gs['thetaG'] - th[c] + pi) % (2 * pi) - pi)

w_r = goalStep(wG0, c_fix, 1, p)
w_p = goalStep(wG0, c_fix, -1, p)
w_z = goalStep(wG0, c_fix, 0, p)
test_close(w_z, wG0)
assert _ang_to_c(goalStats(w_r), c_fix) < _ang_to_c(goalStats(wG0), c_fix)
assert _ang_to_c(goalStats(w_p), c_fix) > _ang_to_c(goalStats(wG0), c_fix)
assert goalStats(goalStep(wG0, 0, 1, p))['strength'] > goalStats(wG0)['strength']
assert w_r.min() >= 0 and w_r.max() <= 1

# AC-5 compass plasticity
from explRL.envs import ZoneArena
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
wC = rng.uniform(0, 1, (N, N))
env = ZoneArena(N=N, symmetric=False)
mirror = 10
def mean_pj(wC):
    return float(np.mean([jumpProb(wC, env.ringActivity(a), (mirror - a) % N) for a in range(N)]))
p0 = mean_pj(wC)
for _ in range(1000):
    direction = 1 if rng.random() < 0.5 else -1
    size = float(np.deg2rad(rng.lognormal(p.muS, p.sigmaS)))
    steps = max(1, int(math.ceil(size / (2 * pi / N))))
    a = int(rng.integers(N))
    c = (mirror - a) % N
    for _ in range(steps):
        wC = compassStep(wC, env.ringActivity(a), c, size, p)
        a = (a + direction) % N
        c = (c - direction) % N
assert p0 > 0.45
assert mean_pj(wC) < 0.15
assert wC.min() >= 0 and wC.max() <= 1

for w0 in (np.zeros((N, N)), np.ones((N, N))):
    w1 = compassStep(w0, ringActivity(3, N, False), 3, 0.1, p)
    assert w1.min() >= 0 and w1.max() <= 1
    w2 = goalStep(np.zeros(N), 4, 1, p)
    assert w2.min() >= 0 and w2.max() <= 1

clue_agents
text:
Tests

import numpy as np
from explRL.clue_agents import *
from explRL.clueboard import ClueBoardEnv
from explRL.multi import runTeam, spawnRngs

b = ClueBoardEnv(3, 4, m=3, r=1, R=105, life=100)
k = b.open[0]; t = b.tasks[k].task
# channels deliver shared clues: the board to all, messages to two, the coordinator to the openers
cb = ClueBoard(); cb.post(1, k, (0, t.primes[0], t.clue(0)[1]), 2.0)
assert cb.view(0, 3.0, b)[k][0][:3] == (0, t.primes[0], t.clue(0)[1]) and known(2, b, cb)[k][0] == t.clue(0)[1]
mb = ClueMessages(4, 2, spawnRngs(9, 4)); to = mb.post(1, k, (1, t.primes[1], t.clue(1)[1]), 2.0)
assert len(to) == 2 and 1 not in to and all(known(a, b, mb)[k].get(1) == t.clue(1)[1] for a in to)
assert len(mb.take(to[0])) == 1 and mb.take(to[0]) == [] and known(to[0], b, mb)[k][1] == t.clue(1)[1]   # kept after take
other = [a for a in range(4) if a not in to and a != 1][0]
assert 1 not in known(other, b, mb)[k] or 1 in b.held(other, k)
lead = ClueLead(4); b.opened[2] = k
lead.post(0, k, (2, t.primes[2], t.clue(2)[1]), 3.0, b)
assert known(2, b, lead)[k][2] == t.clue(2)[1] and (2 not in known(3, b, lead)[k] or 2 in b.held(3, k))
assert lead.suggest(0, b) == k and lead.assigned[0] == k
# own clues win over a false sighting
b.opened[2] = None
held = b.held(0, k)
if held:
    j, r = next(iter(held.items())); cb.post(1, k, (j, t.primes[j], (r + 1) % t.primes[j]), 4.0)
    assert known(0, b, cb)[k][j] == r

def team(channel, share='needed', seed=0, N=4, T=40, liar=False, **kw):
    bd = ClueBoardEnv(seed, N, life=30, **kw)
    ch = dict(none=None, blackboard=ClueBoard(), messages=ClueMessages(N, 2, spawnRngs(seed + 2000, N)), hierarchical=ClueLead(N))[channel]
    rngs = spawnRngs(seed + 1000, N)
    ms = [ClueLiar(ch, rngs[0]) if liar and i == 0 else RuleAgent(ch, rngs[i], share) for i in range(N)]
    runTeam(ms, bd, T)
    return bd
# AC-4: with no channel rule agents never share, and a channel with 'never' sharing gives the no-channel result
assert team('none').counts['shares'] == 0
assert team('blackboard', 'never').netByAgent().sum() == team('none').netByAgent().sum()
# the blackboard with 'needed' sharing solves more than no channel (averaged over seeds); assisted solves happen
bb = [team('blackboard', seed=s) for s in range(5)]; no = [team('none', seed=s) for s in range(5)]
assert sum(x.counts['solved'] for x in bb) > sum(x.counts['solved'] for x in no)
assert any(a for x in bb for (_, _, _, a) in x.solveLog)
for ch in ('messages', 'hierarchical'):
    assert team(ch).counts['shares'] > 0
# a solo agent holds every clue and solves without sharing
solo = team('none', N=1, T=30)
assert solo.counts['solved'] > 0 and solo.counts['wrong'] == 0
# a liar posts false clues; answers built on them can be wrong
lb = [team('blackboard', seed=s, liar=True) for s in range(5)]
assert all(any(x[6] for x in d.shareLog) for d in lb) and sum(d.counts['wrong'] for d in lb) > sum(d.counts['wrong'] for d in bb)
# guessing submits candidates and is reported to the board
g = ClueBoardEnv(1, 4)
ms = [RuleAgent(None, r, 'needed', guess=1.0) for r in spawnRngs(5, 4)]
runTeam(ms, g, 20)
assert g.counts['wrong'] > 0 and all(s[3] is not None and s[3] >= 1 for s in g.submits)

Claiming runs across Colab accounts

claim
def claim(
    runDir, host, takeover:tuple=()
):
Claim runDir for host (claim.json): free -> claimed; ours -> True; another host’s -> False unless the run’s name is in takeover. A folder with progress but no claim (a run started by a cell without claiming) counts as held by another host. The write is atomic (temporary file, then rename) and read back.

Artifacts under results/multiagent/rl/{quick,debug,warm,eval,eval_p13}/ (gitignored); the Colab zip is unpacked into results/multiagent/rl/colab/; local replies are cached in results/multiagent/rl/cache/, so a rerun of the evaluation is byte-identical. GPU hours and cost per Colab session go in results/multiagent/rl/gpu.json ({"hours": ..., "cost": ...}).
import json
import os
import subprocess

import numpy as np

from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV, rowKey, writeCSV
from explRL.clue_policy import claudePolicy, scriptedPolicy
from explRL.clue_roll import runEval
from explRL.coop_grid import LOCAL, MODELS, RL13_PLAN, RL_PLAN, coopHash, evalSuite
from explRL.llm_budget import Budget, estimateCost
from explRL.llm_grid import HAIKU
from explRL.rl_report import rlSummaries, writeRL, writeRLFigures
from explRL.train import demo_artifact_dir

DN = 'multiagent/rl'
D = demo_artifact_dir(None, DN)
CAP = 150.0
LLM = demo_artifact_dir(None, 'multiagent/llm')
LIVE = os.environ.get('EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE') == '1'
LIVE_SPEC = dict(kind='live', cache=str(LLM / 'cache'), cap=CAP, ledger=str(LLM / 'spend.jsonl'))
P11 = demo_artifact_dir('full', 'multiagent/clue') / 'runs.csv'
RUNS = 'runs' if RL_PLAN['version'] == 1 else f"runs_v{RL_PLAN['version']}"   # the RL runs of the current plan
PLANS = dict(RL_PLAN=(RL_PLAN, None), RL13_PLAN=(RL13_PLAN, 'Phase 13, Track B: RL that beats imitation'))


def gitCommit():
    try:
        return subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or 'unknown'
    except OSError:
        return 'unknown'


def slots(cell, model, haiku):
    "(policies, memory) for a cell: model agents with notes; in cross-play, Haiku slots with full memory."
    test, N = cell['level'].split('|')[1], cell['N']
    mine = {'cross1': [0], 'cross3': [0, 1, 2]}.get(test)
    if mine is None:
        return model, 'notes'
    return {i: model if i in mine else haiku for i in range(N)}, {i: 'notes' if i in mine else 'full' for i in range(N)}


def report(mode, rows, apiCost=0.0, adapters=None, curves=None, halted=None, plan='RL_PLAN'):
    out = demo_artifact_dir(mode, DN)
    writeCSV(rows, out / 'runs.csv')
    p11 = readCSV(P11) if P11.exists() else []
    S = rlSummaries(rows, [r for r in p11 if r['runner'] == 'llm'], [r for r in p11 if r['study'] == 'clueNumpy'])
    gpu = json.loads((D / 'gpu.json').read_text()) if (D / 'gpu.json').exists() else dict(hours=0.0, cost=0.0)
    P, title = PLANS[plan]
    meta = dict(mode=mode, planHash=coopHash(P), plan=plan, **({'title': title} if title else {}), commit=gitCommit(),
                base=MODELS['base'], adapters=adapters or {}, halted=halted or {},
                gpuHours=gpu['hours'], gpuCost=gpu['cost'], apiCost=apiCost,
                apiSpent=Budget(CAP, LIVE_SPEC['ledger']).spent() if (LLM / 'spend.jsonl').exists() else 0.0)
    writeRL(out / 'report.md', S, meta)
    ref = lambda st: [r['welfare'] for r in p11 if r['study'] == st and r['channel'] == 'blackboard' and int(r['N']) == 4
                      and int(r['seed']) in range(900, 905)]
    refs = [(float(np.mean(ref(st))), lab, c) for st, lab, c in (('clue', 'Haiku (Phase 11)', 'tab:orange'),
                                                                  ('clueNumpy', 'rule agents', 'tab:green')) if ref(st)]
    writeRLFigures(out, S, curves, refs=refs)
    return S

Quick: the evaluation and report pipeline with scripted policies

import re
def solver(system, blocks):
    "Reads only the text: opens the first listed subtask, submits once its known clues fix the answer, else waits."
    o = blocks[-1]['text']
    m = re.search(r'Your open subtask: T(\d+), open\. Find x with 0 <= x < (\d+)\. Clues you know: (.*)\.', o)
    if not m:
        return json.dumps(dict(action='open', target=re.search(r'\): (T\d+)', o).group(1), answer=0, clue='', notes=''))
    cl = [tuple(map(int, c)) for c in re.findall(r'x mod (\d+) = (\d+)', m.group(3))]
    xs = [y for y in range(int(m.group(2))) if all(y % p == r for p, r in cl)]
    return json.dumps(dict(action='submit', answer=xs[0], target='', clue='', notes='') if len(xs) == 1 else dict(action='wait'))
waiter = scriptedPolicy(lambda s, b: '{"action": "wait"}')
cells = [dict(c, cfg=dict(c['cfg'], turns=3)) for c in evalSuite(('warm', 'credit')) if c['seed'] in (900, 901, 930)]
rows = runEval(cells, lambda c: slots(c, scriptedPolicy(solver), waiter))
S = report('quick', rows)
q = demo_artifact_dir('quick', DN)
assert {p.name for p in q.iterdir()} >= {'runs.csv', 'report.md', 'coop_main.png', 'coop_info.png'} and 'credit' in S['gain']
print(open(q / 'report.md').read()[:600])

text:
Evaluation and report (train; cross-play also needs EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE=1) (AC-11)
The five models one at a time (the untrained base model, the warm-start model, and the three RL adapters on it), cached replies; Haiku slots through the Phase 10 client under the $150 API cap.

import gc
import torch
from explRL.clue_policy import claudePolicy
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig, makeClient
from explRL.local_policy import LocalPolicy, adapterHash
assert RL_PLAN['frozen'], 'RL_PLAN must be frozen before the evaluation'
C, WARM = D / 'colab', D / 'warm_model'
cells = evalSuite()
colab = readCSV(C / 'eval' / 'runs.csv') if (C / 'eval' / 'runs.csv').exists() else []
if colab:                  # the Colab evaluation ran every cell but cross-play: here only cross-play, merged with it
    cells = [c for c in cells if c['level'].endswith(('cross1', 'cross3'))]
    print(f'{len(colab)} evaluation rows from Colab; {len(cells)} cross-play cells to run here')
haiku, apiCost = None, 0.0
if LIVE:
    client = makeClient(LLMConfig(task='clue', model=HAIKU, effort=RL_PLAN['haiku']['effort'],
                                  maxTokens=RL_PLAN['haiku']['maxTokens']), LIVE_SPEC)
    client.reserve(estimateCost(HAIKU, 'clue', 1, 3200))
    haiku = claudePolicy(client)
else:
    cells = [c for c in cells if not c['level'].endswith(('cross1', 'cross3'))]
    print('cross-play skipped: set EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE=1')
adapters, rows = {}, list(colab)
for m in LOCAL:
    path = None if m in ('untrained', 'warm') else str(C / RUNS / m / 'final')
    adapters[m] = adapterHash(path)
    mine = [c for c in cells if c['level'].startswith(m + '|')]
    if not mine:
        continue
    pol = LocalPolicy(MODELS['base'] if m == 'untrained' else str(WARM), adapter=path, cache=str(D / 'cache'))
    rows += runEval(mine, lambda c: slots(c, pol, haiku), logDir=demo_artifact_dir('eval', DN) / 'turns')
    del pol
    gc.collect()
    torch.mps.empty_cache() if torch.backends.mps.is_available() else None
apiCost = float(sum(float(r['cost']) for r in rows))
curves = {sc: [json.loads(x) for x in open(C / RUNS / sc / 'metrics.jsonl')] for sc in RL_PLAN['schemes']
          if (C / RUNS / sc / 'metrics.jsonl').exists()}
halted = {sc: json.loads((C / RUNS / sc / 'halted.json').read_text()) for sc in RL_PLAN['schemes']
          if (C / RUNS / sc / 'halted.json').exists()}
S = report('eval', sorted(rows, key=rowKey), apiCost, adapters, curves, halted)
print(open(demo_artifact_dir('eval', DN) / 'report.md').read()[:3000])

text:
Phase 13 evaluation and report (train; cross-play also needs EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE=1) (AC-8)
Unpack the Colab zip (with eval_p13/ and runs_p13/) into results/multiagent/rl/colab/ first; the Phase 12 evaluation (results/multiagent/rl/eval/runs.csv) must be there too. Reused, not rerun: the Phase 12 warm-start rows and its v2 credit run as credit_s1 (the credit arm’s seed 1, cross-play included). The best arm by RL13_PLAN’s rule (the highest mean RL gain over the warm start on the main boards) gets cross-play for both its seeds here, with Haiku slots through the Phase 10 client; replies cached, so a rerun is byte-identical and free. Report in results/multiagent/rl/eval_p13/.

import gc
import torch
from explRL.clue_policy import claudePolicy
from explRL.coop_grid import RL13_RUNS, rl13Name, rl13Suite
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig, makeClient
from explRL.local_policy import LocalPolicy, adapterHash
from explRL.rl_report import bestArm, renameModel
C, WARM = D / 'colab', D / 'warm_model'
E13, P12 = C / 'eval_p13' / 'runs.csv', D / 'eval' / 'runs.csv'
if not (E13.exists() and P12.exists()):
    print(f'Phase 13 evaluation skipped: needs {E13} (the Colab zip) and {P12} (the Phase 12 evaluation)')
else:
    assert RL13_PLAN['frozen'], 'RL13_PLAN must be frozen before the evaluation'
    names = ['credit_s1'] + [rl13Name(a, s) for a, s in RL13_RUNS]
    run = lambda m: C / RUNS / 'credit' if m == 'credit_s1' else C / 'runs_p13' / m      # credit seed 1: Phase 12's v2 run
    rows = renameModel([r for r in readCSV(P12) if r['level'].split('|')[0] in ('warm', 'credit')], 'credit', 'credit_s1')
    rows += readCSV(E13)
    arm = bestArm(rlSummaries(rows, []))
    have = {r['level'] for r in rows}
    cells = [c for c in rl13Suite([rl13Name(arm, s) for s in (1, 2)], cross=True) if c['level'] not in have]
    print(f'{len(rows)} rows reused; best arm {arm}; {len(cells)} cross-play cells to run here')
    if cells and not LIVE:
        print('cross-play skipped: set EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE=1')
        cells = []
    new = []
    if cells:
        client = makeClient(LLMConfig(task='clue', model=HAIKU, effort=RL_PLAN['haiku']['effort'],
                                      maxTokens=RL_PLAN['haiku']['maxTokens']), LIVE_SPEC)
        client.reserve(estimateCost(HAIKU, 'clue', 1, sum(c['cfg']['turns'] * (3 if c['level'].endswith('cross1') else 1) for c in cells)))
        haiku = claudePolicy(client)
        for m in sorted({c['level'].split('|')[0] for c in cells}):
            pol = LocalPolicy(str(WARM), adapter=str(run(m) / 'final'), cache=str(D / 'cache'))
            new += runEval([c for c in cells if c['level'].startswith(m + '|')], lambda c: slots(c, pol, haiku),
                           logDir=demo_artifact_dir('eval_p13', DN) / 'turns')
            del pol
            gc.collect()
            torch.mps.empty_cache() if torch.backends.mps.is_available() else None
    adapters = {m: adapterHash(str(run(m) / 'final')) for m in names}
    curves = {m: [json.loads(x) for x in open(run(m) / 'metrics.jsonl')] for m in names if (run(m) / 'metrics.jsonl').exists()}
    halted = {m: json.loads((run(m) / 'halted.json').read_text()) for m in names if (run(m) / 'halted.json').exists()}
    S = report('eval_p13', sorted(rows + new, key=rowKey), float(sum(float(r['cost']) for r in new)), adapters, curves, halted,
               plan='RL13_PLAN')
    print(open(demo_artifact_dir('eval_p13', DN) / 'report.md').read()[:3000])

def flexibleAgent(

source

PolicyGradientRL
def PolicyGradientRL(
    policy, lr:float=1.0, eps:float=1e-12
):
Online policy-gradient learning for flexibleAgent (paper Eqs. 13-18, Algorithm 1).


Tests use a small agent with a flat basis so results are easy to predict:

from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_fail, test_close
from explRL.params import Params

def toy_agent(theta=0.0, aF=10.0, nb=4, nx=8, omega=None, seed=None):
    "Builds a small flexibleAgent for testing."
    policy = flexiblePolicy(omega=np.zeros(2 * nb) if omega is None else omega,
                            fk=np.ones((nb, nx)), wParams=np.array([0.5, 1.0, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 0.0]))
    params = Params(nx=nx, nb=nb, delT=0.01, sigF=0.1, aF=aF, muS=0.0, sigmaS=0.5, tS=0.05)
    return flexibleAgent(theta, None, policy, PolicyGradientRL(policy), params, rng=np.random.default_rng(seed))

agent = toy_agent()
nu, pR = agent.convertParams(agent.policy.omega, agent.policy.fk[:, 0], agent.policy.wParams)
test_eq((nu, pR), (0.5, 0.5))   # all-zero weights give sigmoid(0) = fmax/2

With a high threshold the agent fixates; with a tiny threshold it saccades, the step lasts dtS and the integrator resets:

agent = toy_agent(aF=10.0, seed=1)
step = agent.samplePolicy()
test_eq((step.saccade, step.dx, step.dt, step.direction), (False, 0.0, 1, 0))
test_eq(step.ind, agent._heading_index(8))
test_close(agent.policy.integ, step.xi + step.dxi)

agent = toy_agent(aF=1e-6, seed=2)
step = agent.samplePolicy()
assert step.saccade and step.direction in (1, -1)
test_eq(step.dt, agent.params.dtS)
test_eq(agent.policy.integ, 0.0)
assert isinstance(step.dx, float) and step.dx != round(step.dx)   # radians, not rounded
assert np.sign(step.dx) == step.direction

Headings are stored wrapped into [0, 2π), and the nearest basis column wraps too:

test_close(toy_agent(theta=-0.1).theta, 2 * np.pi - 0.1)
test_eq(toy_agent(theta=2 * np.pi - 0.01)._heading_index(8), 0)
test_eq(toy_agent(theta=np.pi)._heading_index(8), 4)
test_eq(toy_agent(theta=7 * np.pi)._heading_index(8), 4)

The same seed gives the same sequence of steps:

a0, a1 = toy_agent(aF=0.05, seed=99), toy_agent(aF=0.05, seed=99)
for _ in range(20):
    test_eq(a0.samplePolicy(), a1.samplePolicy())

sigmoidGrad and gradLogPi match finite differences, for a fixation and for clockwise and counter-clockwise saccades (AC-2):

ag = toy_agent(omega=np.linspace(-0.3, 0.3, 8))
x = 0.3
test_close(ag.sigmoidGrad(x, 1.0, 1.0), (ag.sigmoid(x + 1e-5, 1, 1, 0) - ag.sigmoid(x - 1e-5, 1, 1, 0)) / 2e-5, eps=1e-6)

def fd_check(step, h=1e-6):
    rl, om = ag.rl, ag.policy.omega.copy()
    g = rl.gradLogPi(ag, step)
    fd = np.array([(rl.logPi(ag, step, om + h * e) - rl.logPi(ag, step, om - h * e)) / (2 * h) for e in np.eye(om.size)])
    assert np.max(np.abs(g - fd)) <= 1e-4 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(fd))), (g, fd)

xi = ag.params.aF - 0.02   # near the threshold, so fixation and saccade are both plausible
fd_check(Step(0.0, 0, xi, 0.0, False, 0, 0.0, 1))
fd_check(Step(0.0, 0, xi, 0.0, True, 1, 0.5, ag.params.dtS))
fd_check(Step(0.0, 0, xi, 0.0, True, -1, -0.5, ag.params.dtS))

Gradients stay finite when the fixation probability is very close to 0 or 1 (NFR-7):

for xi in (-50.0, 50.0):
    for sac, d in ((False, 0), (True, 1), (True, -1)):
        assert np.isfinite(ag.rl.gradLogPi(ag, Step(0.0, 0, xi, 0.0, sac, d, 0.0, 1))).all()

A positive reward after a clockwise saccade raises pR at that heading, a negative reward lowers it, and zero reward changes nothing (AC-3):

def pR_after(reward):
    a = toy_agent()
    step = Step(0.0, 0, 0.0, 0.0, True, 1, 0.5, a.params.dtS)
    a.rl.updateParams(a, step, reward)
    return a.convertParams(a.policy.omega, a.policy.fk[:, 0], a.policy.wParams)[1], a.policy.omega

p_pos, _ = pR_after(1.0)
p_neg, _ = pR_after(-1.0)
assert p_pos > 0.5 > p_neg
_, om0 = pR_after(0.0)
test_eq(om0, np.zeros(8))

Bad inputs fail early, and the base RL class still has to be subclassed:

test_fail(lambda: toy_agent(omega=np.zeros(7)), contains="even length")
test_fail(lambda: flexibleAgent(0.0, None, Policy(), None, Params(nx=8, nb=4)), contains="flexiblePolicy")
test_fail(lambda: RL(None).chooseAction())
test_fail(lambda: RL(None).updateParams())

Tests

import json, re
from explRL.clue_policy import parseReply, scriptedPolicy
from explRL.clue_roll import coopRows, rollout
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig

W = dict(m=2, r=1, R=30, value=(1, 2, 3), life=30, penalty=0.5)
ex, boards = sftExamples([20000, 20001], sizes=(1, 2), turns=12, boards=True)
assert len(ex) == 2 * 12 * (1 + 2) and len(boards) == 4
# AC-4: every reply parses, its note comes first, and submit notes list exactly the candidates
acts = set()
for e in ex:
    r = parseReply(e['assistant'])
    assert list(r) == ['notes', 'action', 'target', 'answer', 'clue'] and r['action'] in ('open', 'submit', 'share', 'wait')
    acts.add(r['action'])
    if r['action'] == 'submit':
        parts = re.findall(r'x mod (\d+) = (\d+)[^:]*: ([\d, ]+)', r['notes'])
        (p, a, first), last = parts[0], parts[-1][2]
        assert [int(x) for x in first.split(', ')] == list(range(int(a), 30, int(p)))
        assert [int(x) for x in last.split(', ')] == [r['answer']]
assert {'open', 'submit', 'share'} <= acts
# replaying the examples' replies through rollout (notes memory) reproduces the teacher's boards
lookup = {(e['system'], e['user']): e['assistant'] for e in ex}
replay = scriptedPolicy(lambda s, b: lookup[(s, '\n\n'.join(x['text'] for x in b))])
for N, bs in ((1, boards[:2]), (2, boards[2:])):
    cfg = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard' if N > 1 else 'none', N=N, turns=12, world=W)
    rows = coopRows(cfg, rollout(cfg, [20000, 20001], replay))
    assert [r['solved'] for r in rows] == [b.counts['solved'] for b in bs] and all(r['invalid'] == 0 for r in rows)
    if N == 1:
        assert all(b.counts['solved'] >= b.counts['opens'] - 1 and b.counts['wrong'] == 0 for b in bs)
# the warm-start check: a solver that reads only the text passes, a policy that only waits fails
def solver(system, blocks):
    o = blocks[-1]['text']
    m = re.search(r'Your open subtask: T(\d+), open\. Find x with 0 <= x < (\d+)\. Clues you know: (.*)\.', o)
    if not m:
        return json.dumps(dict(action='open', target=re.search(r'\): (T\d+)', o).group(1), answer=0, clue='', notes=''))
    cl = [tuple(map(int, c)) for c in re.findall(r'x mod (\d+) = (\d+)', m.group(3))]
    xs = [y for y in range(int(m.group(2))) if all(y % p == r for p, r in cl)]
    return json.dumps(dict(action='submit', answer=xs[0], target='', clue='', notes='') if len(xs) == 1 else dict(action='wait'))
ok = warmCheck(scriptedPolicy(solver), seeds=range(1200, 1203), turns=20)
assert ok['passed'] and ok['solveRate'] >= 0.8 and ok['invalid'] == 0, ok
bad = warmCheck(scriptedPolicy(lambda s, b: '{"action": "wait"}'), seeds=range(1200, 1202), turns=10)
assert not bad['passed'] and bad['opens'] == 0
assert set(libVersions()) == {'torch', 'transformers', 'peft', 'vllm'}
assert SFTConfig('m', 'o').batch == 16 and asdict(SFTConfig('m', 'o'))['loraR'] == 16


# With the [train] extra, no download: the warm start, merge and check on the tiny random model (the loss falls)
import importlib.util
if all(importlib.util.find_spec(m) for m in ('transformers', 'peft', 'tokenizers')):   # the [train] extra; the docs build runs cells with imports and lacks it
    import tempfile
    from explRL.local_policy import LocalPolicy
    from explRL.tiny_model import tinyModel
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        tiny = tinyModel(d + '/tiny')
        a = trainSFT(SFTConfig(tiny, d + '/sft', maxSteps=6, batch=8, microBatch=4, lr=1e-3), sftExamples(range(20000, 20003), sizes=(1, 2), turns=10))
        losses = [json.loads(x)['loss'] for x in open(d + '/sft/metrics.jsonl')]
        assert len(losses) == 6 and losses[-1] < losses[0], losses
        res = warmCheck(LocalPolicy(mergeAdapter(tiny, a, d + '/merged'), maxNew=24), seeds=range(1200, 1202), turns=4)
        assert set(res) == {'solveRate', 'invalid', 'opens', 'solved', 'passed'}

import json
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from explRL.scale_report import *
from explRL.bench_grid import rowKey

def row(study, level, N, seed, **m):
    return dict(study=study, factor=study, level=level, channel='blackboard', budget='turns', N=N, seed=seed, episode=0,
                **{**dict(welfare=1.0, welfareHonest=1.0, pooledShare=0.5, invalid=0), **m})
# Part A on synthetic rows with known effects: each arm's liar loss is baseline's x (1 - LR), seed by seed
LR = dict(record=0.6, recordPrivate=0.2, verify=0.0, verifyPublic=0.4)
seeds = range(900, 910)
loss = {s: 2.0 + 0.3 * (s % 4) for s in seeds}
r13, r14 = [], []
for s in seeds:
    for a, rs in (('baseline', r13), ('record', r13), ('verify', r13), ('recordPrivate', r14), ('verifyPublic', r14)):
        st, clean = ('fixA' if rs is r13 else 'trustA'), 10.0 + s % 3
        rs.append(row(st, a, 4, s, welfareHonest=clean, welfare=clean + 0.1 * (a == 'record')))
        rs.append(row(st, a + '|liar', 4, s, welfareHonest=clean - loss[s] * (1 - LR.get(a, 0.0))))
r13.append(row('fixA', 'request', 8, 900))                                          # other cells are ignored
S = trustSummaries(r13, r14)
assert set(S['arms']) == set(LR) and all(abs(S['arms'][a]['gap'] - LR[a]) < 1e-9 for a in LR)
assert S['arms']['recordPrivate']['primary'] and S['arms']['verifyPublic']['primary'] and not S['arms']['record']['primary']
assert S['arms']['record']['pHolm'] != S['arms']['record']['pHolm']                 # Phase 13 arms: no new test
assert S['arms']['verifyPublic']['public'] and not S['arms']['verifyPublic']['free'] and S['arms']['recordPrivate']['free']
E = S['effects']
for k, v in (('publicity', (0.6 + 0.4) / 2 - (0.2 + 0.0) / 2), ('cost', (0.6 + 0.2) / 2 - (0.0 + 0.4) / 2)):
    assert abs(E[k]['effect'] - v) < 1e-9 and all(abs(c - v) < 1e-9 for c in E[k]['ci']) and E[k]['n'] == 10, k
assert abs(E['difference']['effect'] - 0.2) < 1e-9
assert abs(S['cost']['record']['mean'] - 0.1) < 1e-9 and S['cost']['verifyPublic']['mean'] == 0 and set(S['cost']) == set(LR)
# a noisy arm: the bootstrap interval opens around the estimate, the same seeds resampled for every arm
noisy = [dict(r, welfareHonest=r['welfareHonest'] - (0.5 if r['seed'] % 2 else -0.5)) if r['level'] == 'verifyPublic|liar' else r for r in r14]
e = trustSummaries(r13, noisy)['effects']['publicity']
assert e['ci'][0] < e['effect'] < e['ci'][1] and abs(e['effect'] - 0.4) < 1e-9          # mean loss unchanged (5 up, 5 down)
# seeds missing from one arm drop out of the effects (all arms share the seeds)
assert trustSummaries(r13, [r for r in r14 if r['seed'] != 909])['effects']['publicity']['n'] == 9
# mechanism: checks, checks found false and the checked shares behind the track records shown
k = rowKey(row('trustA', 'recordPrivate|liar', 4, 900))
k2 = rowKey(row('trustA', 'verifyPublic|liar', 4, 900))
recs = [dict(key=k, kind='turn', valid=True, report=None, response='{"action": "wait"}',
             obs='T1: x mod 3 = 1 (agent 0, 2 turns ago, record 1/3 true); T2: x mod 5 = 2 (agent 2, 1 turns ago, record none)'),
        dict(key=k, kind='turn', valid=True, report=None, response='{"action": "wait"}',
             obs='T1: x mod 3 = 1 (agent 0, 3 turns ago, record 0/1 true)'),
        dict(key=k2, kind='turn', valid=True, report=None, response='{"action": "check"}',
             obs='Your check: T1 x mod 3 = 1 (from agent 0) is false.\nChecked by agent 2: T2 x mod 5 = 2 (from agent 1) is true.')]
m = trustLogMetrics(recs)
assert m[k]['recordEntries'] == 3 and abs(m[k]['recordChecked'] - 4 / 3) < 1e-9 and abs(m[k]['recordNone'] - 1 / 3) < 1e-9
assert m[k2]['checks'] == 1 and m[k2]['checkedFalse'] == 1 and m[k2]['recordEntries'] == 0 and m[k2]['recordChecked'] != m[k2]['recordChecked']
S = trustSummaries(r13, r14, m)
assert S['mechanism']['recordPrivate|liar']['recordChecked'] == 4 / 3 and S['mechanism']['verifyPublic|liar']['checks'] == 1
assert set(S['mechanism']) == {a + x for a in ('baseline', *LR) for x in ('', '|liar')} and S['mechanism']['record']['runs'] == 10

# Part B on synthetic rows: request closes -0.1 of the gap and record recovers half the loss at every N
rows = []
for N in (8, 16, 32):
    for s in range(900, 905):
        b, cl, B = 0.4 + 0.02 * (s % 3), 10.0 + s % 2, 1.0 + N / 8 + 0.1 * (s % 4)
        rows += [row('scaleB', 'baseline', N, s, pooledShare=b, welfareHonest=cl), row('scaleB', 'request', N, s, pooledShare=b - 0.1 * (1 - b)),
                 row('scaleB', 'baseline|liar', N, s, welfareHonest=cl - B), row('scaleB', 'record|liar', N, s, welfareHonest=cl - 0.5 * B)]
T = scaleSummaries(rows + [row('trustA', 'request', 8, 900, pooledShare=1.0)])
assert set(T['request']) == {'request|8', 'request|16', 'request|32'} and set(T['record']) == {'record|8', 'record|16', 'record|32'}
assert all(abs(v['gap'] + 0.1) < 1e-9 for v in T['request'].values()) and all(abs(v['gap'] - 0.5) < 1e-9 for v in T['record'].values())
assert all(v['cleanRef'] == 'baseline' and v['primary'] and v['n'] == 5 for v in T['record'].values())
assert all(v['primary'] and v['pHolm'] == v['pHolm'] for v in T['request'].values())
assert T['trend']['record'] == {8: 0.5, 16: 0.5, 32: 0.5} or all(abs(x - 0.5) < 1e-9 for x in T['trend']['record'].values())
assert abs(T['baseline'][16]['honestLoss']['mean'] - (3 + 0.1 * np.mean([s % 4 for s in range(900, 905)]))) < 1e-9
assert abs(T['baseline'][8]['pooledShare']['mean'] - np.mean([0.4 + 0.02 * (s % 3) for s in range(900, 905)])) < 1e-9
# with record's own clean cells, they are its clean reference
own = rows + [row('scaleB', 'record', N, s, welfareHonest=11.0 + s % 2) for N in (8, 16, 32) for s in range(900, 905)]
own = [dict(r, welfareHonest=r['welfareHonest'] + 1) if r['level'] == 'record|liar' else r for r in own]
assert all(v['cleanRef'] == 'record' and abs(v['gap'] - 0.5) < 1e-9 for v in scaleSummaries(own)['record'].values())

# reports and figures
meta = dict(mode='test', planHash='abc', commit='x', model='claude-haiku-5-5', pricesChecked='2026-10-12', cost=0.0, spent=0.0,
            cap=150.0, calls=0, wall=0.0)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    d = Path(d)
    t = writeTrust(d / 't.md', S, meta).read_text()
    assert '| recordPrivate (private/free) | 0.20 [0.20, 0.20]' in t and '| publicity | 0.40 [0.40, 0.40] | 10 |' in t
    assert 'Phase 13 |' in t and 'Mechanism' in t and 'TRUST_PLAN' in t
    sc = writeScale(d / 's.md', T, meta).read_text()
    assert '| request|8 | -0.10 [-0.10, -0.10]' in sc and '| record|32 | 0.50' in sc and '## Baseline per N' in sc and 'SCALE_PLAN' in sc
    ps = figScale(d, S, T)

    assert figScale(d, None, scaleSummaries([])) == []

Tests

import json, math, os, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from explRL.llm_runs import *
from explRL.llm_budget import BudgetExceeded
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient, ResponseCache
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply

def same(a, b):
    return json.dumps(a, sort_keys=True, default=str).replace('NaN', 'nan') == json.dumps(b, sort_keys=True, default=str).replace('NaN', 'nan')

cfg = LLMConfig(task='board', channel='messages', N=8, B=200, world=dict(life=20))
assert LLMConfig.fromDict(json.loads(json.dumps(cfg.asDict()))) == cfg and cfg.turnsPerAgent() == 25
assert LLMConfig(turns=7).turnsPerAgent() == 7


def fake():
    return LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply))

# rounds and squads (speedup plan Part B): homes in the prompt, home share in the row; rounds decide on a snapshot
c = fake()
rows, log = runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=5, protocol='rounds', window=5.0, squads=2, beta=1.0,
                             world=dict(tStay=5.0)), 3, c)
assert 0 <= rows[0]['homeShare'] <= 1 and rows[0]['calls'] == 4 * 5 + 4
assert all('home range is the locations' in q['system'][0]['text'] for q in c.client.requests)
r0 = runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=5, world=dict(tStay=5.0)), 3, fake())[0][0]
assert 'homeShare' not in r0 and same(r0, runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=5, protocol='rounds', window=0.0, world=dict(tStay=5.0)), 3, fake())[0][0])

# text foraging: N agents x turns calls plus one belief call each; Phase 8 metrics where they apply
c = fake()
rows, log = runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=2, turns=6), 3, c)
r = rows[0]
assert len(rows) == 1 and r['calls'] == 2 * 6 + 2 and len(c.client.requests) == 14 and len(log) == 14
assert r['invalid'] == 0 and r['refusals'] == 0 and 0 < r['reportShare'] < 1 and r['cost'] > 0 and 'cacheHit' not in r
for k in ('welfare', 'welfareHonest', 'rmrt', 'ifdMean', 'discoveries', 'freeRiding', 'diversity', 'beliefError',
          'exploreShare', 'exploreSpread', 'soShare', 'inputTokens', 'outputTokens', 'promptCacheRead', 'tEnd'):
    assert k in r, k
assert r['welfare'] == r['welfareHonest'] and sum(x['kind'] == 'beliefs' for x in log) == 2
assert abs(r['teamWelfare'] - r['welfare'] * 2 * 6) < 1e-9          # team total = per agent-turn x N x turns
assert r['tEnd'] < 40 and 'teamRate_0' not in r                       # shorter than one move period: no complete period
assert same(rows, runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=2, turns=6), 3, fake())[0])      # deterministic

# the task board: solves, wrong answers, duplicate turns; no belief calls
rows, log = runLLM(LLMConfig(task='board', channel='blackboard', N=2, turns=6, difficulty=0), 3, fake())
assert rows[0]['calls'] == 12 and {'solved', 'wrong', 'duplicates', 'soShare'} <= set(rows[0]) and 'rmrt' not in rows[0]
assert abs(rows[0]['teamWelfare'] - rows[0]['welfare'] * 2 * 6) < 1e-9
r30 = runLLM(LLMConfig(task='board', channel='none', N=2, turns=30, difficulty=0), 4, fake())[0][0]
assert [k for k in r30 if k.startswith('teamRate_')] == ['teamRate_0', 'teamRate_1', 'teamRate_2']
assert abs(sum(r30[f'teamRate_{k}'] for k in range(3)) * 10 - r30['teamWelfare']) < 1e-9

# a scripted liar takes slot 0 and makes no calls; honest welfare leaves it out
for task in ('forage', 'board'):
    rows, log = runLLM(LLMConfig(task=task, channel='blackboard', N=3, nLiar=1, turns=4), 5, fake())
    assert rows[0]['calls'] == 2 * 4 + 2 * (task == 'forage') and {x['agent'] for x in log} == {1, 2}

# equal budget: B / N turns per agent
rows, _ = runLLM(LLMConfig(N=4, B=8, channel='none'), 1, fake())
assert rows[0]['calls'] == 8 + 4

# persistence: one row per episode on world seeds 10 000 + 100 s + e; lessons (last notes) carried when asked
c = fake()
rows, log = runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=2, turns=3, episodes=2, lessons=True), 7, c)
assert [r['episode'] for r in rows] == [0, 1] and {x['episode'] for x in log} == {0, 1}
systems = [q['system'][0]['text'] for q in c.client.requests]
assert not any('Lessons' in s for s in systems[:8]) and all('Lessons' in s for s in systems[8:])
w, env, _ = setup(LLMConfig(), 10000 + 700 + 1)
assert env.names == locationNames(64, 10701)

# the run's estimate is checked against what is left before its first live call
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
c = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', budget=Budget(1e-6, tmp / 'spend.jsonl'), client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
try:
    runLLM(LLMConfig(N=2, turns=50), 0, c); raise AssertionError('not refused')
except BudgetExceeded:
    assert len(c.client.requests) == 0

# with a response cache, a rerun sends nothing and gives the same rows
cache = ResponseCache(tmp / 'cache')
c1 = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', cache=cache, client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
r1, l1 = runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='messages', N=3, turns=4), 2, c1)
c2 = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', cache=cache, client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
r2, l2 = runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='messages', N=3, turns=4), 2, c2)
assert len(c2.client.requests) == 0 and c2.hits == c1.calls and c2.calls == 0
assert same(r1, r2) and same(l1, l2)            # rows and turn log do not depend on the cache (AC-9)

# live clients need the opt-in variable and a cap; fake is the default
os.environ.pop('EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE', None)
for spec in (dict(kind='live', cap=1.0), ):
    try:
        makeClient(LLMConfig(), spec); raise AssertionError
    except RuntimeError as e:
        assert 'EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE' in str(e)
assert isinstance(makeClient(LLMConfig()).client, FakeClient)

# a cell: keys, flattened config, turn log written per cell
cell = dict(study='main', factor='main', level='forage', N=2, seed=4, runner='llm', logDir=str(tmp / 'turns'),
            cfg=LLMConfig(channel='hierarchical', N=2, turns=3, world=dict(Tmove=30.0)).asDict())
rows = runLLMCell(cell)
assert rows[0]['study'] == 'main' and rows[0]['world.Tmove'] == 30.0 and rows[0]['budget'] == 'turns'
lines = [json.loads(x) for x in next((tmp / 'turns').glob('*.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(lines) == 2 * 3 + 2 and all(x['key'] == rowKey(rows[0]) for x in lines)
assert {'obs', 'response', 'action', 'valid', 'reward', 'usage', 'cost'} <= set(lines[0]) and 'cached' not in lines[0]

import copy
from types import SimpleNamespace
from explRL.clue_policy import claudePolicy
from explRL.clue_roll import rollout
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig

# AC-5 (Phase 12): group advantages on hand-made returns (seeds x group x N); equal returns give 0
R = np.array([[[1.0, 0.0], [3.0, 0.0]], [[2.0, 5.0], [2.0, 1.0]]])
A = groupAdvantages(R)
assert np.allclose(A[0, :, 0], [-1, 1], atol=1e-5) and np.all(A[0, :, 1] == 0) and np.all(A[1, :, 0] == 0)
assert np.allclose(A[1, :, 1], [1, -1], atol=1e-5)
# the format penalty lowers training returns only, per invalid reply of the slot
ro = SimpleNamespace(returns=np.array([[1.0, 2.0]]), logs=[[[dict(valid=True), dict(valid=False)], [dict(valid=False)] * 3]])
assert np.allclose(trainingReturns(ro, 0.1), [[0.9, 1.7]]) and np.allclose(ro.returns, [[1.0, 2.0]])

# hand-made boards (AC-4): turn records (time, delivered reward, valid), the board's submit log and the credit pending at the end
rec = lambda t, r, valid=True: dict(t=t, reward=r, valid=valid)
bd = lambda pending, submits=(): SimpleNamespace(pending=np.array(pending, float), submits=list(submits))
def ro2(logs, boards, seeds):
    ret = [[sum(x['reward'] for x in recs) + b.pending[i] for i, recs in enumerate(lg)] for lg, b in zip(logs, boards)]
    return SimpleNamespace(logs=logs, boards=boards, seeds=seeds, returns=np.array(ret))
# wrong answers cost wrongPenalty in training returns only (from the submit log: slot 0 twice, slot 1 once; 'late' is free)
subs = [(0.0, 0, 3, 2, 'wrong'), (2.0, 0, 3, 1, 'wrong'), (1.0, 1, 4, None, 'wrong'), (3.0, 1, 4, 1, 'late')]
r = ro2([[[rec(0.0, -0.5), rec(2.0, -0.5, False)], [rec(1.0, -0.5), rec(3.0, 0.0)]]], [bd([0, 0], subs)], [7])
logs0 = copy.deepcopy(r.logs)
assert np.allclose(trainingReturns(r, 0.1, 2.5), [[-1 - 0.1 - 5, -0.5 - 2.5]]) and np.allclose(trainingReturns(r, 0.1), [[-1.1, -0.5]])
assert np.array_equal(trainingReturns(r, 0.1, 0.0), trainingReturns(r, 0.1)) and r.logs == logs0      # turn logs untouched
# per-turn rewards: the wrong answer at its own turn (matched by time), the format penalty at the invalid turn
assert np.allclose(turnRewards(r, 0.1, 2.5)[0][0], [-3.0, -3.1]) and np.allclose(turnRewards(r, 0.1, 2.5)[0][1], [-3.0, 0.0])
assert turnRewards(r, 0.1)[0][1] == [-0.5, 0.0]
# equal groups -> 0 at every turn
same = ro2([[[rec(0, 1.0), rec(1, 0.0)]]] * 3, [bd([0.5])] * 3, [5, 5, 5])
assert turnAdvantages(same, 0.1, 2.5) == [[[0.0, 0.0]]] * 3
# a late credit counts toward the sharing turn's reward-to-go: board 0's slot 0 shares at turn 0 (reward 0) and is credited
# at turn 2 (delivered) or only at the end (pending); the replays where nothing is credited get the opposite advantage
for logs, pend in (([rec(0, 0.0), rec(1, 0.0), rec(2, 1.5)], 0.0), ([rec(0, 0.0), rec(1, 0.0), rec(2, 0.0)], 1.5)):
    t = ro2([[logs], [[rec(0, 0.0), rec(1, 0.0), rec(2, 0.0)]]], [bd([pend]), bd([0.0])], [9, 9])
    G, a = rewardsToGo(t, 0.1), turnAdvantages(t, 0.1)
    assert np.allclose(G[0][0], [1.5, 1.5, 1.5]) and np.allclose(a[0][0], [1, 1, 1], atol=1e-5) and np.allclose(a[1][0], [-1, -1, -1], atol=1e-5)
# per turn, not per board: the same total, earned at different turns, differs only at the turn in between
t = ro2([[[rec(0, 0.0), rec(1, 2.0), rec(2, 0.0)]], [[rec(0, 0.0), rec(1, 0.0), rec(2, 2.0)]]], [bd([0.0])] * 2, [3, 3])
a = turnAdvantages(t, 0.1)
assert a[0][0][:2] == [0.0, 0.0] and np.allclose([a[0][0][2], a[1][0][2]], [-1, 1], atol=1e-5)
assert np.all(groupAdvantages(trainingReturns(t, 0.1).reshape(1, 2, 1)) == 0)     # the board-level advantage sees no difference
# groups are the boards of one seed, whatever their order
t = ro2([[[rec(0, 1.0)]], [[rec(0, 0.0)]], [[rec(0, 3.0)]], [[rec(0, 2.0)]]], [bd([0.0])] * 4, [1, 2, 1, 2])
assert np.allclose([x[0][0] for x in turnAdvantages(t, 0.1)], [-1, -1, 1, 1], atol=1e-5)

# samples: one per text turn of slots with nonzero advantage, with its prompt; zero-advantage slots skipped
cfg = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=3, world=dict(m=2, r=1, R=30))
ro = rollout(cfg, [900, 900], claudePolicy(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply))), keepPrompts=True)
adv = np.zeros((2, 4)); adv[0, 1], adv[1, 3] = 0.5, -1.0
smp = stepSamples(ro, adv)
assert len(smp) == 6 and {x['slot'] for x in smp} == {1, 3} and all(x['blocks'][-1]['text'].startswith('Now:\n') for x in smp)
assert [x['adv'] for x in smp] == [0.5] * 3 + [-1.0] * 3 and all(x['eos'] for x in smp)
# a share of the turns: a seeded, sorted subset of the full set, of the requested size
full = stepSamples(ro, adv)
part = stepSamples(ro, adv, 0.5, np.random.default_rng([0, 7]))
assert len(part) == 3 and all(x in full for x in part) and part == stepSamples(ro, adv, 0.5, np.random.default_rng([0, 7]))
assert stepSamples(ro, adv * 0, 0.25) == [] and len(stepSamples(ro, adv, 0.01)) == 1
# per-turn advantages: a constant list per slot gives the per-slot samples; zero turns are skipped
perTurn = [[[float(adv[b, i])] * len(ro.logs[b][i]) for i in range(4)] for b in range(2)]
assert stepSamples(ro, perTurn) == full and stepSamples(ro, perTurn, 0.5, np.random.default_rng([0, 7])) == part
perTurn[0][1][1] = 0.0
assert [x['adv'] for x in stepSamples(ro, perTurn)] == [0.5, 0.5] + [-1.0] * 3
# on a real rollout: G at the first turn is the training return; the board's wrong answers are the turn logs' wrong submits
rt = trainingReturns(ro, 0.1, 2.5)
assert all(np.isclose(rewardsToGo(ro, 0.1, 2.5)[b][i][0], rt[b, i]) for b in range(2) for i in range(4))
assert sum(len(wrongTimes(b, i)) for b in ro.boards for i in range(4)) == sum(b.counts['wrong'] for b in ro.boards) > 0
ta = turnAdvantages(ro, 0.1, 2.5)
assert [len(x) for x in ta[0]] == [len(x) for x in ro.logs[0]] and all(v == 0 for b in ta for x in b for v in x)  # replays of one board, same replies

Tests

import numpy as np
from collections import deque
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_close
from explRL.harness import Blackboard, MessageBus, Lead
from explRL.harness_agents import CommBandit, LeadFollower, CircuitCommMember
from explRL.harness_runs import benchWorld
from explRL.core import loadCircuitAgent
from explRL.members import CircuitMember
from explRL.multi import runTeam, spawnRngs
from explRL.patchworld import TeamPatchWorld
from explRL.team_agents import banditAgent, CircuitPatchMember
from explRL.circuit import goalStep

def same_ledger(a, b):
    test_eq(len(a), len(b))
    for ra, rb in zip(a, b):
        test_eq(len(ra), len(rb))
        for x, y in zip(ra, rb):
            if isinstance(x, float) and np.isnan(x):
                assert np.isnan(y)
            else:
                test_eq(x, y)

def same_hist(h0, h1):
    test_eq(len(h0.records), len(h1.records))
    for a, b in zip(h0.records, h1.records):
        test_eq((a.t, a.dt, a.location, a.reward), (b.t, b.dt, b.location, b.reward))

for seed in (0, 1, 2):
    for mk in ('none', 'bb', 'msg'):
        w0, w1 = benchWorld(), benchWorld()
        w0.reset(seed, 8); w1.reset(seed, 8)
        ch = None if mk == 'none' else Blackboard(w0.L, n=8) if mk == 'bb' else MessageBus(8, rngs=spawnRngs(seed + 2000, 8))
        m0 = [banditAgent() for _ in range(8)]
        m1 = [CommBandit(ch, w=0.0) for _ in range(8)]
        h0 = runTeam(m0, w0, 300.0)
        h1 = runTeam(m1, w1, 300.0)
        same_ledger(w0.ledger, w1.ledger)
        same_hist(h0, h1)
        if ch is not None:   # w = 0 members still share (FR-7), so the bridge also shows sharing changes nothing
            assert sum(s['written'] + s['sent'] for s in ch.stats.values()) > 0

# AC-4: messages on (w = 1) leave the world's draws alone: the same patch sites as with no channel
sites = []
for ch in (None, MessageBus(8, rngs=spawnRngs(2000, 8))):
    wm = benchWorld(); wm.reset(0, 8)
    runTeam([CommBandit(ch) for _ in range(8)], wm, 300.0)
    sites.append(list(wm.site))
test_eq(sites[0], sites[1])

# AC-4: message carries sender's own best stay mean
w = benchWorld(); w.reset(0, 2)
bus = MessageBus(2, k=1, period=5.0, radius=np.inf, rngs=spawnRngs(11, 2))
cb = CommBandit(bus, w=1.0)
cb.id = 0
cb.rates = [deque([3.0]), deque([1.0])]
cb._world, cb._t = w, 0.0
bus.window[0] = -1
cb.learn({'location': 0}, 0, 3.0, {'kind': 'stay', 'dur': 1.0})
got = bus.take(1)
test_eq(len(got), 1)
test_close(got[0][2], 3.0)

# AC-6
bb6 = Blackboard(2, n=2, lam=0.0)
cb6 = CommBandit(bb6, w=0.5, K=3)
cb6.rates = [deque([2.0]), deque()]
cb6.reports = [deque(), deque([4.0])]
cb6._world, cb6._t, cb6.id = benchWorld(), 0.0, 0
bb6.write(1, 1, 6.0, 0.0)
mean, n = cb6._stats({'travel': np.ones(2)})
test_close(mean[1], 5.0)
test_close(n[1], 1.0)
test_eq(cb6.act({'travel': np.array([1., 1.]), 'location': 0}), 1)
# a location known only from reports counts as visited (else the nearest unvisited, 1, would be chosen)
cbV = CommBandit(MessageBus(1, rngs=spawnRngs(0, 1)), w=1.0); cbV.id, cbV._world = 0, benchWorld()
cbV.rates = [deque([2.0]), deque(), deque()]
cbV.reports = [deque(), deque([1.0]), deque()]
test_eq(cbV.act({'travel': np.array([0., 1., 5.]), 'location': 0}), 2)
# K limits own stays and stored reports separately
cbK = CommBandit(MessageBus(2, rngs=spawnRngs(0, 2)), w=1.0, K=2); cbK.id, cbK._world = 0, benchWorld()
cbK.rates = [deque(maxlen=2) for _ in range(cbK._world.L)]
for v in (1.0, 2.0, 3.0):
    cbK.rates[0].append(v); cbK._store()[0].append(10 * v)
mK, nK = cbK._stats(None)
test_eq(float(nK[0]), 4.0); test_close(mK[0], (2 + 3 + 20 + 30) / 4)

w = benchWorld(); w.reset(1, 2)
lead = Lead(w.L, 2, lam=0.0)
followers = [LeadFollower(lead) for _ in range(2)]
hL = runTeam(followers, w, 50.0)
# followers go where the lead assigns and report every stay
assert all(r.location == r.extras[0] for r in hL.records)
for i in range(2):
    test_eq(lead.assigned[i], hL.forAgent(i)[-1].extras[0])
test_eq(sum(lead.stats[i]['written'] for i in range(2)), sum(r[3] == 'stay' for r in w.ledger))

CIRC_N = len(CircuitMember.extraNames)
for symmetric in (True, False):
    for seed in (0, 1, 2):
        world = TeamPatchWorld.zoneConfig(symmetric=symmetric)
        world.reset(seed, 1)
        h0 = runTeam([CircuitPatchMember(loadCircuitAgent(seed=seed))], world, 300.0)
        world.reset(seed, 1)
        h1 = runTeam([CircuitCommMember(loadCircuitAgent(seed=seed))], world, 300.0)
        same_hist(h0, h1)
        world.reset(seed, 1)
        h2 = runTeam([CircuitCommMember(loadCircuitAgent(seed=seed), Blackboard(world.L, n=1), w=0)], world, 300.0)
        same_hist(h0, h2)

# AC-7
ag = loadCircuitAgent(seed=0)
bb7 = Blackboard(32, n=2, lam=0.0)
mem = CircuitCommMember(ag, bb7, w=2); mem.id = 0
p = ag.params
j = 3
bb7.write(1, j, 1.0, 0.0)
wG0 = ag.policy.wG.copy()
cRep = (ag.c + j - ag.a) % p.nCirc
wGexp = wG0.copy()
for _ in range(2):
