title: demo_prestructured
text:
Simulated runs
Three conditions: fixed goal with jumps (Fig 2h), goal learning without jumps, and goal learning with jumps. The quick cell keeps normal tests fast; the slow cell reruns with 20 runs.

runs_fix = runManyPrestructured(params, goal, nRuns, seed=seed, learn=False, thetaG0=goal)
runs_learn = runManyPrestructured(noJumps, goal, nRuns, seed=seed, learn=True)
runs_jump = runManyPrestructured(params, goal, nRuns, seed=seed, learn=True)


artifact_mode, nRuns = 'full', 20
runs_fix = runManyPrestructured(params, goal, nRuns, seed=seed, learn=False, thetaG0=goal)
runs_learn = runManyPrestructured(noJumps, goal, nRuns, seed=seed, learn=True)
runs_jump = runManyPrestructured(params, goal, nRuns, seed=seed, learn=True)


def pooled(runs):
    "Fixation durations and relative headings (degrees) of all events of all runs."
    fix = np.concatenate([r['history'].fixDur for r in runs])
    rel = np.concatenate([relHeading(r['history'].thetaA, goal) for r in runs])
    return fix, rel

def distGoal(g): return np.abs(angdiff(g, goal))
def distNearer(g): return np.minimum(distGoal(g), np.abs(angdiff(g, goal + pi)))

grid = np.arange(0, params.Ttot, 1.0)
lastQ = grid >= 0.75 * params.Ttot

def distTrace(r, dist):
    "Distance of the goal heading in effect at each grid time (1 s steps)."
    return dist(heldGoal(r['history'], r['thetaG0'], grid, params.tS))

def startAndLastQuarter(runs, dist):
    "Distance at the start and time-averaged over the last quarter of the run, averaged over runs."
    start = np.mean([dist(r['thetaG0']) for r in runs])
    last = np.mean([distTrace(r, dist)[lastQ].mean() for r in runs])
    return float(start), float(last)

fix, rel = pooled(runs_fix)
near = float(fix[np.abs(rel) <= 30].mean())
anti = float(fix[np.abs(rel) >= 150].mean())
side = float(fix[(np.abs(rel) >= 60) & (np.abs(rel) <= 120)].mean())
ac9 = startAndLastQuarter(runs_learn, distGoal)
ac10 = startAndLastQuarter(runs_jump, distNearer)
print(f'fixation goal {near:.2f} s, anti-goal {anti:.2f} s, side {side:.2f} s')
print(f'no jumps |thetaG - goal|: {ac9[0]:.2f} -> {ac9[1]:.2f} rad; jumps, nearer goal: {ac10[0]:.2f} -> {ac10[1]:.2f} rad')

Simulated readout of the fixed-goal runs, with the Eq. 23 curve for comparison. The anti-goal peak is higher than Eq. 23 predicts because the compass offset persists between jumps (spec design D4).

ro = [r['readout'] for r in runs_fix]
centers = ro[0]['centers']
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 2.5))
ev = effectivePolicy(th, goal, params)
for ax, key, title in zip(axes, ['fixDur', 'turnBias'], ['mean fixation duration (s)', 'turn bias (+ = CW)']):
    ax.plot(centers, np.nanmean([r[key] for r in ro], 0), 'o-', label='simulated')
    ax.plot(deg, ev[key], 'k--', alpha=0.5, label='Eq. 23')
    ax.set_xlabel('arena - goal (deg)'); ax.set_title(title); ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
save_demo_figure('fig2h_simulated', fig=fig, mode=artifact_mode, demo_name=DN)
plt.show()

title: demo_prestructured
text:
Summary
With the paper’s Table 1 setpoint parameters, the decided signs (spec Q1, Q2) and no tuning, 20 runs of 240 s (seeds 0-19) gave:

AC-8: mean fixation 11.5 s within ±30 degrees of the goal and 10.6 s within ±30 degrees of the anti-goal, versus 2.5 s at 60-120 degrees from the goal: the readout is bimodal, as in Fig 2h.
AC-9: without jumps, the distance from the goal heading to the reward goal fell from 1.67 rad at the start to 0.51 rad (time average over the last quarter).
AC-10 (reported only): with jumps, the distance to the nearer of goal / anti-goal went from 0.84 to 0.74 rad, so no clear convergence.

The simulated anti-goal peak is much higher than Eq. 23 predicts (3.2 s), because the compass offset persists between jumps. All three conditions run in about a second.

title: llm_client
llm_client
text:
Tests

import json, os, re, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from explRL.llm_client import *
from explRL.llm_client import requestKey
from explRL.llm_budget import *
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient

schema = {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'action': {'type': 'string'}}, 'required': ['action'], 'additionalProperties': False}
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
i0, r0, o0 = TOKEN_PROFILE[('claude-haiku-5-5', 'forage')]
fake = FakeClient([dict(text='{"action": "stay"}', usage=dict(input_tokens=i0, cache_read_input_tokens=r0, output_tokens=o0))])
c = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', cache=ResponseCache(tmp / 'cache'), budget=Budget(1.0, tmp / 'spend.jsonl'), client=fake)
blocks = [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'turn 1'}]
r1 = c.complete('rules', blocks, schema)
assert r1.parsed == {'action': 'stay'} and not r1.cached and c.calls == 1
assert abs(r1.cost - estimateCost('claude-haiku-5-5', 'forage', 1, 1)) < 1e-12   # the profile prices like usage
# a cache hit replays the reply, makes no request and charges nothing
r2 = c.complete('rules', blocks, schema)
assert r2.cached and r2.parsed == r1.parsed and r2.cost == r1.cost and len(fake.requests) == 1 and c.hits == 1
assert abs(c.budget.spent() - r1.cost) < 1e-12
# the request: no sampling parameters, cached system prompt, schema and effort in output_config
req = fake.requests[0]
assert set(req) == {'model', 'max_tokens', 'system', 'messages', 'output_config'}
assert req['system'][0]['cache_control'] == {'type': 'ephemeral'} and req['output_config']['effort'] == 'low'
assert req['output_config']['format'] == {'type': 'json_schema', 'schema': schema}
# first writer wins: a later reply for the same key is not stored, and the stored one is returned
rc = ResponseCache(tmp / 'race')
assert rc.put('ab12', {'x': 1}) == {'x': 1} and rc.put('ab12', {'x': 2}) == {'x': 1} and rc.get('ab12') == {'x': 1}
assert not list((tmp / 'race').rglob('*.tmp'))
# a concurrent identical request that stored its reply first: this call returns that reply but is charged its own cost
rc2, led = ResponseCache(tmp / 'race2'), Budget(10.0, tmp / 'race2.jsonl')
def racer(req):
    rc2.put(requestKey(req), dict(text='{"action": "go"}', parsed={'action': 'go'}, stopReason='end_turn', refusal=None,
                                  usage={}, cost=9.0))
    return dict(text='{"action": "stay"}', usage=dict(input_tokens=1000, output_tokens=0))
r = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', cache=rc2, budget=led, client=FakeClient(racer)).complete('s', blocks, schema)
assert r.parsed == {'action': 'go'} and abs(led.spent() - 1000 * 0.10 / 1e6) < 1e-12
# a different request misses the cache
c.complete('rules', [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'turn 2'}], schema)
assert len(fake.requests) == 2

# refusal and max_tokens stops give no parsed action
for stop, ref in [('refusal', 'cyber'), ('max_tokens', None)]:
    fc = FakeClient([dict(text='{"action": "go"', stop=stop, refusal=ref)])
    r = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=fc).complete('s', blocks, schema)
    assert r.parsed is None and r.stopReason == stop and r.refusal == ref
assert LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(['not json'])).complete('s', blocks, schema).parsed is None

# the cap: a request is refused once the recorded spend reaches it
b = Budget(0.001, tmp / 'cap.jsonl')
cc = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', budget=b, client=FakeClient([dict(text='{}', usage=dict(input_tokens=10000))]))
cc.complete('s', blocks, schema)                    # $0.001: reaches the cap exactly
try:
    cc.complete('s', [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'x'}], schema); raise AssertionError('cap not enforced')
except BudgetExceeded:
    pass
assert len(cc.client.requests) == 1
try:
    Budget(1.0, tmp / 'est.jsonl').check(need=2.0); raise AssertionError
except BudgetExceeded:
    pass
# a run whose estimate exceeds what is left is refused at its first live call, but a cached rerun is served
c.reserve(5.0)
assert c.complete('rules', blocks, schema).cached
try:
    c.complete('rules', [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'new'}], schema); raise AssertionError('estimate not checked')
except BudgetExceeded:
    pass
c.reserve(0.01)
c.complete('rules', [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'new'}], schema)
assert c.pending == 0.0

# costs and estimates
assert costOf(dict(input_tokens=10**6), PRICES['claude-sonnet-5-5']) == 2.0
assert abs(estimateCost('claude-haiku-5-5', 'board', 4, 50, profile={('claude-haiku-5-5', 'board'): (1000, 2000, 300)})
           - 4 * 50 * (1000 * .10 + 2000 * .01 + 300 * .50) / 1e6) < 1e-12
assert requestKey(dict(a=1, b=2)) == requestKey(dict(b=2, a=1))

# secrets: nothing key-like is ever written to the cache or the ledger
written = ''.join(p.read_text() for p in tmp.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
assert not re.search(r'sk-ant-|api[_-]?key|x-api-key|authorization', written, re.I)

# the env-file loader: sets missing, non-empty variables only, and reports names, not values
env = tmp / '.env.local'
env.write_text('# comment\nexport EXPLRL_T1="abc"\nEXPLRL_T2=\nEXPLRL_T3=xyz\nnot a line\n')
os.environ['EXPLRL_T3'] = 'kept'
assert loadEnvFile(env) == ['EXPLRL_T1'] and os.environ['EXPLRL_T1'] == 'abc' and os.environ['EXPLRL_T3'] == 'kept'
assert 'EXPLRL_T2' not in os.environ and loadEnvFile(tmp / 'missing') == []
for k in ('EXPLRL_T1', 'EXPLRL_T3'):
    del os.environ[k]

# the package imports and runs offline without the SDK
import subprocess, sys
code = ("import sys; sys.modules['anthropic'] = None\n"
        "import explRL, explRL.llm_client as m, explRL.llm_fake as f\n"
        "m.LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=f.FakeClient(['{}'])).complete('s', [], {})\n"
        "try:\n    m.LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5'); raise SystemExit('imported')\nexcept ImportError: print('ok')")
out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', code], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert out.stdout.strip() == 'ok', out.stderr

# the floor keeps money unspent: a call is refused when less than the floor would be left
fb = Budget(1.0, tmp / 'floor.jsonl'); fb.add(0.5)
try:
    LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', budget=fb, client=FakeClient(['{}']), floor=0.6).complete('s', blocks, schema); raise AssertionError
except BudgetExceeded:
    pass
assert LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', budget=fb, client=FakeClient(['{}']), floor=0.4).complete('s', blocks, schema).parsed == {}
# timing records: one per call, live and cached, with the run's tag and the task; no prompt text
tl, tc = [], ResponseCache(tmp / 'timing')
ct = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', cache=tc, client=FakeClient(['{"a": 1}']), timing=tl); ct.tag = 'main|x|001'
ct.complete('s', blocks, schema, task='board'); ct.complete('s', blocks, schema, task='board')
assert [(r['key'], r['task'], r['cached'], r['retries']) for r in tl] == [('main|x|001', 'board', False, 0), ('main|x|001', 'board', True, 0)]
assert set(tl[0]) == {'key', 'model', 'task', 'seconds', 'retries', 'cached'} and tl[0]['seconds'] >= 0
# retries: the SDK's retry log messages are counted for the calling thread
import logging
RETRIES.install(); RETRIES.take()
logging.getLogger('anthropic._base_client').info('Retrying request to /v1/messages in %f seconds', 0.5)
logging.getLogger('anthropic._base_client').info('Sending HTTP Request')
assert RETRIES.take() == 1 and RETRIES.take() == 0

import json
import numpy as np
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_close

from explRL.harness import Blackboard, MessageBus
from explRL.harness_agents import CommBandit
from explRL.harness_runs import benchWorld

# one trust update matches the formula; a sender whose reports are always wrong loses weight
w = benchWorld(); w.reset(0, 3)
bb = Blackboard(w.L, n=3)
bb.write(1, 0, 0.5, 0.0); bb.write(2, 0, -2.6, 0.0)
db = DefendedBandit(bb, 'trust'); db.id, db._world, db._t = 0, w, 1.0; db._setup(w)
db._check(0, 0.85)
test_close(db.tau[1], 0.9 + 0.1 * np.exp(-0.35 / 0.5)); test_close(db.tau[2], 0.9 + 0.1 * np.exp(-3.45 / 0.5))
for k in range(30): db._t = 2.0 + k; db._check(0, 0.85)
assert db.tau[2] < 0.1 < 0.5 < db.tau[1]

# sanctions: strikes within 120 s raise the level (warning, half weight, revoked); the channel then drops the
# sender's writes; once the strikes leave the window the sender is reinstated
mon = Monitor(3, sanctions=True, theta=1.0, channel=bb)
mon.record(1, 2.0, 0.0); test_eq(mon.level(1, 0.0), 1); test_close(mon.weights(0.0)[1], mon.rho[1])
mon.record(1, 2.0, 10.0); test_close(mon.weights(10.0)[1], 0.5 * mon.rho[1])
mon.record(1, 0.2, 15.0); test_eq(mon.level(1, 15.0), 2)                 # a good check is not a strike
mon.record(1, 2.0, 20.0); test_eq(mon.level(1, 20.0), 3); test_eq(bb.blocked, {1}); test_eq(mon.weights(20.0)[1], 0.0)
bb.write(1, 3, 1.0, 21.0); test_eq(bb.stats[1]['rejected'], 1)
test_eq(mon.firstRevoke[1], 20.0); test_eq(int(mon.maxLevel[1]), 3)
mon.weights(141.0); test_eq(bb.blocked, set()); test_eq(mon.level(1, 141.0), 0)  # all strikes older than 120 s
assert np.isnan(mon.firstRevoke[0])
rep = Monitor(3); rep.record(2, 3.0, 0.0); test_close(rep.weights(0.0)[2], 0.9 + 0.1 * np.exp(-6.0))

# with 'none' and q = 0 a DefendedBandit chooses exactly as CommBandit (blackboard and messages), and still logs
for kind in ('blackboard', 'messages'):
    hs, logs = [], []
    for cls in (CommBandit, DefendedBandit):
        wr = benchWorld(); wr.reset(4, 8)
        ch = Blackboard(wr.L, n=8) if kind == 'blackboard' else MessageBus(8, rngs=spawnRngs(2004, 8))
        team = [cls(ch) for _ in range(8)]
        hs.append(runTeam(team, wr, 200.0).records)
        logs.append(sum(len(getattr(m, 'reportLog', [])) for m in team))
    test_eq(hs[0], hs[1]); assert logs[1] > 0
    assert DefendedBandit(None).whiteScore() != DefendedBandit(None).whiteScore()   # nan: never reported

# honest reports sit close to own beliefs (white-box score), deliberate checks happen at most at rate q and cost time
wr = benchWorld(); wr.reset(5, 8)
ch = Blackboard(wr.L, n=8); mon = Monitor(8, sanctions=True, channel=ch)
team = [DefendedBandit(ch, 'sanctions', mon, q=0.2, rng=r) for r in spawnRngs(3005, 8)]
h = runTeam(team, wr, 300.0)
draws = sum(1 for r in h.records)                                          # upper bound on decisions
d = sum(m.deliberate for m in team); assert 0 < d < 0.2 * draws
assert sum(m.checkSeconds for m in team) > 0 and sum(m.checks for m in team) > 0
assert max(m.whiteScore() for m in team) < 1.5

import math
import numpy as np
from explRL.fix_stats import *

# gap closed against a fixed ceiling: a constant paired difference of 0.3 over a baseline mean of 0.4 closes half the gap
base = {s: 0.4 + 0.02 * (s % 3 - 1) for s in range(10)}
g = gapClosed({s: v + 0.3 for s, v in base.items()}, base, 1.0)
assert abs(g['gap'] - 0.3 / (1 - np.mean(list(base.values())))) < 1e-12 and g['n'] == 10 and g['ceiling'] == 1.0
assert g['ci'][0] <= g['gap'] <= g['ci'][1] and abs(g['diff']['mean'] - 0.3) < 1e-12 and g['p'] < 0.01
# per-unit ceiling (the solo agent on the same episodes), only units all three have; a null arm closes nothing
solo = {s: 0.9 for s in range(8)}
g = gapClosed(base, base, solo)
assert g['gap'] == 0 and g['n'] == 8 and g['p'] == 1.0 and abs(g['ceiling'] - 0.9) < 1e-12
# win rates: baseline wins 2 of 10, the arm 4 of 10 (same episodes), the solo agent 9 of 10 -> 2/7 of the gap
b = {s: float(s < 2) for s in range(10)}
a = {s: float(s < 4) for s in range(10)}
c = {s: float(s < 9) for s in range(10)}
assert abs(gapClosed(a, b, c)['gap'] - 0.2 / 0.7) < 1e-12
# loss recovered: arm loss 0.1 against baseline 0.4 -> 0.75; an equal loss -> 0; no units -> nan
L = lossRecovered({s: 0.1 for s in range(5)}, {s: 0.4 + 0.01 * s for s in range(6)})
assert abs(L['gap'] - (1 - 0.1 / 0.42)) < 1e-12 and L['n'] == 5 and L['diff']['mean'] > 0 and L['ceiling'] == 0.0
assert lossRecovered({1: 0.3}, {1: 0.3})['gap'] == 0 and math.isnan(lossRecovered({}, {1: 1.0})['gap'])
assert all(math.isnan(x) for x in lossRecovered({}, {})['ci'])
# Holm within a family; controls keep nan
items = dict(x=dict(p=0.01), y=dict(p=0.04), z=dict(p=0.001))
holmFamily(items, ['x', 'y'])
assert items['x']['pHolm'] == 0.02 and items['y']['pHolm'] == 0.04 and items['x']['primary']
assert math.isnan(items['z']['pHolm']) and not items['z']['primary']
# the bootstrap is seeded (identical reruns)
assert bootStat(lambda i: float(np.mean(i)), 5) == bootStat(lambda i: float(np.mean(i)), 5)

import numpy as np


from pathlib import Path
import json, tempfile
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_close
from explRL.core import loadCircuitAgent
from explRL.envs import ZoneArena
from explRL.members import CircuitMember
from explRL.multi import runTeam, TeamEnv, spawnRngs
from explRL.patchworld import TeamPatchWorld, ringLayout

# AC-1 sanity bridge
CIRC_N = len(CircuitMember.extraNames)
for symmetric in (True, False):
    for seed in (0, 1, 2):
        env = ZoneArena(symmetric=symmetric)
        world = TeamPatchWorld.zoneConfig(symmetric=symmetric)
        world.reset(seed, 1)
        h0 = runTeam([CircuitMember(loadCircuitAgent(seed=seed))], env, 300.0)
        world.reset(seed, 1)
        h1 = runTeam([CircuitPatchMember(loadCircuitAgent(seed=seed))], world, 300.0)
        test_eq(len(h0.records), len(h1.records))
        for a, b in zip(h0.records, h1.records):
            test_eq((a.t, a.dt, a.location, a.reward), (b.t, b.dt, b.location, b.reward))
            test_eq(a.extras[:CIRC_N], b.extras[:CIRC_N])

# AC-2 (golden fixtures after the reward hook and apply(..., t)) runs in the train, prestructured_train and
# circuit_train notebooks.

# AC-8 agents
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
ra = randomAgent(rng)
obs = {'travel': np.ones(8)}
counts = np.zeros(8)
for _ in range(10_000):
    counts[ra.act(obs)] += 1
expected = 10_000 / 8
se = np.sqrt(expected * (1 - 1/8))
assert np.all(np.abs(counts - expected) <= 3 * se)

ba = banditAgent(K=3, cUCB=0.2, H=10.0)
obs0 = {'travel': np.arange(8, dtype=float) + 1., 'location': 0}
visited = []
for _ in range(8):
    j = ba.act(obs0)
    visited.append(j)
    ba.learn({'location': j}, j, 1.0, {'kind': 'stay', 'dur': 1.0})
test_eq(visited, list(range(8)))                       # unvisited first, nearest first
obs_tie = {'travel': np.array([0., 1., 1., 1.]), 'location': 0}
test_eq(banditAgent().act(obs_tie), 0)
b = banditAgent()
b.act(obs_tie); b.learn({'location': 0}, 0, 1.0, {'kind': 'stay', 'dur': 1.0})
test_eq(b.act(obs_tie), 1)                             # equal travel times: lower index

ring8 = TeamPatchWorld(ringLayout(8), nPatches=1, nDanger=0, model='fixed', intake=(1.0,),
                       patchSites=[3], dangerSites=[], Tmove=None, tStay=1.0, c=1.0)
ring8.reset(0, 1)
agent = banditAgent(cUCB=0.2, H=10.0)
team = runTeam([agent], ring8, 600.0)
stays = [r for r in team.records if r.kind == 'stay' and r.t >= 450]
share = sum(1 for r in stays if r.location == 3) / max(len(stays), 1)
assert share > 0.8

baK = banditAgent(K=2)
for _ in range(5):
    baK.act({'travel': np.array([1., 1.]), 'location': 0})
    baK.learn({'location': 0}, 0, 1.0, {'kind': 'stay', 'dur': 1.0})
    baK.learn({'location': 0}, 0, 2.0, {'kind': 'stay', 'dur': 1.0})
    baK.learn({'location': 0}, 0, 3.0, {'kind': 'stay', 'dur': 1.0})
test_eq(len(baK.rates[0]), 2)

# AC-10 determinism, JSONL, TeamEnv replay
def patch_world():
    "Ring of 16, sites drawn by the seed, moving patches, noisy harvest: every world generator is used."
    return TeamPatchWorld(ringLayout(16), nPatches=2, nDanger=2, intake=(2.0, 2.0), Tmove=10.0, noise=0.2)

def run_patch_team(seed=0, n=2):
    "Mixed team: random agents (even index) and bandits (odd index)."
    w = patch_world()
    rngs = spawnRngs(seed + 1000, n)
    ms = [randomAgent(r) if i % 2 == 0 else banditAgent() for i, r in enumerate(rngs)]
    w.reset(seed, n)
    hist = runTeam(ms, w, 30.0)
    return w, hist, ms

def same_ledger(a, b):
    test_eq(len(a), len(b))
    for ra, rb in zip(a, b):
        test_eq(len(ra), len(rb))
        for x, y in zip(ra, rb):
            if isinstance(x, float) and np.isnan(x):
                assert np.isnan(y)
            else:
                test_eq(x, y)

w1, h1, _ = run_patch_team(42, 4)
w2, h2, _ = run_patch_team(42, 4)
same_ledger(w1.ledger, w2.ledger)
test_eq(h1.records, h2.records)
w3, _, _ = run_patch_team(42, 6)                       # more agents: same patch sites (separate generators)
test_eq(w3.site.tolist(), w1.site.tolist())

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = h1.toJSONL(Path(d) / 't.jsonl')
    row = json.loads(p.read_text().splitlines()[0])
    test_eq(set(row['extras']), set(PatchMember.extraNames))

w, hist, ms = run_patch_team(7, 4)
actions = [r.extras[0] for r in hist.records]
w2 = patch_world()
env = TeamEnv(w2, 4, 30.0)
env.reset(7)
ai = 0
while (i := env.next_agent()) is not None:
    env.step(int(actions[ai]))
    ai += 1
same_ledger(w2.ledger, w.ledger)

import json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from explRL.clue_train import *
from explRL.clue_runs import runClue
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig

S = dict(m=3, r=1, R=105)
def rollout(seed, N=4, batch=2, turns=12, channel='blackboard', scheme='individual'):
    ep = ClueEpisodes(batch, N, S, scheme=scheme, turns=turns, seed=seed, channel=channel)
    nxt, total = ep.reset(), []
    while any(x is not None for x in nxt):
        replies = [teacherAction(ep.boards[b], x[0], ep.channels[b]) if x is not None else None for b, x in enumerate(nxt)]
        nxt, rew, done = ep.step(replies)
        total.append(rew)
    return ep, total
# deterministic per seed; every agent makes its turns; done flags at the end
e1, r1 = rollout(3); e2, r2 = rollout(3)
assert r1 == r2 and all(sum(d) == 4 * 12 for d in e1.done)
assert all(isinstance(x[0], int) for step in r1 for x in step if x)
# the teacher solves every subtask it holds all clues for (one agent holds all), never answering wrong
solo, _ = rollout(5, N=1, batch=3, turns=30, channel='none')
for bd in solo.boards:
    assert bd.counts['solved'] >= bd.counts['opens'] - 1 and bd.counts['wrong'] == 0 and bd.counts['solved'] > 0
# with a channel the teacher shares, and a team solves assisted subtasks
team, _ = rollout(7, N=4, batch=2, turns=30)
assert all(bd.counts['shares'] > 0 for bd in team.boards) and any(a for bd in team.boards for *_, a in bd.solveLog)
# reward schemes: same team total delivered plus pending
tot = {}
for sc in ('individual', 'team', 'credit'):
    ep, rw = rollout(9, scheme=sc)
    tot[sc] = sum(r for step in rw for x in step if x for r in [x[1]]) + sum(bd.pending.sum() for bd in ep.boards)
assert abs(tot['individual'] - tot['team']) < 1e-9 and abs(tot['individual'] - tot['credit']) < 1e-9
# exports from a run's turn log round-trip, in both formats
rows, log = runClue(LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=3, turns=4, world=S), 900, LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply)))
log = [dict(key='k1', **x) for x in log]
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
steps = readTrajectories(exportTrajectories(log, tmp / 'steps.jsonl'))
assert len(steps) == 12 and sum(s['done'] for s in steps) == 3 and steps[0]['obs'] == log[0]['obs'] and steps[0]['action'] == log[0]['response']
chat = readTrajectories(exportTrajectories(log, tmp / 'chat.jsonl', 'chat', system='rules'))
assert [m['role'] for m in chat[0]['messages']] == ['system', 'user', 'assistant'] and chat[0]['messages'][0]['content'] == 'rules'
assert readTrajectories(tmp / 'chat.jsonl') == chat

import hashlib
import json
from explRL.clue_fix import *
from explRL.clue_agents import ClueBoard, known
from explRL.clue_runs import runClue
from explRL.clue_text import CLUE_SCHEMA, HINTS, TextClueEnv
from explRL.clueboard import ClueBoardEnv
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig

# defaults unchanged (AC-2, NFR-1): rules, schema, observations, rows and turn logs hash as before Phase 13
H = lambda s: hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
fake = lambda: LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
got = [H(TextClueEnv(ClueBoardEnv(0, 4)).rules()), H(TextClueEnv(ClueBoardEnv(1, 8, m=2, R=30), hint='follow').rules()),
       H(json.dumps(CLUE_SCHEMA, sort_keys=True))]
for ch, nLiar in (('blackboard', 1), ('messages', 0), ('hierarchical', 0)):
    cfg = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel=ch, N=4, turns=10, nLiar=nLiar, memory='full', world=dict(m=2, r=1, R=30))
    got.append(H(json.dumps(runClue(cfg, 900, fake()), sort_keys=True, default=str)))
assert got == ['0d71b754be52dbba', '78a7b077e3f81a06', 'ce192d3fc3c7e717', 'f35507dc0199d7e3', 'a0e448242d25f405',
               'b131cbde560b9608'], got
off = dict(ask=False, table=False, record=False, check=False)
b0 = ClueBoardEnv(0, 4)
assert TextClueEnv(b0).SCHEMA is CLUE_SCHEMA and TextClueEnv(b0, **off).SCHEMA is CLUE_SCHEMA
assert TextClueEnv(b0, table=True, record=True).SCHEMA is CLUE_SCHEMA and TextClueEnv(b0, **off).rules() == TextClueEnv(b0).rules()
assert fixOptions(dict(m=2, hint='follow')) == {} and fixOptions(dict(ask=True, R=30)) == dict(ask=True)
# the schema gains 'ask' and 'check' only with their options; CLUE_SCHEMA itself never changes
enum = lambda e: e.SCHEMA['properties']['action']['enum']
assert enum(TextClueEnv(b0, ask=True)) == ['open', 'submit', 'share', 'wait', 'ask']
assert enum(TextClueEnv(b0, check=True)) == ['open', 'submit', 'share', 'wait', 'check']
assert enum(TextClueEnv(b0, ask=True, check=True)) == ['open', 'submit', 'share', 'wait', 'ask', 'check']
assert CLUE_SCHEMA['properties']['action']['enum'] == ['open', 'submit', 'share', 'wait']
# rules: each option adds its sentence after the channel paragraph; ask and check join the reply format; the hints
base = TextClueEnv(b0).rules()
for k in FIX:
    r = TextClueEnv(b0, **{k: True}).rules()
    assert FIX_RULES[k] in r and r.index(FIX_RULES[k]) > r.index('did not see it.') and r.replace(FIX_RULES[k] + '\n\n', '').split(
        'Reply with JSON')[0] == base.split('Reply with JSON')[0], k
r = TextClueEnv(b0, ask=True, check=True).rules()
assert "action is 'open', 'submit', 'share', 'wait', 'ask' or 'check'; target is the subtask name for 'open', 'share', 'ask' " \
       "and 'check' (empty otherwise)" in r and "clue is the clue text for 'share' and 'check' (empty" in r
assert "action is 'open', 'submit', 'share', 'wait' or 'ask';" in TextClueEnv(b0, ask=True).rules()
assert TextClueEnv(b0, table=True).rules().split('Reply with JSON')[1] == base.split('Reply with JSON')[1]
for h in ('evidence', 'warn'):
    assert HINTS[h] in TextClueEnv(b0, hint=h).rules() and TextClueEnv(b0, hint=h).rules().replace(HINTS[h] + '\n\n', '') == base
assert HINTS['evidence'].startswith('Before working on your own subtask, post every clue') and 'Cross-check' in HINTS['warn']

P = lambda **kw: dict(dict(action='wait', target='', answer=0, clue='', notes=''), **kw)
def clue(b, k, j):
    p, r = b.tasks[k].task.clue(j)
    return j, p, r
def share(b, cb, i, k, j, r, t):
    "Agent i posts clue j of k with residue r (true or false) on the board and the board logs the share."
    b.apply(i, ('share', (k, j, r)), t); cb.post(i, k, (j, b.tasks[k].task.primes[j], r), t)
def solve(b, i, k, t):
    b.apply(i, ('open', k), t); assert b.apply(i, ('submit', b.tasks[k].task.x), t + 1)[3]['result'] == 'solved'

# ask: valid only for the asker's open subtask (still open); a wait on the board; posted, shown with holder counts; lapses
b, cb = ClueBoardEnv(0, 4, m=3, r=1, R=105, life=100), ClueBoard()
env, plain = TextClueEnv(b, ask=True), TextClueEnv(b)
k, k2 = b.open[0], b.open[1]
A = next(a for a in range(4) if len(b.held(a, k)) < 3)          # the asker lacks a clue of k
V = next(a for a in range(4) if a != A and any(j not in b.held(A, k) for j in b.held(a, k)))   # a viewer holding one
b.apply(A, ('open', k), 0.0)
assert 'Requests: none' in env.observe(A, 1.0, cb) and 'Requests' not in plain.observe(A, 1.0, cb)
assert env.parse(P(action='ask', target=f'T{k2}'), A) == (('wait', None), None, False)          # not its open subtask
assert env.parse(P(action='ask', target=f'T{k}'), V)[2] is False                                # V has nothing open
assert plain.parse(P(action='ask', target=f'T{k}'), A) == (('wait', None), None, False)          # option off: invalid
act, rep, ok = env.parse(P(action='ask', target=f'T{k}'), A)
assert (act, rep, ok) == (('wait', None), ('ask', k), True)
_, _, _, info = b.apply(A, act, 1.0)
assert info['result'] == 'wait' and b.ledger[-1][3] == 'stay' and b.counts == dict(solved=0, wrong=0, late=0, opens=1, shares=0)
assert env.post(A, rep, 1.0, cb, info) and cb.requests(b) == [(k, A, 1.0)]
assert env.summary(A, 1.0, act, 0.0, rep, info) == f'turn 1: asked for clues for T{k}, earned 0.00.'
n = sum(j not in b.held(A, k) for j in b.held(V, k))
assert f'Requests: agent {A} needs clues for T{k} (you hold {n})' in env.observe(V, 2.0, cb)
jv = next(j for j in b.held(V, k) if j not in b.held(A, k))
share(b, cb, V, k, *clue(b, k, jv)[::2], 2.0)                      # once posted, the asker knows it: one fewer
assert f'agent {A} needs clues for T{k} (you hold {n - 1})' in env.observe(V, 3.0, cb)
env.observe(A, 3.0, cb); cb.ask(A, k, 3.0)                         # a new ask replaces the earlier one
assert cb.requests(b) == [(k, A, 3.0)]
B = next(a for a in range(4) if a not in (A, V))
b.apply(B, ('open', k2), 3.0); env.observe(B, 4.0, cb); assert env.parse(P(action='ask', target=f'T{k2}'), B)[2]
cb.ask(B, k2, 4.0)
assert [x[1] for x in cb.requests(b)] == sorted([A, B])
assert f'agent {A} needs clues for T{k} (you hold ' in env.observe(V, 4.0, cb) and f'agent {B} needs clues for T{k2}' in env.observe(V, 4.0, cb)
b.apply(A, ('open', b.open[2]), 4.0); b.apply(A, ('open', k), 5.0)  # A opened another subtask: lapsed (even back on k)
assert cb.requests(b) == [(k2, B, 4.0)]
solve(b, V, k2, 6.0)                                                # k2 closed: lapsed
assert cb.requests(b) == [] and 'Requests: none' in env.observe(V, 8.0, cb)

# table: each distinct clue once per open subtask, without sender or age, instead of one entry per post
b, cb = ClueBoardEnv(0, 4, m=3, r=1, R=105, life=100), ClueBoard()
k, k2 = b.open[0], b.open[1]
(j0, p0, r0), (j1, p1, r1), (j2, p2, r2) = clue(b, k, 0), clue(b, k, 1), clue(b, k2, 2)
share(b, cb, 0, k, j0, r0, 0.0); share(b, cb, 1, k, j0, r0, 1.0); share(b, cb, 2, k, j1, r1, 1.0); share(b, cb, 3, k2, j2, r2, 2.0)
o = TextClueEnv(b, table=True).observe(0, 3.0, cb)
assert 'Clues shared on the board' not in o and 'Known to the team: ' in o
line = next(x for x in o.split('\n') if x.startswith('Known to the team'))
assert f'T{k}: x mod {p0} = {r0}, x mod {p1} = {r1}' in line and f'T{k2}: x mod {p2} = {r2}' in line and 'agent' not in line
assert line.count(f'x mod {p0} = {r0}') == 1
assert TextClueEnv(b, table=True).observe(0, 3.0, ClueBoard()).count('Known to the team: none') == 1

# record: true and false shares of solved subtasks only; 'record none' without any
b, cb = ClueBoardEnv(0, 4, m=3, r=1, R=105, life=100), ClueBoard()
k, k2, k3, k4 = b.open[:4]
_, pf, rf = clue(b, k2, 0)
share(b, cb, 1, k, *clue(b, k, 0)[::2], 0.0)                        # agent 1: a true share of k (solved below)
share(b, cb, 2, k2, 0, (rf + 1) % pf, 0.0)                          # agent 2: a false share of k2 (solved below)
share(b, cb, 2, k4, 0, (clue(b, k4, 0)[2] + 1) % clue(b, k4, 0)[1], 0.0)   # and a false one of k4 (stays open)
share(b, cb, 1, k3, *clue(b, k3, 1)[::2], 1.0)                      # shares still on the board
share(b, cb, 2, k3, *clue(b, k3, 2)[::2], 1.0)
env = TextClueEnv(b, record=True)
assert trackRecord(1, b) == trackRecord(2, b) == (0, 0) and trackRecord(0, b) == (0, 0)
assert f'(agent 1, 2 turns ago, record none)' in env.observe(0, 3.0, cb)
solve(b, 3, k, 3.0); solve(b, 3, k2, 5.0)
assert trackRecord(1, b) == (1, 1) and trackRecord(2, b) == (0, 1)      # k4's false share is not counted yet
o = env.observe(0, 7.0, cb)
assert f'x mod {clue(b, k3, 1)[1]} = {clue(b, k3, 1)[2]} (agent 1, 6 turns ago, record 1/1 true)' in o
assert '(agent 2, 6 turns ago, record 0/1 true)' in o and 'Clues shared on the board: ' in o
assert TextClueEnv(b).observe(0, 7.0, cb).replace(', record 1/1 true', '').replace(', record 0/1 true', '') == o.replace(
    ', record 1/1 true', '').replace(', record 0/1 true', '')

# check: the truth next turn; a false clue leaves the checker's known clues (falling back), a true one is kept; others unchanged
b, cb = ClueBoardEnv(0, 4, m=3, r=1, R=105, life=100), ClueBoard()
k = b.open[0]
j = 0; H0 = min(b.tasks[k].holders[j]); _, p, r = clue(b, k, j)
C, D, L = [a for a in range(4) if a != H0][:3]                       # C checks, D does not; L lies
env = TextClueEnv(b, check=True)
share(b, cb, H0, k, j, r, 0.0)                                       # the true clue first
share(b, cb, L, k, j, (r + 1) % p, 1.0)                              # then a false one, later (overwrites in known)
b.apply(C, ('open', k), 1.0)
o = env.observe(C, 2.0, cb)
assert known(C, b, cb)[k][j] == (r + 1) % p and 'Your check' not in o
assert env.parse(P(action='check', target=f'T{k}', clue=f'x mod {p} = {(r + 2) % p}'), C)[2] is False   # never posted
assert TextClueEnv(b).parse(P(action='check', target=f'T{k}', clue=f'x mod {p} = {(r + 1) % p}'), C)[2] is False
act = env.parse(P(action='check', target=f'T{k}', clue=f'x mod {p} = {(r + 1) % p}'), C)
assert act == (('wait', None), None, True) and env.checked[C] == {(k, j, (r + 1) % p): False}
b.apply(C, act[0], 2.0)
o = env.observe(C, 3.0, cb)
assert f'Your check: T{k} x mod {p} = {(r + 1) % p} (from agent {L}) is false.' in o
assert env._known[C][k][j] == r and f'x mod {p} = {r}' in o.split('Clues you know: ')[1]   # falls back to the true one
assert 'Your check' not in env.observe(C, 4.0, cb)                   # shown once, the turn after the check
assert env.observe(D, 4.0, cb) and env._known[D][k][j] == (r + 1) % p  # D's view is unchanged
assert known(C, b, cb, {(k, j, r): False, (k, j, (r + 1) % p): False})[k].get(j) is None   # both found false: unknown
env.parse(P(action='check', target=f'T{k}', clue=f'x mod {p} = {r}'), C)
assert f'Your check: T{k} x mod {p} = {r} (from agent {H0}) is true.' in env.observe(C, 5.0, cb)
share(b, cb, D, k, j, (r + 2) % p, 5.0)                              # a later post: C keeps the clue it found true
assert env.observe(C, 6.0, cb) and env._known[C][k][j] == r and known(D, b, cb)[k][j] == (r + 2) % p
assert env.summary(C, 4.0, ('wait', None), 0.0, None, dict(result='wait', task=-1)) == f'turn 4: checked T{k}: x mod {p} = {r}, earned 0.00.'


# Phase 14 (AC-2): Phase 13's option values keep their rules, schemas, rows and turn logs (hashed before Phase 14)
import re
def asker(req):
    "fakeReply, but some turns ask for the open subtask's clues or check the first clue on the board."
    o = req['messages'][0]['content'][-1]['text']
    h, op = int(hashlib.sha256(o.encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 4, re.search(r'Your open subtask: T(\d+), open', o)
    seen = re.search(r'(?:the board|the team): T(\d+): (x mod \d+ = -?\d+)', o)
    if h == 1 and op:
        return json.dumps(dict(action='ask', target=f'T{op.group(1)}', answer=0, clue='', notes='a'))
    if h == 2 and seen:
        return json.dumps(dict(action='check', target=f'T{seen.group(1)}', answer=0, clue=seen.group(2), notes='c'))
    return fakeReply(req)
W, out = dict(m=2, r=1, R=30), []
for opt in (dict(ask=True), dict(table=True), dict(record=True), dict(check=True),
            dict(ask=True, table=True, record=True, check=True), dict(record=True, check=True, ask=True)):
    e = TextClueEnv(ClueBoardEnv(900, 4, **W), **opt)
    out.append(H(e.rules()) + H(json.dumps(e.SCHEMA)))
    for N, nLiar in ((4, 0), (4, 1), (8, 0)):
        cfg = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=N, turns=12, nLiar=nLiar, memory='full', world={**W, **opt})
        out.append(H(json.dumps(runClue(cfg, 900, LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(asker))), sort_keys=True, default=str)))
assert H(' '.join(out)) == 'bd460bb72d41b02f', H(' '.join(out))
# the settings: stored as given, no aliases; booleans as Phase 13
assert fixSettings(True, True) == (True, True) and fixSettings('private', 'public') == ('private', 'public')
assert fixSettings(0, 1) == (False, True)
for bad in (('public', False), (False, 'private'), ('yes', True)):
    try:
        TextClueEnv(b0, record=bad[0], check=bad[1]); assert False, bad
    except ValueError:
        pass
# rules and schema: each new setting swaps its option's sentence and nothing else; 'check' joins the actions either way
for k, v, key in (('record', 'private', 'recordPrivate'), ('check', 'public', 'checkPublic')):
    new, old = TextClueEnv(b0, **{k: v}).rules(), TextClueEnv(b0, **{k: True}).rules()
    assert FIX_RULES[key] in new and FIX_RULES[k] not in new and new.replace(FIX_RULES[key], FIX_RULES[k]) == old
assert FIX_RULES['recordPrivate'] == ("Each shared clue shows how many of its sender's earlier shares were true, counted "
                                      "over subtasks you solved yourself.")
assert FIX_RULES['checkPublic'] == ("'check' a clue on the board (target = its subtask, clue = its text): next turn every "
                                    "teammate and you learn whether it is true; checking takes your turn.")
assert enum(TextClueEnv(b0, check='public')) == enum(TextClueEnv(b0, check=True)) == ['open', 'submit', 'share', 'wait', 'check']
assert TextClueEnv(b0, record='private').SCHEMA is CLUE_SCHEMA

# private record: only the shares of subtasks the viewer solved itself count
b, cb = ClueBoardEnv(0, 4, m=3, r=1, R=105, life=100), ClueBoard()
k, k2, k3 = b.open[:3]
_, pf, rf = clue(b, k2, 0)
share(b, cb, 1, k, *clue(b, k, 0)[::2], 0.0)                        # agent 1: a true share of k (agent 3 solves it)
share(b, cb, 2, k2, 0, (rf + 1) % pf, 0.0)                          # agent 2: a false share of k2 (agent 0 solves it)
share(b, cb, 1, k3, *clue(b, k3, 1)[::2], 1.0)                      # shares still on the board
share(b, cb, 2, k3, *clue(b, k3, 2)[::2], 1.0)
solve(b, 3, k, 2.0); solve(b, 0, k2, 4.0)
assert trackRecord(1, b) == (1, 1) and trackRecord(2, b) == (0, 1)                 # public: both solves count
assert trackRecord(1, b, 3) == (1, 1) and trackRecord(1, b, 0) == (0, 0) and trackRecord(1, b, 2) == (0, 0)
assert trackRecord(2, b, 0) == (0, 1) and trackRecord(2, b, 3) == (0, 0)
env, pub = TextClueEnv(b, record='private'), TextClueEnv(b, record=True)
o3, o0, o1 = env.observe(3, 6.0, cb), env.observe(0, 6.0, cb), env.observe(1, 6.0, cb)
assert '(agent 1, 5 turns ago, record 1/1 true)' in o3 and '(agent 2, 5 turns ago, record none)' in o3
assert '(agent 1, 5 turns ago, record none)' in o0 and '(agent 2, 5 turns ago, record 0/1 true)' in o0
assert ', record none)' in o1 and 'true)' not in o1
p3 = pub.observe(3, 6.0, cb)
assert '(agent 1, 5 turns ago, record 1/1 true)' in p3 and '(agent 2, 5 turns ago, record 0/1 true)' in p3
assert re.sub(r', record [^)]*\)', ')', p3) == re.sub(r', record [^)]*\)', ')', o3)    # otherwise the same observation

# public check: the result reaches every teammate's next observation once; every agent's known clues apply it
b, cb = ClueBoardEnv(0, 4, m=3, r=1, R=105, life=100), ClueBoard()
k = b.open[0]
j = 0; H0 = min(b.tasks[k].holders[j]); _, p, r = clue(b, k, j)
C, D, L = [a for a in range(4) if a != H0][:3]
env = TextClueEnv(b, check='public')
share(b, cb, H0, k, j, r, 0.0); share(b, cb, L, k, j, (r + 1) % p, 1.0)
for a in range(4):
    env.observe(a, 2.0, cb)
assert all(env._known[a][k][j] == (r + 1) % p for a in range(4) if j not in b.held(a, k))
act = env.parse(P(action='check', target=f'T{k}', clue=f'x mod {p} = {(r + 1) % p}'), C)
assert act == (('wait', None), None, True) and env.checkedAll == {(k, j, (r + 1) % p): False} and env.checked == {}
b.apply(C, act[0], 2.0)
line = f'Checked by agent {C}: T{k} x mod {p} = {(r + 1) % p} (from agent {L}) is false.'
obs = {a: env.observe(a, 3.0, cb) for a in range(4)}
assert f'Your check: T{k} x mod {p} = {(r + 1) % p} (from agent {L}) is false.' in obs[C] and 'Checked by' not in obs[C]
assert all(line in obs[a] and 'Your check' not in obs[a] for a in range(4) if a != C)
assert all(env._known[a][k][j] == r for a in range(4))                              # everyone drops the false clue
assert all(known(a, b, cb, env.checkedAll)[k][j] == r for a in range(4))
assert not any('Checked by' in env.observe(a, 4.0, cb) for a in range(4))           # shown once
env.parse(P(action='check', target=f'T{k}', clue=f'x mod {p} = {r}'), C)
share(b, cb, L, k, j, (r + 2) % p, 4.0)                                              # a later false post
obs = {a: env.observe(a, 5.0, cb) for a in range(4)}
assert all(f'Checked by agent {C}: T{k} x mod {p} = {r} (from agent {H0}) is true.' in obs[a] for a in range(4) if a != C)
assert all(env._known[a][k][j] == r for a in range(4))                              # everyone keeps the true clue
priv = TextClueEnv(b, check=True)                                                    # Phase 13: only the checker
priv.observe(C, 5.0, cb); priv.parse(P(action='check', target=f'T{k}', clue=f'x mod {p} = {(r + 2) % p}'), C)
assert 'Checked by' not in priv.observe(D, 6.0, cb) and priv._known[D][k][j] == (r + 2) % p
assert 'Your check' in priv.observe(C, 6.0, cb) and priv._known[C][k][j] != (r + 2) % p

text:
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV, writeCSV
from explRL.clue_runs import runClueAny
from explRL.coop_grid import TRACKA_PLAN, coopHash, trackAGrid, trackAPilotGrid, trackAQuick
from explRL.coop_report import figTrackA, logMetrics, trackASummaries, writeTrackA
from explRL.llm_budget import PRICES, Budget
from explRL.llm_grid import HAIKU
from explRL.llm_sched import mergeTiming, runWorkload, timingSummary
from explRL.train import demo_artifact_dir

DN = 'multiagent/coop'
WORKERS = min(8, os.cpu_count() or 1)
LLM_WORKERS = 32
CAP = 150.0
LLM = demo_artifact_dir(None, 'multiagent/llm')
LIVE = os.environ.get('EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE') == '1'
LIVE_SPEC = dict(kind='live', cache=str(LLM / 'cache'), cap=CAP, ledger=str(LLM / 'spend.jsonl'))
P11 = demo_artifact_dir('full', 'multiagent/clue')


def gitCommit():
    try:
        return subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or 'unknown'
    except OSError:
        return 'unknown'


def readLog(p):
    return [json.loads(x) for x in open(p)] if p.exists() else []


def run(mode, grids, spec, workers=None, study='coopA'):
    "Run a workload through runWorkload; write runs.csv, turns.jsonl, timing.jsonl, report.md, coopA.png, metrics.json."
    out = demo_artifact_dir(mode, DN)
    logs = out / 'turns'
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    workers = workers or (LLM_WORKERS if spec.get('kind') == 'live' else WORKERS)
    t0 = time.time()
    res = runWorkload(grids, spec, workers, str(logs), run=runClueAny)
    rows, wall = res['rows'], time.time() - t0
    writeCSV(rows, out / 'runs.csv')
    with open(out / 'turns.jsonl', 'w') as f:
        for p in sorted(logs.glob('*.jsonl')) if logs.exists() else []:
            f.write(p.read_text())
    timing = timingSummary(mergeTiming(logs, out / 'timing.jsonl'), wall)
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    p11 = readCSV(P11 / 'runs.csv') if (P11 / 'runs.csv').exists() else []
    m = TRACKA_PLAN['settings']['m']
    S = trackASummaries(rows, p11, logMetrics(readLog(out / 'turns.jsonl'), m), logMetrics(readLog(P11 / 'turns.jsonl'), m), study)
    meta = dict(mode=mode, planHash=coopHash(TRACKA_PLAN), commit=gitCommit(), model=HAIKU, cap=CAP, wall=wall,
                pricesChecked=PRICES[HAIKU]['checked'], cost=float(sum(r['cost'] for r in rows)),
                calls=int(sum(r['calls'] for r in rows)), spent=Budget(CAP, spec['ledger']).spent() if spec.get('ledger') else 0.0)
    writeTrackA(out / 'report.md', S, meta)
    if S['effect']:
        figTrackA(out, S)
    (out / 'metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(meta, done=res['done'], refused=res['refused'], stopped=res['stopped'],
                                                      pooled=res['pooled'], workers=workers, timing=timing, plan=TRACKA_PLAN),
                                                 indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str) + '\n')
    if spec.get('kind') == 'live':             # keep the live run's metrics and timing; a cached rerun overwrites the others
        for f in ('metrics.json', 'timing.jsonl'):
            if not (out / f.replace('.', '_live.')).exists():
                shutil.copy(out / f, out / f.replace('.', '_live.'))
    print(f"{mode}: {len(rows)} rows, {meta['calls']} calls, ${meta['cost']:.2f} for these runs, ${meta['spent']:.2f} spent "
          f"in all, {wall:.0f} s; stopped: {res['stopped']}")
    return rows, S, meta

import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

# synthetic evaluation rows with known differences (welfare = base + model offset, paired on seed)
OFF = dict(untrained=0.0, warm=0.2, individual=0.25, team=0.3, credit=0.4)
def row(model, test, ch, N, seed, w, **kw):
    r = dict(study='coopEval', level=f'{model}|{test}', channel=ch, N=N, seed=seed, episode=0, runner='local', welfare=w,
             welfareHonest=w, pooledShare=w / 2, followShare=0.5, **{k: 1.0 for k in INFO})
    r.update(kw)
    return r
base = lambda s: 0.1 + 0.01 * (s % 5)
rows = [row(m, 'main', 'blackboard', 4, s, base(s) + o) for m, o in OFF.items() for s in list(range(900, 905)) + list(range(930, 940))]
for m, o in OFF.items():
    if m == 'untrained':
        continue
    rows += [row(m, t, ch, N, s, base(s) + o) for t, ch, N in (('gen8', 'blackboard', 8), ('genMsg', 'messages', 4),
                                                            ('genLead', 'hierarchical', 4), ('cross1', 'blackboard', 4),
                                                            ('cross3', 'blackboard', 4)) for s in range(900, 905)]
    rows += [row(m, 'liar', ch, 4, s, base(s) + o - (0.1 if ch == 'blackboard' else 0.05)) for ch in ('blackboard', 'messages') for s in range(900, 903)]
p11 = [dict(study='clue', runner='llm', channel=ch, N=N, seed=s, episode=0, welfare=base(s) + 0.3)
       for ch, N in (('blackboard', 4), ('blackboard', 8), ('messages', 4), ('hierarchical', 4)) for s in range(900, 905)]
rule = [dict(study='clueNumpy', runner='numpy', channel='blackboard', N=4, seed=s, episode=0, welfare=base(s) + 0.5) for s in range(900, 905)]
S = rlSummaries(rows, p11, rule)
near = lambda v, x: abs(v['mean'] - x) < 1e-9
assert list(S['main']) == list(OFF) and S['main']['credit']['welfare']['n'] == 15
assert near(S['gain']['credit'], 0.2) and near(S['gain']['individual'], 0.05) and 'warm' not in S['gain']
assert near(S['schemes']['credit - individual'], 0.15) and near(S['schemes']['credit - team'], 0.1)

import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

import numpy as np

from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV, writeCSV
from explRL.coop_grid import coopHash
from explRL.fix_grid import HB_PLAN, hbGrid, hbPilotGrid
from explRL.fix_stats import gapClosed, holmFamily
from explRL.llm_budget import Budget
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig, makeClient
from explRL.profile_runs import runProfile
from explRL.train import demo_artifact_dir

DN, CAP, WORKERS = 'multiagent/hiddenbench', 150.0, 16
LLM = demo_artifact_dir(None, 'multiagent/llm')
LIVE = os.environ.get('EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE') == '1'
LIVE_SPEC = dict(kind='live', cache=str(LLM / 'cache'), cap=CAP, ledger=str(LLM / 'spend.jsonl'))
f = lambda x: float(x) if x not in ('', None) else float('nan')


def gitCommit():
    try:
        return subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or 'unknown'
    except OSError:
        return 'unknown'


def hbSummary(rows, study):
    "Per arm: win rate, agent accuracy, disclosure; gap closed vs baseline against the solo ceiling (Holm over HB_PLAN's pair)."
    rs = [r for r in rows if r['study'] == study]
    by = lambda arm, k: {int(f(r['seed'])): f(r[k]) for r in rs if r['level'] == f'{arm}|hb'}
    acc = lambda arm: {s: v / HB_PLAN['N'] for s, v in by(arm, 'votesA').items()}
    arms = [a for a in HB_PLAN['arms'] if by(a, 'success')]
    S = dict(arms={a: dict(win=float(np.mean(list(by(a, 'success').values()))), n=len(by(a, 'success')),
                           accuracy=float(np.nanmean(list(acc(a).values()))) if a != 'solo' else float('nan'),
                           disclosed=float(np.nanmean(list(by(a, 'uniquePosted').values()))) if a != 'solo' else float('nan'),
                           invalid=float(np.nanmean([f(r['invalid']) / max(f(r['calls']), 1) for r in rs if r['level'] == f'{a}|hb'])))
                   for a in arms}, gap={})
    if 'baseline' in arms and 'solo' in arms:
        for a in ('factsFirst', 'table', 'dissent'):
            if a in arms:
                S['gap'][a] = gapClosed(by(a, 'success'), by('baseline', 'success'), by('solo', 'success'))
        holmFamily(S['gap'], [a for a in HB_PLAN['holm'] if a in S['gap']])
    return S


def writeHB(path, S, meta):
    g = lambda x: 'n/a' if x != x else f'{x:.2f}'
    L = [f"# HiddenBench replication of the vote fixes ({meta['mode']})", '', 'Exploratory, pre-specified in `HB_PLAN`.', '',
         f"- Plan hash `{meta['planHash']}`, git commit `{meta['commit']}`; Claude Haiku 5.5; HiddenBench (65 tasks, MIT, "
         f"Li, Naito, Shirado, ICML 2026); cost ${meta['cost']:.2f}; total API spend ${meta['spent']:.2f} of the $150 cap", '',
         '| arm | win rate (majority) | agent accuracy | hidden facts disclosed | invalid replies | episodes |', '|---|---|---|---|---|---|']
    L += [f"| {a} | {g(v['win'])} | {g(v['accuracy'])} | {g(v['disclosed'])} | {v['invalid']:.3f} | {v['n']} |" for a, v in S['arms'].items()]
    L += ['', '| arm | gap closed [95% CI] | n | p | Holm p |', '|---|---|---|---|---|']
    L += [f"| {a} | {g(v['gap'])} [{g(v['ci'][0])}, {g(v['ci'][1])}] | {v['n']} | {v['p']:.3f} | "
          f"{g(v['pHolm']) if v['primary'] else 'control'} |" for a, v in S['gap'].items()]
    path.write_text('\n'.join(L) + '\n')


def run(mode, cells, spec, workers=WORKERS, study='hbA'):
    "Run the cells through runProfile; runs.csv, turns.jsonl, report.md, summary.json."
    out = demo_artifact_dir(mode, DN)
    logs = out / 'turns'
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    client = makeClient(LLMConfig.fromDict(cells[0]['cfg']), spec)
    t0 = time.time()
    rows = runProfile(cells, client, logs, workers=workers)
    writeCSV(rows, out / 'runs.csv')
    with open(out / 'turns.jsonl', 'w') as fh:
        for p in sorted(logs.glob('*.jsonl')):
            fh.write(p.read_text())
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    S = hbSummary(rows, study)
    meta = dict(mode=mode, planHash=coopHash(HB_PLAN), commit=gitCommit(), cost=float(sum(f(r['cost']) for r in rows)),
                spent=Budget(CAP, spec['ledger']).spent() if spec.get('ledger') else 0.0, wall=time.time() - t0)
    writeHB(out / 'report.md', S, meta)
    (out / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(S=S, meta=meta), indent=1, default=str) + '\n')
    return rows, S

import json
import numpy as np
from explRL.clue_text import *
from explRL.clue_agents import ClueBoard, ClueLead, ClueMessages, known
from explRL.clueboard import ClueBoardEnv
from explRL.llm_agent import LLMMember, runTurns
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient
from explRL.multi import spawnRngs

b = ClueBoardEnv(0, 4, m=3, r=1, R=105, life=100)
env = TextClueEnv(b)
assert len(env.rules()) / 5 > 512, len(env.rules())
k = b.open[0]; task = b.tasks[k].task
A = min(b.tasks[k].holders[0]); O = (A + 1) % 4          # A holds clue 0 of k; O will open k
own = b.held(A, k)
cb = ClueBoard()
obs = env.observe(A, 0.0, cb)
assert all(f'T{x} ' in obs for x in b.open) and 'Your own clues:' in obs and 'no subtask open' in obs
assert all(f'T{k}: x mod {task.primes[j]} = {r}' in obs for j, r in own.items())
P = lambda **kw: dict(dict(action='wait', target='', answer=0, clue='', notes=''), **kw)
# parsing: open, share (a known clue only), submit, wait; unusable replies are invalid waits
assert env.parse(P(action='open', target=f't{k}'), A) == (('open', k), None, True)
j, r = next(iter(own.items())); p = task.primes[j]
assert env.parse(P(action='share', target=f'T{k}', clue=f'x mod {p} = {r}'), A) == (('share', (k, j, r)), (k, (j, p, r)), True)
assert env.parse(P(action='share', target=f'T{k}', clue=f'x mod {p} = {(r + 1) % p}'), A)[2] is False   # not a clue it knows
unknown = [jj for jj in range(3) if jj not in own]
if unknown:
    q = task.primes[unknown[0]]
    assert env.parse(P(action='share', target=f'T{k}', clue=f'x mod {q} = {task.clue(unknown[0])[1]}'), A)[2] is False
assert env.parse(P(action='submit', answer=3), A)[2] is False and env.parse(None, A)[2] is False
# a share posted to the board becomes known to teammates; the open subtask lists every known clue and the range
b.apply(A, ('share', (k, j, r)), 0.0); env.post(A, (k, (j, p, r)), 0.0, cb, {})
b.apply(O, ('open', k), 0.0)
o2 = env.observe(O, 1.0, cb)
assert f'T{k}: x mod {p} = {r} (agent {A}' in o2 and f'Your open subtask: T{k}, open. Find x with 0 <= x < 105.' in o2
assert f'x mod {p} = {r}' in o2.split('Clues you know: ')[1]
# submitting reports the candidate count to the board
env.parse(P(action='submit', answer=task.x), O); assert b._noted[O] >= 1

# a fake-client team shares through each channel (messages to two teammates; the coordinator passes clues on)
def script(req):
    o = req['messages'][0]['content'][-1]['text']
    import re
    m = re.search(r'Your own clues: T(\d+): (x mod \d+ = \d+)', o)
    if m:
        return json.dumps(P(action='share', target=f'T{m.group(1)}', clue=m.group(2)))
    return json.dumps(P(action='wait'))
for name, ch in (('board', ClueBoard()), ('messages', ClueMessages(4, 2, spawnRngs(1, 4))), ('lead', ClueLead(4))):
    bd = ClueBoardEnv(5, 4, m=3, r=1, R=105)
    e = TextClueEnv(bd)
    ms = [LLMMember(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(script)), e, ch) for _ in range(4)]
    runTurns(ms, bd, 3)
    assert bd.counts['shares'] > 0 and all(x['valid'] for m in ms for x in m.log), name
    if name == 'messages':
        assert any('agent ' in x['obs'] and 'says T' in x['obs'] for m in ms for x in m.log)
    if name == 'lead':
        assert all('The coordinator suggests: T' in x['obs'] for m in ms for x in m.log)

# the observation alone is enough to solve: a scripted client that reads only the text solves a board it holds all clues of
import re
def solver(req):
    o = req['messages'][0]['content'][-1]['text']
    m = re.search(r'Your open subtask: T(\d+), open\. Find x with 0 <= x < (\d+)\. Clues you know: (.*)\.', o)
    if not m:
        return json.dumps(P(action='open', target=re.search(r'Open subtasks[^:]*: (T\d+)', o).group(1)))
    cl = [tuple(map(int, c)) for c in re.findall(r'x mod (\d+) = (\d+)', m.group(3))]
    xs = [y for y in range(int(m.group(2))) if all(y % p == r for p, r in cl)]
    return json.dumps(P(action='submit', answer=xs[0]) if len(xs) == 1 else P(action='wait'))
solo = ClueBoardEnv(4, 1, m=3, r=1, R=105)
mem = LLMMember(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(solver)), TextClueEnv(solo), None)
runTurns([mem], solo, 20)
assert solo.counts['solved'] >= 9 and solo.counts['wrong'] == 0

# Track A options (AC-2): off by default; the hint sentence, the teammates line, pooled clues passed with a suggestion
bd = ClueBoardEnv(2, 4, m=2, r=1, R=30)
plain, hinted = TextClueEnv(bd), TextClueEnv(bd, hint='follow', showOpen=True)
assert HINTS['follow'] not in plain.rules() and HINTS['follow'] in hinted.rules()
assert hinted.rules().replace(HINTS['follow'] + '\n\n', '') == plain.rules()
k0 = bd.open[0]; bd.apply(1, ('open', k0), 0.0)
o_plain, o_open = plain.observe(0, 1.0, ClueBoard()), hinted.observe(0, 1.0, ClueBoard())
assert 'Teammates working on' not in o_plain
assert f'Teammates working on: agent 1: T{k0}; agent 2: none; agent 3: none' in o_open
assert o_open.replace(f'\nTeammates working on: agent 1: T{k0}; agent 2: none; agent 3: none', '') == o_plain
for pp in (False, True):
    bd = ClueBoardEnv(3, 4, m=2, r=1, R=30)
    lead = ClueLead(4, passPooled=pp)
    k = bd.open[0]; h = min(bd.tasks[k].holders[0]); p, r = bd.tasks[k].task.clue(0)
    lead.post(h, k, (0, p, r), 0.0, bd)                  # nobody has k open: not routed on posting
    other = (h + 1) % 4
    o = TextClueEnv(bd).observe(other, 1.0, lead)
    assert f'The coordinator suggests: T{k}.' in o
    assert (f'T{k}: x mod {p} = {r} (from agent {h})' in o) == pp
    assert (known(other, bd, lead)[k].get(0) == r) == (pp or 0 in bd.held(other, k))

source

angdiff
def angdiff(
    a, b
):
a - b wrapped into [-pi, pi); works element-wise on arrays.




source

wrap
def wrap(
    a
):
Heading in [0, 2pi) as a float.*


Policy curves (Eqs. 20-21). thetaC is the compass heading, thetaG the goal heading; all accept arrays.


source

jumpProb
def jumpProb(
    thetaC, thetaG, p
):
Eq. 21 with the sign decided in spec Q1 (1 - cos): fewest jumps at the goal.




source

driftRate
def driftRate(
    thetaC, thetaG, p
):
Eq. 20: fixation drift rate; mean fixation duration is aF / driftRate.




source

turnProb
def turnProb(
    thetaC, thetaG, p
):
Eq. 20: probability of a clockwise saccade.




source

effectivePolicy
def effectivePolicy(
    thetaA, thetaG, p
):
Eq. 23: drift rate, turn probability, fixation duration and turn bias seen at arena headings thetaA.




source

Event
def Event(
    thetaA:float, thetaC:float, fixDur:float, direction:int, dx:float, jumped:bool, thetaC_next:float
)->None:
One fixation followed by one saccade and a possible bump jump.




source

prestructuredPolicy
def prestructuredPolicy(
    thetaG
):
Policy whose only learnable state is the goal heading thetaG (compass coordinates, radians).




source

prestructuredAgent
def prestructuredAgent(
    theta, goal, policy, rl, params, rng:NoneType=None, thetaC:NoneType=None
):
Agent with an arena heading theta and a compass heading thetaC that can jump by thetaJ.




source

GoalHeadingRL
def GoalHeadingRL(
    policy, lr:float=1.0, eps:float=1e-12
):
Policy-gradient update of the goal heading after each saccade (Eqs. 24-25, saccade term only).


Policy curves stay in valid ranges and respect heading asymmetry:

from math import pi
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_fail, test_close
from explRL.params import Params

p = Params()
g = pi
ths = np.linspace(0, 2 * pi, 37, endpoint=False)
dS = turnProb(ths, g, p)
nu = driftRate(ths, g, p)
pj = jumpProb(ths, g, p)
assert dS.min() >= 0.05 and dS.max() <= 0.95
assert nu.min() >= 0.05 and nu.max() <= 0.85 + 1e-9
assert pj.min() >= 0.05 and pj.max() <= 0.75
for i, th in enumerate(ths):
    test_close(turnProb(th, g, p), dS[i]); test_close(jumpProb(th, g, p), pj[i])
assert turnProb(g + 0.01, g, p) < 0.5 < turnProb(g - 0.01, g, p)

AC-2: Eq. 23 readout is bimodal; turn bias points toward or away from the goal:

def theta_at_rel_deg(rel_deg, goal=pi):
    return wrap(goal + np.deg2rad(rel_deg))

eff = effectivePolicy(np.array([theta_at_rel_deg(r) for r in (0, 90, -90, 180)]), g, p)
fd0, fd90, fd180 = eff['fixDur'][0], eff['fixDur'][1], eff['fixDur'][3]
assert fd0 > fd90 and fd180 > fd90
for rel in (30, -30, 80, -80):
    tb = effectivePolicy(theta_at_rel_deg(rel), g, p)['turnBias']
    assert np.sign(tb) == -np.sign(rel)
for rel in (150, -150, 170, -170):
    tb = effectivePolicy(theta_at_rel_deg(rel), g, p)['turnBias']
    assert np.sign(tb) == np.sign(rel)

AC-3: With no jumps, effective readout matches Eq. 20 at the arena heading:

p0 = Params(GJ=0.0, BJ=0.0)
th = np.linspace(0, 2 * pi, 25, endpoint=False)
eff0 = effectivePolicy(th, g, p0)
test_close(eff0['dS'], turnProb(th, g, p0))
test_close(eff0['nu'], driftRate(th, g, p0))
test_close(eff0['fixDur'], p0.aF / eff0['nu'])
assert eff0['fixDur'].argmax() == int(np.argmin(np.abs(angdiff(th, g))))

Agent sampling, wrapping, and draw order:

def toy_prestructured(theta=-0.1, seed=0, thetaC=None, **kw):
    pol = prestructuredPolicy(pi)
    params = Params(**kw)
    return prestructuredAgent(theta, pi, pol, GoalHeadingRL(pol, lr=0.0), params,
                              rng=np.random.default_rng(seed), thetaC=thetaC)

a = toy_prestructured()
test_close(a.theta, 2 * pi - 0.1)
test_close(a.thetaC, a.theta)
test_fail(lambda: prestructuredAgent(0.0, pi, Policy(), GoalHeadingRL(prestructuredPolicy(pi)), Params()),
          contains='prestructuredPolicy')
ev = toy_prestructured(seed=4).samplePolicy()
assert ev.fixDur > 0
assert abs(ev.dx) > 0 and abs(ev.dx) != round(abs(ev.dx))
off = abs(angdiff(ev.thetaC_next, wrap(ev.thetaC + ev.dx)))
test_close(off, 0.0 if not ev.jumped else pi)
a0, a1 = toy_prestructured(seed=5), toy_prestructured(seed=5)
for _ in range(20):
    test_eq(a0.samplePolicy(), a1.samplePolicy())

Mean fixation duration at the anti-goal compass heading (heavy-tailed at the goal):

ag = toy_prestructured(thetaC=0.0, seed=99)
ag.policy.thetaG = pi
nu_ag = float(driftRate(ag.thetaC, ag.policy.thetaG, ag.params))
pred = ag.params.aF / nu_ag
durs = [ag.samplePolicy().fixDur for _ in range(20000)]
test_close(np.mean(durs), pred, eps=0.05 * pred)

AC-6: Observed CW and jump rates match predictions (20 000 calls):

ag = toy_prestructured(thetaC=1.0, seed=7)
ag.policy.thetaG = 2.0
dS_pred = float(turnProb(ag.thetaC, ag.policy.thetaG, ag.params))
cw, jumped, post_c = [], [], []
for _ in range(20000):
    ev = ag.samplePolicy()
    cw.append(ev.direction > 0)
    jumped.append(ev.jumped)
    post_c.append(wrap(ag.thetaC + ev.dx))
test_close(np.mean(cw), dS_pred, eps=0.01)
pj_pred = float(np.mean([jumpProb(c1, ag.policy.thetaG, ag.params) for c1 in post_c]))
test_close(np.mean(jumped), pj_pred, eps=0.01)

AC-4: Analytic goal gradient matches finite differences of logPiS:

def fd_logPiS(rl, agent, ev, h=1e-6):
    g0 = rl.policy.thetaG
    g = lambda x: rl.logPiS(agent, ev, thetaG=x)
    return (g(g0 + h) - g(g0 - h)) / (2 * h)

rl = GoalHeadingRL(prestructuredPolicy(0.0))
agent = toy_prestructured(thetaC=0.5, seed=1)
agent.policy = rl.policy
agent.rl = rl
for d in (1, -1):
    for tc in (0.2, 1.1, 5.0):
        ev = Event(agent.theta, tc, 0.1, d, 0.05 * d, False, wrap(tc + 0.05 * d))
        test_close(rl.gradLogPiS(agent, ev), fd_logPiS(rl, agent, ev), eps=1e-6)

AC-5: Small learning steps move dS in the reward direction:

def dS_at(agent, tc=None):
    tc = agent.thetaC if tc is None else tc
    return float(turnProb(tc, agent.policy.thetaG, agent.params))

rl = GoalHeadingRL(prestructuredPolicy(pi), lr=0.01)
agent = toy_prestructured(seed=2)
agent.policy = rl.policy
agent.rl = rl
ev = Event(agent.theta, agent.thetaC, 0.1, 1, 0.02, False, wrap(agent.thetaC + 0.02))
before = dS_at(agent)
rl.updateParams(agent, ev, 1.0)
assert dS_at(agent) > before
rl.policy.thetaG = pi
before = dS_at(agent)
rl.updateParams(agent, ev, -1.0)
assert dS_at(agent) < before
g_fixed = rl.policy.thetaG
rl.lr = 0.0
rl.updateParams(agent, ev, 1.0)
test_close(rl.policy.thetaG, g_fixed)
assert np.isfinite(rl.policy.thetaG)

import json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from explRL.local_policy import *
from explRL.clue_policy import userText

class StubTok:
    "A stand-in tokenizer: one id per character, eos 0; the chat template is the JSON of the messages."
    eos_token_id, pad_token, eos_token = 0, '<pad>', '<eos>'
    def __call__(self, text, add_special_tokens=False):
        return dict(input_ids=[ord(c) for c in text])
    def apply_chat_template(self, msgs, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True):
        return json.dumps(msgs)

class Echo(LocalPolicy):
    "Generation replaced by a counter, to test caching and the request bookkeeping without a model."
    n = 0
    def _generate(self, texts):
        out = []
        for t in texts:
            Echo.n += 1
            out.append((json.dumps(dict(action='wait', notes=f'g{Echo.n}')), len(t), 5, 'end_turn'))
        return out

assert pickDevice('cpu') == 'cpu' and pickDevice('mps') == 'mps'
blocks = [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'Your notes so far: a'}, {'type': 'text', 'text': 'Now:\nobs'}]
assert json.loads(promptText(StubTok(), 'sys', blocks)) == [dict(role='system', content='sys'), dict(role='user', content=userText(blocks))]
# the reply (plus eos) is kept whole; the prompt is cut from the left to fit
ids, start = encodePair(StubTok(), 'abcdef', 'xy', maxLen=6)
assert ids == [ord(c) for c in 'defxy'] + [0] and start == 3
ids, start = encodePair(StubTok(), 'ab', 'xy', maxLen=50)
assert ids == [ord(c) for c in 'abxy'] + [0] and start == 2
assert encodePair(StubTok(), 'ab', 'xy', eos=False)[0] == [ord(c) for c in 'abxy']
assert len({cacheKey('m', '', 't', 1.0, 160, 0, 0), cacheKey('m', '', 't', 1.0, 160, 0, 1), cacheKey('m', 'h', 't', 1.0, 160, 0, 0)}) == 3
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    assert adapterHash(None) == '' and adapterHash(d) == adapterHash(d)
    (Path(d) / 'adapter_model.safetensors').write_bytes(b'1')
    h1 = adapterHash(d)
    (Path(d) / 'adapter_model.safetensors').write_bytes(b'2')
    assert h1 != adapterHash(d)
reqs = [('sys', blocks), ('sys', blocks), ('sys', [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'Now:\nother'}])]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as c:
    a = Echo('m', device='cpu', engine='hf', tokenizer=StubTok(), cache=c)(reqs)
    assert len({x.parsed['notes'] for x in a}) == 3              # a repeated prompt is a separate sample
    assert a[0].usage['output_tokens'] == 5 and a[0].cost == 0 and a[0].stopReason == 'end_turn'
    b = Echo('m', device='cpu', engine='hf', tokenizer=StubTok(), cache=c)(reqs)
    assert [x.text for x in a] == [x.text for x in b] and Echo.n == 3     # the second run is served from the cache
    Echo('m', device='cpu', engine='hf', tokenizer=StubTok(), cache=c, seed=1)(reqs)
    assert Echo.n == 6                                            # another sampling seed is another key
assert Echo('m', device='cpu', engine='auto', tokenizer=StubTok()).engine == 'hf'
x, y = Echo('m', device='cpu', tokenizer=StubTok()), Echo('m', device='cpu', tokenizer=StubTok())
x.setAdapter(None); y.setAdapter(None)
assert len({x.loraId, y.loraId}) == 2
# Phase 17: guided replies need vLLM (the HF engine refuses them); off by default, so keys and parameters are unchanged
try:
    LocalPolicy('m', device='cpu', guided=True)
    raise AssertionError('the HF engine must refuse guided replies')
except ValueError:
    pass
lp = LocalPolicy('m', device='cpu')
assert lp.guided is False and lp._structured() == {}
assert list(GUIDED_SCHEMA['properties']) == list(REPLY_ORDER) == GUIDED_SCHEMA['required'] and REPLY_ORDER[0] == 'notes'
assert {k: v for k, v in GUIDED_SCHEMA.items() if k not in ('required', 'properties')} == {k: v for k, v in CLUE_SCHEMA.items() if k not in ('required', 'properties')}
assert GUIDED_SCHEMA['properties'] == CLUE_SCHEMA['properties']                      # same constraints, only the order differs
for bad in ('notes', 2):
    try:
        LocalPolicy('m', device='cpu', engine='vllm', guided=bad)
        raise AssertionError
    except ValueError:
        pass


# With the [train] extra, no download: generation on this machine's device with the tiny random model
import importlib.util
if all(importlib.util.find_spec(m) for m in ('transformers', 'peft', 'tokenizers')):   # the [train] extra; the docs build runs cells with imports and lacks it

            assert len({o.text for o in out}) > 1 and all(o.usage['input_tokens'] > 100 for o in out)   # samples differ

            a = [o.text for o in LocalPolicy(tiny, maxNew=12, device='cpu', cache=c)(reqs)]

Tests

import json, re
import numpy as np
from explRL.llm_agent import *
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient
from explRL.llm_env import TextForagingEnv, locationNames
from explRL.llm_board import TextBoardEnv
from explRL.board_agents import BoardLead, ClaimBoard
from explRL.harness import Blackboard, Lead, MessageBus
from explRL.harness_runs import benchWorld
from explRL.multi import spawnRngs
from explRL.taskboard import TaskBoardEnv

def obsOf(req):
    return req['messages'][0]['content'][-1]['text']

def forager(req):
    "Stay where you are and report it; every third turn go to the coordinator's suggestion or the first board entry."
    o = obsOf(req)
    here = re.search(r'You are at (\w+)', o).group(1)
    sug = re.search(r'suggests: (\w+)', o) or re.search(r'Board[^:]*: (\w+) ', o)
    go = sug and int(float(re.search(r'Time ([\d.]+)', o).group(1))) % 3 == 0 and sug.group(1) != 'empty'
    return json.dumps(dict(action='go' if go else 'stay', target=sug.group(1) if go else '', reportLocation=here,
                           reportValue=0.5, notes=f'at {here}'))

def team(channel, n=3, turns=6, memory='full', seed=0):
    w = benchWorld(); w.reset(seed, n)
    env = TextForagingEnv(w, locationNames(64, seed))
    fc = FakeClient(forager)
    ms = [LLMMember(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=fc), env, channel, memory=memory) for _ in range(n)]
    hist = runTurns(ms, w, turns)
    return ms, hist, fc, w

# every agent makes exactly its turn budget; extras record validity and reports
ms, hist, fc, w = team(None, turns=5)
assert [len(hist.forAgent(i)) for i in range(3)] == [5, 5, 5] and len(fc.requests) == 15
assert all(r.extras[0] and r.extras[4] for r in hist.records)
w = benchWorld(); w.reset(0, 3); env = TextForagingEnv(w, locationNames(64, 0))
h = runTurns([LLMMember(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(forager)), env) for _ in range(3)], w, [2, 4, 1])
assert [len(h.forAgent(i)) for i in range(3)] == [2, 4, 1]

# the same script gives identical logs
a, b = team(Blackboard(64, None, 0.01, 3))[0], team(Blackboard(64, None, 0.01, 3))[0]
assert json.dumps([m.log for m in a]) == json.dumps([m.log for m in b])

# channels: reports reach the blackboard, messages reach two teammates, the lead's suggestion reaches every agent
bb = Blackboard(64, None, 0.01, 3)
ms, *_ = team(bb)
assert sum(bb.stats[i]['written'] for i in range(3)) == 18
assert any('Board (' in r['obs'] and 'empty' not in r['obs'] for r in ms[1].log)
mb = MessageBus(3, 2, 10.0, np.inf, spawnRngs(5, 3))
ms, *_ = team(mb, turns=12)
assert sum(mb.stats[i]['sent'] for i in range(3)) > 0 and any('agent ' in r['obs'] for m in ms for r in m.log)
lead = Lead(64, 3)
ms, *_ = team(lead)
assert all('The coordinator suggests' in r['obs'] for m in ms for r in m.log) and lead.table.C.sum() > 0

# memory: full is append-only (each turn's history starts with the previous turn's), last8 keeps 8, notes keeps notes
ms, hist, fc, w = team(None, n=1, turns=12)
hs = [[c['text'] for c in r['messages'][0]['content'][:-1]] for r in fc.requests]
assert all(hs[k + 1][:len(hs[k])] == hs[k] and len(hs[k + 1]) == len(hs[k]) + 1 for k in range(11))
assert all('cache_control' in r['messages'][0]['content'][-2] for r in fc.requests[1:])
assert len({json.dumps(r['system']) for r in fc.requests}) == 1                        # the cached prefix never changes
ms, hist, fc, w = team(None, n=1, turns=12, memory='last8')
assert [len(r['messages'][0]['content']) - 1 for r in fc.requests] == [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 8, 8, 8]
ms, hist, fc, w = team(None, n=1, turns=3, memory='notes')
assert [c['text'] for c in fc.requests[2]['messages'][0]['content'][:-1]] == [f'Your notes so far: {ms[0].log[1]["response"] and json.loads(ms[0].log[1]["response"])["notes"]}']

# invalid replies, refusals and max_tokens stops become 'stay' and are counted
w = benchWorld(); w.reset(0, 1); env = TextForagingEnv(w, locationNames(64, 0))
fc = FakeClient([dict(text='{"action": "go", "target": "Atlantis", "reportLocation": "", "reportValue": 0, "notes": ""}'),
                 dict(text='', stop='refusal', refusal='other'), dict(text='{"act', stop='max_tokens')])
m = LLMMember(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=fc), env)
h = runTurns([m], w, 3)
assert [r.kind for r in h.records] == ['stay'] * 3 and [r.extras[0] for r in h.records] == [False] * 3
assert [x['refusal'] for x in m.log] == [None, 'other', None] and [x['stop'] for x in m.log][2] == 'max_tokens'

# framing and lessons change only the system prompt
w = benchWorld(); w.reset(0, 1); env = TextForagingEnv(w, locationNames(64, 0))
s = {f: LLMMember(None, env, framing=f).system() for f in FRAMING}
assert len(set(s.values())) == 3 and all(x.startswith(env.rules()) for x in s.values())
assert 'team\'s total food' in s['team'] and 'Lessons' in LLMMember(None, env, lessons='go east').system()
hs = LLMMember(None, env, home={3, 4}).system()

            int(re.search(r'f\(x\) == (-?\d+)', o).group(1))
