from explRL.hidden_profile import *


def known(t, env, i):
    "Agent i's facts and the facts on the board."
    return set(t['held'][i]) | {p['fact'] for p in env.board if p['kind'] == 'fact'}


def play(t, rounds, posts, **kw):
    """A scripted team: posts(t, i, r) -> parsed post; each agent votes for the option with the higher total over the
    facts it knows (ties: the option shown first)."""
    env = ProfileEnv(t, rounds, **kw)
    for r in range(rounds):
        for i in range(t['N']):
            env.post(i, posts(t, i, r))
        env.endRound()
    votes = []
    for i in range(t['N']):
        tot = factTotals(t, known(t, env, i))
        votes.append(env.vote(i, dict(vote=t['names'][int(tot[1] > tot[0])], notes='')))
    return env, votes


def privateFirst(t, i, r):
    "Post the agent's own facts, private ones first."
    order = sorted(range(len(t['held'][i])), key=lambda j: not t['facts'][t['held'][i][j]]['private'])
    return dict(kind='fact', fact=f'F{order[r % len(order)] + 1}', text='', notes='')


silent = lambda t, i, r: dict(kind='opinion', fact='', text='I think we should decide carefully.', notes='')

# 1 000 seeds: shared facts alone favour B, all facts favour A (A +8, B +3), each agent alone prefers B (A +2, B +3);
# lone adds one fact, held by one agent, that rules B out; names, the hidden-best's position and fact order vary
pairs, bests, doms, orders = set(), set(), set(), set()
for seed in range(1000):
    t = profileTask(seed)
    A, B, N = t['best'], 1 - t['best'], t['N']
    sh = factTotals(t, [k for k, f in enumerate(t['facts']) if len(f['holders']) == N])
    al = factTotals(t)
    assert (sh[A], sh[B]) == (0, 3) and (al[A], al[B]) == (8, 3), seed
    for i in range(N):
        own = factTotals(t, t['held'][i])
        assert (own[A], own[B]) == (2, 3) and len(t['held'][i]) == 7
    assert all(f['option'] == A and f['sign'] == 1 and len(f['holders']) == 1 for f in t['facts'] if f['private'])
    texts = [f['text'] for f in t['facts']]
    assert len(set(texts)) == len(texts) == 13 and all(t['names'][f['option']] in f['text'] for f in t['facts'])
    L = profileTask(seed, 'lone')
    out = [f for f in L['facts'] if f['ruleOut']]
    assert (L['names'], L['best'], L['domain']) == (t['names'], t['best'], t['domain']) and len(L['facts']) == 14
    assert len(out) == 1 and len(out[0]['holders']) == 1 and out[0]['option'] == B and t['names'][B] in out[0]['text']
    assert sorted(f['text'] for f in L['facts'] if not f['ruleOut']) == sorted(texts)
    al = factTotals(L)
    assert al[A] > al[B]
    pairs.add(tuple(t['names'])); bests.add(A); doms.add(t['domain'])
    orders.add(tuple(f['option'] == A for f in t['facts']))
assert len(pairs) > 100 and bests == {0, 1} and len(doms) == 3 and len(orders) > 100
assert profileTask(7) == profileTask(7) and profileTask(7, domain='hiring')['domain'] == 'hiring'


# a scripted team that posts every fact (enough rounds, or private facts first in 3 rounds) and votes by its totals
# always succeeds; one that posts no fact never does (classic variant)
for seed in range(1000):
    t = profileTask(seed)
    env, votes = play(t, 7, lambda t, i, r: dict(kind='fact', fact=f'F{r + 1}', text='', notes=''))
    assert env.stats()['factsPosted'] == 13 and env.success(votes) and env.stats()['uniquePosted'] == 1
    env, votes = play(t, 3, privateFirst)
    assert env.success(votes) and env.stats()['uniquePosted'] == 1 and env.stats()['invalid'] == 0
    env, votes = play(t, 3, silent)
    assert not env.success(votes) and sum(v == t['best'] for v in votes) == 0 and env.stats()['opinions'] == 12
    env, votes = play(profileTask(seed, 'lone'), 8, lambda t, i, r: dict(kind='fact', fact=f'F{r % len(t["held"][i]) + 1}', text='', notes=''))
    assert env.success(votes)

# posts: a fact id publishes the fact's own sentence; bad ids, kinds, empty opinions and non-dicts are invalid and
# post nothing; opinions are cut to 300 characters; factsFirst rejects round-1 opinions only
t = profileTask(1)
env = ProfileEnv(t)
op = dict(kind='opinion', fact='', text='x' * 400, notes='')
assert env.post(0, dict(kind='fact', fact=' f2 ', text='made up', notes='')) and env.pending[0]['text'] == t['facts'][t['held'][0][1]]['text']
bad = [dict(kind='fact', fact='F8', text='', notes=''), dict(kind='fact', fact=2, text='', notes=''), dict(kind='vote'),
       dict(kind='opinion', fact='', text='  ', notes=''), None, 'F1', {}]
assert not any(env.post(1, b) for b in bad) and 1 not in env.pending and env.invalid == len(bad)
assert env.post(2, op) and env.pending[2]['text'] == 'x' * 300
assert 'nothing posted yet' in env.observe(3)            # no same-round visibility
env.endRound()
assert [p['agent'] for p in env.board] == [0, 2] and env.round == 2 and 'round 1, agent 0 (fact): ' in env.observe(3)
ff = ProfileEnv(t, rule='factsFirst')
assert not ff.post(0, op) and ff.post(1, dict(kind='fact', fact='F1', text='', notes='')) and ff.invalid == 1
ff.endRound()
assert ff.post(0, op) and [p['kind'] for p in ff.board] == ['fact']


# the table lists each posted fact once, grouped by option, without senders; opinions below
t = profileTask(2)
A, B = t['best'], 1 - t['best']
k = next(k for k, f in enumerate(t['facts']) if len(f['holders']) == t['N'] and f['option'] == B)
for table in (False, True):
    env = ProfileEnv(t, table=table)
    for i in range(3):
        env.post(i, dict(kind='fact', fact=f"F{t['held'][i].index(k) + 1}", text='', notes=''))
    env.post(3, dict(kind='opinion', fact='', text='We should pick carefully.', notes=''))
    env.endRound()
    o = env.boardText()
    assert o.count(t['facts'][k]['text']) == (1 if table else 3) and ('agent 0' in o) != table
    if table:
        assert o.index(f"About {t['names'][B]}:") < o.index(t['facts'][k]['text']) and f"About {t['names'][A]}: none." in o
        assert o.endswith('Opinions:\nround 1, agent 3: We should pick carefully.')
    assert env.stats()['factsPosted'] == 1 and env.stats()['opinions'] == 1

# votes: the schema's enum is the two names; a name (case and spaces ignored) parses, anything else is invalid
env = ProfileEnv(t)
assert env.VOTE_SCHEMA['properties']['vote']['enum'] == t['names'] == voteSchema(t['names'])['properties']['vote']['enum']
assert env.SCHEMA == POST_SCHEMA and POST_SCHEMA['properties']['kind']['enum'] == ['fact', 'opinion']
assert env.vote(0, dict(vote=f"  {t['names'][1].upper()} ", notes='')) == 1 and env.vote(0, dict(vote=t['names'][0])) == 0
assert env.vote(1, dict(vote='Nobody')) is None and env.vote(1, None) is None and env.invalid == 2
assert env.success([A, A, A, B]) and not env.success([A, A, B, B]) and not env.success([A, A, None, None])
assert parseVote(t['names'], dict(vote=t['names'][1])) == 1

# rules: each option adds its sentence only when on; observations show own facts with ids, the round and the board
base = ProfileEnv(t).rules()
assert all(x in base for x in t['names']) and 'only facts may be posted' not in base and DISSENT not in base
assert 'only facts may be posted' in ProfileEnv(t, rule='factsFirst').rules() and DISSENT in ProfileEnv(t, hint='dissent').rules()
assert 'once, grouped by option' in ProfileEnv(t, table=True).rules() and 'once, grouped by option' not in base
o = ProfileEnv(t, rounds=4).observe(2, 1)
assert o.startswith('Round 1 of 4. You are agent 2.\nYour facts:\nF1: ') and o.count('\nF') == len(t['held'][2])
assert ProfileEnv(t).voteText(1).endswith(f"Vote privately for {t['names'][0]} or {t['names'][1]}: reply with one JSON object, vote and notes.")

# the solo ceiling's prompt holds every fact
L = profileTask(2, 'lone')
s = soloCeiling(L)
assert all(f['text'] in s for f in L['facts']) and s.count('\n- ') == 14

text:
Learning dynamics
Each line is one agent. PI is fixation-weighted safe minus danger time (higher is better). Distance is degrees from the learned goal in the arena to the nearest safe-zone center. Jump rate is the running fraction of saccades followed by a 180° compass jump (exploratory remapping in the symmetric arena). Agents do not interact; curves differ only by seed.

def _iterEnd(h):
    return h.t + h.fixDur + tS

def _cumPI(h):
    w = h.valence * h.fixDur
    return _iterEnd(h), np.cumsum(w) / np.cumsum(h.fixDur)

def _cumJump(h):
    n = np.arange(1, len(h.t) + 1, dtype=float)
    return _iterEnd(h), np.cumsum(h.jumped) / n

times = np.arange(0.0, Ttot, 1.0)

                         dist_last_quarter=lastQuarterMean(h, dist, s0['dist'], Ttot, tS),
                         strength_start=s0['strength'], strength_end=float(h.strength[-1]),
                         PI=piScore(h), jump_rate=float(h.jumped.mean())))
    axes[0].plot(*_cumPI(h), label=f'agent {i}')
    axes[1].plot(times, heldValue(h, dist, s0['dist'], times, tS), label=f'agent {i}')
    axes[2].plot(*_cumJump(h), label=f'agent {i}')
for ax, ylab in zip(axes, ('PI (cumulative)', 'goal distance to safe (deg)', 'jump rate (cumulative)')):

from explRL.circuit_train import historyFromRecords, piScore
from explRL.harness_runs import (HarnessConfig, benchWorld, circuitWorld, netHarvest, runHarness, rangeCheck)
from explRL.team_refs import idealFree, ifdDistanceTies, ledgerArrays, occupancy, socialOptimum, timeToIFD
from explRL.train import save_demo_figure, save_demo_metrics, save_demo_report
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

DN = 'multiagent/demo_harness'
CHANNELS = ('none', 'blackboard', 'messages', 'hierarchical')
CIRCUIT_CHANNELS = ('none', 'blackboard', 'messages')
artifact_mode, T, circuit_T = 'quick', 300.0, 300.0
SEEDS = list(range(3))
N_BANDITS = 8
N_CIRCUIT = 4
DEFAULTS = HarnessConfig().asDict()
_bw = benchWorld()
WORLD = dict(layout=_bw.layout.name, L=_bw.L, travelScale=float(_bw.layout.T[0, 1] / _bw.layout.dist[0, 1]),
             model=_bw.model, nPatches=_bw.nPatches, nDanger=_bw.nDanger, intake=_bw.intake.tolist(), c=_bw.c,
             Tmove=_bw.Tmove, noise=_bw.noise, dangerCost=_bw.dangerCost)


def boot_ci(vals, n=2000, seed=0):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    vals = np.asarray(vals, float)
    boots = [rng.choice(vals, len(vals), replace=True).mean() for _ in range(n)]
    return float(np.percentile(boots, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(boots, 97.5))


def cfg_channel(name, **kw):
    d = {**HarnessConfig(channel=name).asDict(), 'budget': 'time', **kw}
    return HarnessConfig.fromDict(d)


def bandit_series(cfg, N, seed, Ttot):
    c = HarnessConfig.fromDict({**cfg.asDict(), 'budget': 'time', 'T': Ttot})
    world, hist, channel, metrics = runHarness(c, N, seed)
    L = ledgerArrays(world.ledger)
    times, counts = occupancy(L, N, world.nPatches, Ttot)
    n_ifd, _ = idealFree(world, N)
    d = ifdDistanceTies(counts, n_ifd, world.intake, N)
    moves = [k * world.Tmove for k in range(1, int(Ttot // world.Tmove) + 1)
             if k * world.Tmove < Ttot] if world.Tmove else []
    bins = np.arange(0.0, Ttot + 10.0, 10.0)
    rate = np.histogram(L['t'], bins=bins, weights=netHarvest(world, L))[0] / 10.0   # welfare: harvest minus danger cost
    return dict(bins=bins[:-1], rate=rate, times=times, ifd_d=d, moves=moves, metrics=metrics)


def mean_series(runs, key):
    return np.mean([r[key] for r in runs], axis=0)


def summarize_bandit(cfg, N, seeds, Ttot):
    runs = [bandit_series(cfg, N, sd, Ttot) for sd in seeds]
    mets = [r['metrics'] for r in runs]
    pas = [m['perAgentSecond'] for m in mets]
    comm = [sum(m['comm'].get('perAgentSecond', {}).values()) for m in mets]
    tifd = []
    for m in mets:
        ok = [t for t in (m.get('timeToIFD') or []) if t == t]
        tifd.append(float(np.mean(ok)) if ok else float('nan'))
    ok_tifd = [x for x in tifd if x == x]
    return dict(
        perAgentSecond=dict(mean=float(np.mean(pas)), ci=boot_ci(pas)),
        commPerAgentSecond=dict(mean=float(np.mean(comm)), ci=boot_ci(comm)),
        timeToIFD=dict(mean=float(np.nanmean(tifd)) if ok_tifd else float('nan'),
                       ci=boot_ci(ok_tifd) if len(ok_tifd) > 1 else ((ok_tifd[0], ok_tifd[0]) if ok_tifd else (float('nan'), float('nan')))),
        series=dict(bins=runs[0]['bins'], rate=mean_series(runs, 'rate'), times=runs[0]['times'],
                    ifd_d=mean_series(runs, 'ifd_d'), moves=runs[0]['moves']),
    )
artifact_mode, T, circuit_T = 'full', 600.0, 1200.0
SEEDS = list(range(10))

def harness_demo_report(m):
    lines = [
        f"# Phase 7 harness demo ({m['mode']} run)\n",
        f"Benchmark ring world ({m['world']['nPatches']} patches, danger sites, patches jump every {m['world']['Tmove']} s). "
        f"Eight bandit learners compare four communication channels; circuit teams use four trained agents on a crowded asymmetric ring. "
        f"Bandit runs: {m['T_s']} s world time; circuit: {m['circuit_T_s']} s.\n",
        "## Figures in this folder\n",
        "- `channels.png` — team harvest rate (10 s bins, mean over seeds) and IFD distance; dashed lines = patch moves.\n",
        "- `evaporation.png` — blackboard with λ = 0, 0.01, 0.1 (same panels as channels).\n",
        "- `circuit_channels.png` — harvest and performance index per agent for none / blackboard / messages.\n",
    ]
    if m['mode'] == 'full':
        lines += [
            "- `range_check.png` — AC-11 dynamic range (welfare per agent-s vs team size).\n",
            "- `scaling_budgets.png` — welfare per agent-s vs team size under fixed time and fixed compute budgets.\n",
        ]
    lines += ["- `metrics.json` — numbers behind this report.\n", "\nWelfare = true harvest minus the danger cost (time at danger sites x `dangerCost`).\n", "## Channel comparison\n"]
    for ch in CHANNELS:
        row = m['channels'][ch]
        pas = row['perAgentSecond']
        comm = row['commPerAgentSecond']
        tifd = row['timeToIFD']
        lines.append(
            f"- **{ch}**: {pas['mean']:.3f} welfare per agent-s (95% CI {pas['ci'][0]:.3f}–{pas['ci'][1]:.3f}); "
            f"comm cost {comm['mean']:.4f}/agent-s; mean time-to-IFD after moves {tifd['mean']:.0f} s (when defined).\n"
        )
    lines.append("\n## Evaporation\n")
    for lam, row in m['evaporation'].items():
        pas = row['perAgentSecond']['mean']
        lines.append(f"- Blackboard λ={lam}: {pas:.3f} welfare per agent-s.\n")
    lines.append("\n## Circuit teams\n")
    for ch, row in m['circuit']['channels'].items():
        h = ', '.join(f'{x:.0f}' for x in row['harvest'])
        lines.append(f"- **{ch}**: welfare totals [{h}]; PI {[round(p, 2) for p in row['PI']]}.\n")
    if 'range_check' in m:
        rc = m['range_check']
        lines += [
            "\n## Harness check (AC-11)\n",
            f"- Ceiling (first-quarter rate < 0.9× social optimum): {'pass' if rc['ceiling'] else 'fail'}.\n",
            f"- Floor (none channel above random): {'pass' if rc['floor'] else 'fail'}.\n",
            f"- Channel gap (paired best−worst): {'pass' if rc['gap'] else 'fail'}.\n",
            f"- Overall: {'OK' if rc['ok'] else 'needs benchWorld tuning'}.\n",
        ]
    if 'budgets' in m:
        lines.append("\n## Budget scaling\n")
        for budget in ('time', 'compute'):
            best = max(CHANNELS, key=lambda ch: m['budgets'][budget][ch]['64']['mean'])
            val = m['budgets'][budget][best]['64']['mean']
            lines.append(f"- Fixed **{budget}** at 64 agents: highest mean welfare/agent-s is **{best}** ({val:.3f}).\n")
    lines.append("\nRe-run: `nbdev-test --n-workers 0 nbs/demo_harness.ipynb` (quick) or add `--flags slow` (full). Spec: `specs/multiagent/phase7/`.\n")
    return ''.join(lines)

import numpy as np
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_close
from explRL.bench_metrics import (periods, recovery, trueRates, beliefs, goalSpread, discoveryRows, discoveries,
                                  freeRiding, findTime, overlap, followTime, benchMetrics)
from explRL.credit import runCredit
from explRL.harness_runs import HarnessConfig, benchWorld, runHarness
from explRL.team_refs import ledgerArrays

def row(i, t, loc, patch, h, kind='stay'):
    return (i, float(t), 1.0, kind, loc, patch, float(h), float(h), float(t), float(t) + 1.0)

# recovery: one agent; on the patch for t = 45..79 (period 1 recovers at 9 s: the first 10 s window with
# at least 5 of 10 points at distance 0), off it in period 2 (censored at 40 s)
w = benchWorld(nPatches=1, nDanger=0, intake=(5.0,), patchSites=[0], dangerSites=[], Tmove=40.0)
w.reset(0, 1)
w.ledger = [row(0, t, 0, 0, 0.85) for t in range(45, 80)] + [row(0, t, 0, None, 0.0) for t in range(80, 120)]
L = ledgerArrays(w.ledger)
test_eq(periods(w, 120.0), [(1, 40.0, 80.0), (2, 80.0, 120.0)])
test_close(recovery(w, L, 1, 120.0, 0.5), (24.5, 0.5))

# discoveries, follow time, find time: agent 0 finds the patch at site 5 (t = 41), agent 1 follows 1 s later;
# a zero harvest and a non-patch stay are not discoveries; in period 2 agent 1 finds it at 81, nobody follows
w = benchWorld(nPatches=1, nDanger=0, intake=(5.0,), patchSites=[5], dangerSites=[], Tmove=40.0)
w.reset(0, 3)
w.ledger = [row(0, 41, 5, 0, 0.5), row(1, 42, 5, 0, 0.5), row(2, 43, 5, 0, 0.0), row(2, 44, 7, None, 0.0),
            row(1, 81, 5, 0, 0.5)]
L = ledgerArrays(w.ledger)
test_eq(discoveryRows(w, L).tolist(), [0, 4]); test_eq(discoveries(w, L).tolist(), [1, 1, 0])
test_close(followTime(w, L, 120.0), (1.0 + (120.0 - 81.0)) / 2)
test_close(findTime(w, L, 120.0), (1.0 + 1.0) / 2)                  # moved patch first harvested 1 s after each move
# overlap: period 1, agents 0 and 1 share site 5 and agent 2 visited {5, 7}: pairs 1, 1/2, 1/2; period 2, only
# agent 1 stayed anywhere: its two pairs score 0 (the idle pair has an empty union and is skipped)
test_close(overlap(w, L, 3, 120.0), np.mean([1.0, 0.5, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0]))

# free riding: harvest shares (1, 2, 3, 4) against discovery shares (4, 3, 2, 1) give -1; nan below 4 agents
Lf = ledgerArrays([row(i, 0, 0, 0, i + 1) for i in range(4)])
test_close(freeRiding(Lf, np.array([4, 3, 2, 1]), 4), -1.0)
assert np.isnan(freeRiding(Lf, np.array([1, 0, 0]), 3))

# beliefs: three agents know site 0 (true solo rate min(c, intake) = 0.85) with 1, 2, 3; one agent thinks
# empty site 1 pays 5; diversity uses site 0 only, error both sites
w = benchWorld(nPatches=1, nDanger=0, intake=(2.0,), patchSites=[0], dangerSites=[]); w.reset(0, 3)

text:
Artifacts (gitignored): results/multiagent/liar/{quick,full}/ (trace_summary.json, accounting.csv, variants.json, report.md, liar.png); the full run’s trace_summary.json and variants.json are copied to specs/multiagent/phase15/. The replay reads Phase 10’s response cache (results/multiagent/llm/cache) through the cache-only client: a miss raises, nothing is spent, and no key or EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE is needed.
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV, rowKey, writeCSV
from explRL.clue_runs import runClueAny
from explRL.coop_grid import coopHash
from explRL.liar_grid import TRACE_PLAN, forecastCells, liarForecast, liarShareGrid, nChange, numpyChanges, traceGrid, _pairs
from explRL.liar_report import MEASURES, TERMS, figTrace, lossAccount, mechanics, traceSummaries, writeTrace
from explRL.liar_trace import VARIANTS, traceCells
from explRL.llm_budget import Budget
from explRL.llm_sched import runWorkload
from explRL.train import demo_artifact_dir

LIAR = 'multiagent/liar'
WORKERS = min(8, os.cpu_count() or 1)
CAP = 150.0
LLM = demo_artifact_dir(None, 'multiagent/llm')
ROOT = LLM.parents[2]
SPEC = ROOT / 'specs/multiagent/phase15'
SCALE_FULL = demo_artifact_dir('full', 'multiagent/scale')      # Phase 14 Part B: runs.csv and turns.jsonl
NUMPY14 = ROOT / 'results/multiagent/forecast/scale_numpy.json'   # the numpy forecast's rows
LIVE_SPEC = dict(kind='live', cache=str(LLM / 'cache'), cap=CAP, ledger=str(LLM / 'spend.jsonl'))


def gitCommit():
    try:
        return subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or 'unknown'
    except OSError:
        return 'unknown'


def committed(*paths):
    "Tracked by git and unchanged since the last commit."
    run = lambda *a: subprocess.run(['git', *a], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return all(run('ls-files', str(p)).stdout.strip() and not run('status', '--porcelain', str(p)).stdout.strip() for p in paths)


def accounting(name, runs):
    "Per board (N, seed): the measures and the eight terms, one CSV row each."
    return [dict(runner=name, N=N, seed=sd, **mechanics(d['liar'].trace, d['liar'].board, d['liar'].nLiar),
                 **lossAccount(d['clean'], d['liar'])) for N, s in sorted(_pairs(runs).items()) for sd, d in sorted(s.items()) if len(d) == 2]


def analyse(mode, haiku, numpy, variants):
    "Summaries, report, figure and the per-board accounting in results/multiagent/liar/<mode> (AC-3's exact sum checked)."
    out = demo_artifact_dir(mode, LIAR)
    S = traceSummaries(haiku, numpy, variants)
    meta = dict(mode=mode, planHash=coopHash(TRACE_PLAN), commit=gitCommit(), haikuCells=len(haiku), numpyCells=len(numpy),
                haikuSource='fake client' if mode == 'quick' else 'replayed from the response cache')
    acc = accounting('haiku', haiku) + accounting('numpy', numpy)
    assert all(abs(r['total'] - r['loss']) < 1e-12 for r in acc), 'the eight terms must sum to the honest loss'
    writeTrace(out / 'report.md', S, meta)
    figTrace(out, S)
    writeCSV(acc, out / 'accounting.csv')
    (out / 'trace_summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(meta, perN=S['perN'], change=S['change'], pooled=S['pooled'],
                                                            diff=S['diff'], hyp=S['hyp']),
                                                       indent=1, sort_keys=True, default=str) + '\n')
    (out / 'variants.json').write_text(json.dumps(S['variants'], indent=1, sort_keys=True, default=str) + '\n')
    return S, out


def short(cells, turns, seeds):
    return [dict(c, cfg=dict(c['cfg'], turns=turns)) for c in cells if c['seed'] in seeds]

text:
Part D (optional; --flags llm, EXPLRL_PHASE15_D=1, EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE=1; about 7 000 calls, about $3.20)
FR-D2: the variant is the one, among those passing H15-4, whose honest-loss change is closest to Haiku’s; none passes: no Part D. The first pass writes liar_predictions.json (numpy, seconds) and stops; commit it, then run again for the live cells and the score.

PRED = SPEC / 'liar_predictions.json'
full = demo_artifact_dir('full', LIAR)
if os.environ.get('EXPLRL_PHASE15_D') != '1' or not (full / 'trace_summary.json').exists():
    print('skipped: Part D needs EXPLRL_PHASE15_D=1, the full traces and the user\'s approval')
else:
    T, V = json.loads((full / 'trace_summary.json').read_text()), json.loads((full / 'variants.json').read_text())
    obs = T['change']['haiku']['loss']
    ok = {v: x for v, x in V.items() if x['honestLoss']['change']['sign'] == obs['sign']}
    if not ok:
        print('no variant passes H15-4: Part D is not run')
    elif not PRED.exists():
        best = min(ok, key=lambda v: abs(ok[v]['honestLoss']['change']['mean'] - obs['mean']))
        PRED.write_text(json.dumps(dict(variant=best, forecast=liarForecast(best, workers=WORKERS)), indent=1, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
        print(f'forecast written for variant {best}: commit {PRED.name}, then run this section again')
    else:
        assert committed(PRED), f'commit {PRED.name} before the live cells'
        assert os.environ.get('EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE') == '1', 'Part D makes live calls: set EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE=1'
        out = demo_artifact_dir('full', 'multiagent/liarD')
        res = runWorkload([('liarD', liarShareGrid())], LIVE_SPEC, 32, str(out / 'turns'), run=runClueAny)
        writeCSV(res['rows'], out / 'runs.csv')
        spent, ref = Budget(CAP, LIVE_SPEC['ledger']).spent(), (out / 'runs.csv').read_bytes()
        again = runWorkload([('liarD', liarShareGrid())], LIVE_SPEC, 32, str(out / 'turns'), run=runClueAny)
        writeCSV(again['rows'], out / 'runs.csv')               # the cached rerun: byte-identical and free
        assert (out / 'runs.csv').read_bytes() == ref and Budget(CAP, LIVE_SPEC['ledger']).spent() == spent
        clean = [r for r in readCSV(SCALE_FULL / 'runs.csv')
                 if r['study'] == 'scaleB' and r['level'] == 'baseline' and int(r['N']) in (8, 32)]
        got = numpyChanges(res['rows'] + clean, ('honestLoss',))['honestLoss']['change']
        pred = json.loads(PRED.read_text())
        score = dict(observed=got, predicted={k: v['change'] for k, v in pred['forecast'].items()},
                     agree={k: v['change']['sign'] == got['sign'] for k, v in pred['forecast'].items()})
        (out / 'score.json').write_text(json.dumps(score, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
        print(json.dumps(score, indent=1))

import json
import math
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV
from explRL.bench_stats import bootCI
from explRL.colony_report import signFlipExact, trendSlopes
from explRL.clue_report import summaries as clueSummaries
from explRL.coop_report import trackASummaries
from explRL.rl_report import rlSummaries
from explRL.fix_report import fixLogMetrics, fixSummaries
from explRL.scale_report import scaleSummaries, trustSummaries
from explRL.followup_report import summaries as followupSummaries
from explRL.llm_report import summaries
from explRL.team_time import marginalGain
from explRL.train import demo_artifact_dir

R = demo_artifact_dir(None, 'multiagent')
NEED = [R / 'bench/full/metrics.json', R / 'bench/full/runs.csv', R / 'safety/h3/metrics.json',
        R / 'safety/full/metrics.json', R / 'llm/full/runs.csv', R / 'llm/full/metrics.json']
HAVE = all(p.exists() for p in NEED)
print('saved results found' if HAVE else 'missing: ' + ', '.join(str(p.relative_to(R)) for p in NEED if not p.exists()))
COLORS = dict(none='tab:gray', blackboard='tab:blue', messages='tab:orange', hierarchical='tab:green')
CH = tuple(COLORS)


def ci(x):
    x = np.asarray([v for v in x if not math.isnan(v)], float)
    return float(x.mean()), *bootCI(x)


def fmt(m, lo, hi, d=3):
    return f'{m:.{d}f} [{lo:.{d}f}, {hi:.{d}f}]'
if HAVE:
    bench = json.loads((R / 'bench/full/metrics.json').read_text())
    h3 = json.loads((R / 'safety/h3/metrics.json').read_text())
    safety = json.loads((R / 'safety/full/metrics.json').read_text())
    llmMeta = json.loads((R / 'llm/full/metrics.json').read_text())
    benchRows = [r for r in readCSV(R / 'bench/full/runs.csv') if r['study'] == 'main']
    llmRows = readCSV(R / 'llm/full/runs.csv')
    S10 = summaries([r for r in llmRows if r['runner'] == 'llm'], [r for r in llmRows if r['runner'] == 'numpy'])
    out = R / 'report'
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    opt = lambda q: readCSV(R / q) if (R / q).exists() else []
    teamRate8 = opt('bench/teamrate/runs.csv')                  # Phase 8 main grid rerun with team rates (post hoc)
    followRows = opt('followup/full/runs.csv') + opt('followup/numpy/runs.csv') + opt('followup/pilot/runs.csv')
    SF = followupSummaries(followRows, llmRows) if followRows else None
    clueRows = opt('clue/full/runs.csv')
    SC = clueSummaries([r for r in clueRows if r['runner'] == 'llm'], [r for r in clueRows if r['study'] == 'clueNumpy']) if clueRows else None
    coopRows = opt('coop/full/runs.csv')
    SA = trackASummaries(coopRows, clueRows) if coopRows and clueRows else None
    rlRows = opt('rl/eval/runs.csv')
    SB = rlSummaries(rlRows, [r for r in clueRows if r['runner'] == 'llm'],
                     [r for r in clueRows if r['study'] == 'clueNumpy']) if rlRows and clueRows else None
    fixRows, voteRows = opt('fix/full/runs.csv'), opt('profile/full/runs.csv')
    fixLogs = R / 'fix/full/turns.jsonl'
    SF13 = fixSummaries(fixRows, clueRows, fixLogMetrics([json.loads(x) for x in open(fixLogs)]) if fixLogs.exists() else {},
                        voteRows) if fixRows and clueRows else None
    trustRows, scaleRows = opt('trust/full/runs.csv'), opt('scale/full/runs.csv')
    ST = trustSummaries(fixRows, trustRows) if trustRows and fixRows else None
    SS = scaleSummaries(scaleRows) if scaleRows else None
    liarJ = R / 'liar/full/trace_summary.json'
    SL = json.loads(liarJ.read_text()) if liarJ.exists() else None    # Phase 15 traces (demo_liar)
    SLV = json.loads((R / 'liar/full/variants.json').read_text()) if SL else None
    p16J = R / 'rl/eval_p16/summary.json'
    S16 = json.loads(p16J.read_text()) if p16J.exists() else None    # Phase 16 (demo_rl16)
    c17, s17 = R / 'rl/eval_p17s0/curves.json', R / 'rl/pilot_p17/selection.json'
    C17 = json.loads(c17.read_text()) if c17.exists() else None      # Phase 17 step 0 (demo_rl17)
    P17 = json.loads(s17.read_text()) if s17.exists() else None      # Phase 17 pilot selection
    m17 = R / 'rl/eval_p17/summary.json'
    M17 = json.loads(m17.read_text()) if m17.exists() else None      # Phase 17 main runs (demo_rl17)
    m18 = R / 'colony/stage1/metrics.json'
    S18 = json.loads(m18.read_text())['summary'] if m18.exists() else None   # Phase 18 Stage 1 (demo_colony)
    m32 = R / 'colony/stage32/metrics.json'
    S32 = json.loads(m32.read_text())['summary'] if m32.exists() else None   # Phase 18, guards at 32 agents (deviation)
    m64 = R / 'colony/stage64/metrics.json'
    S64 = json.loads(m64.read_text())['summary'] if m64.exists() else None   # Phase 18, guards at 64 agents (second deviation)
    m4s = R / 'colony/stage4/metrics.json'
    S4 = json.loads(m4s.read_text())['summary'] if m4s.exists() else None    # Phase 18, Stage 4 (guards that scale)
    SQ4 = None                                   # the squads' own trend over 16-64 agents: each seed's slope over log2 N (descriptive)
    if S4 is not None:
        rows4 = sum((readCSV(R / f'colony/{x}/runs.csv') for x in ('stage1', 'stage32', 'stage64', 'stage4')), [])
        sl4 = list(trendSlopes(rows4, 'squads', [16, 64]).values())
        SQ4 = dict(slope=float(np.mean(sl4)), p=min(1.0, 2 * min(signFlipExact(sl4, 'greater'), signFlipExact(sl4, 'less'))),
                   rising=sum(v > 0 for v in sl4), n=len(sl4))
    b18, e18 = R / 'rl/eval_p18/summary.json', R / 'rl/colab/eval_p18/runs.csv'
    SPB = json.loads(b18.read_text()) if b18.exists() else None             # Phase 18, Part B (demo_rl18)
    EPB = readCSV(e18) if e18.exists() else []                              # its evaluation rows (the warm start's baseline)
    m3s = R / 'colony/stage3/metrics.json'
    S3 = json.loads(m3s.read_text())['summary'] if m3s.exists() else None    # Phase 18, Stage 3 (Claude liars, volunteers)
    rl13Rows = opt('rl/eval_p13/runs.csv')
    SB13 = rlSummaries(rl13Rows, [r for r in clueRows if r['runner'] == 'llm'],
                       [r for r in clueRows if r['study'] == 'clueNumpy']) if rl13Rows and clueRows else None

Figures

def scalingFig(path):
    "Phase 8: welfare per agent-second vs team size per channel, fixed compute and fixed world time."
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4), sharey=True)
    for ax, b in zip(axs, ('compute', 'time')):
        for ch in CH:
            Ns = sorted({int(r['N']) for r in benchRows})
            st = [ci([r['perAgentSecond'] for r in benchRows if r['channel'] == ch and r['budget'] == b and int(r['N']) == N]) for N in Ns]
            m = np.array([s[0] for s in st])
            ax.errorbar(Ns, m, yerr=[m - [s[1] for s in st], [s[2] for s in st] - m], label=ch, color=COLORS[ch], marker='o', capsize=2)
        ax.set(xscale='log', xlabel='team size N', title=f'fixed {"compute (N x T constant)" if b == "compute" else "world time"}')
        ax.set_xticks(Ns, [str(N) for N in Ns]); ax.minorticks_off()
    axs[0].set_ylabel('welfare per agent-second'); axs[0].legend(fontsize=8)
    fig.suptitle('Phase 8: numpy bandit teams (30 seeds)'); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(path, dpi=110); plt.close(fig)


def robustnessFig(path):
    "Phase 9: honest agents' relative welfare loss vs share of liars, per channel, N = 16 and 64."
    loss = safety['tables']['attackLoss']
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4), sharey=True)
    for ax, N in zip(axs, (16, 64)):
        for ch in CH:
            pts = sorted((int(k.split('/')[3]) / N, v['loss']) for k, v in loss.items()
                         if k.startswith(f'{ch}/{N}/liar/'))
            if pts:
                x, m = [0.0] + [p[0] for p in pts], np.array([0.0] + [p[1][0] for p in pts])
                lo, hi = np.array([0.0] + [p[1][1] for p in pts]), np.array([0.0] + [p[1][2] for p in pts])
                ax.errorbar(x, m, yerr=[m - lo, hi - m], label=ch, color=COLORS[ch], marker='o', capsize=2)
        ax.set(xlabel='share of liars in the team', title=f'N = {N}'); ax.axhline(0, color='k', lw=0.5)
    axs[0].set_ylabel("honest agents' welfare loss (share)"); axs[0].legend(fontsize=8)
    fig.suptitle('Phase 9: robustness to liars (10 seeds)'); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(path, dpi=110); plt.close(fig)


def llmFig(path):
    "Phase 10: welfare per agent-turn vs team size per channel, task board and text foraging (Claude Haiku 5.5)."
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))
    for ax, task in zip(axs, ('board', 'forage')):
        for ch in CH:
            pts = sorted((N, s) for (t, c, N), s in S10['main'].items() if t == task and c == ch)
            m = np.array([p[1]['mean'] for p in pts])
            err = [m - [p[1]['ci'][0] for p in pts], [p[1]['ci'][1] for p in pts] - m]
            ax.errorbar([p[0] for p in pts], m, yerr=err, label=ch, color=COLORS[ch], marker='o', capsize=2)
        rho = S10['numpy'][task]
        ax.set(xscale='log', xlabel='team size N', ylabel='welfare per agent-turn',
               title=f"{'task board' if task == 'board' else 'text foraging'} (numpy-LLM rho {rho['rho']:.2f})")
        ax.set_xticks([1, 2, 4, 8], ['1', '2', '4', '8']); ax.minorticks_off(); ax.axhline(0, color='k', lw=0.5)
    axs[0].legend(fontsize=8)
    fig.suptitle('Phase 10: Claude Haiku 5.5 teams (5 seeds, 50 turns per agent)'); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(path, dpi=110)
    plt.close(fig)


def teamFig(path):
    "Team totals (post hoc): Phase 8 team total vs N (both budgets), Phase 8 cumulative harvest over time, Phase 10 team totals."
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4))
    Ns = sorted({int(r['N']) for r in benchRows})
    for ch in CH:
        for b, ls in (('compute', '-'), ('time', '--')):
            m = [ci([r['welfare'] for r in benchRows if r['channel'] == ch and r['budget'] == b and int(r['N']) == N])[0] for N in Ns]
            axs[0].plot(Ns, m, ls, color=COLORS[ch], marker='o', ms=3, label=ch if b == 'compute' else None)
        rs = [r for r in teamRate8 if r['channel'] == ch and r['budget'] == 'time' and int(r['N']) == 16]
        K = min((sum(k.startswith('teamRate_') and r[k] == r[k] for k in r) for r in rs), default=0)
        if K:
            axs[1].plot(40 * np.arange(1, K + 1), np.mean([[r[f'teamRate_{k}'] * 40 for k in range(K)] for r in rs], 0).cumsum(),
                        color=COLORS[ch], marker='.', label=ch)
        for task, ls in (('board', '-'), ('forage', '--')):
            pts = sorted((N, s['team']['mean']) for (t, c, N), s in S10['main'].items() if t == task and c == ch)
            axs[2].plot([x for x, _ in pts], [y for _, y in pts], ls, color=COLORS[ch], marker='o', ms=3)
    axs[0].set(xscale='log', xlabel='team size N', ylabel='team total (net harvest)', title='Phase 8 team total')
    axs[0].set_xticks(Ns, [str(N) for N in Ns]); axs[0].minorticks_off(); axs[0].legend(fontsize=7)
    axs[1].set(xlabel='world time (s)', ylabel='team harvest, cumulative', title='Phase 8 harvest over time (N = 16)')
    axs[1].legend(fontsize=7)
    axs[2].set(xscale='log', xlabel='team size N', ylabel='team total', title='Phase 10 team total')
    axs[2].set_xticks([1, 2, 4, 8], ['1', '2', '4', '8']); axs[2].minorticks_off()
    fig.suptitle('Team totals (post hoc). Left: solid = fixed compute, dashed = fixed world time. Right: solid = task board, dashed = text foraging', fontsize=10)
    fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(path, dpi=110); plt.close(fig)


if HAVE:
    scalingFig(out / 'scaling.png'); robustnessFig(out / 'robustness.png'); llmFig(out / 'llm.png')
    if teamRate8:
        teamFig(out / 'team.png')

def teamSection():
    "Section 5: team totals (post hoc), from the saved rows."
    if not teamRate8:
        return []
    tt = lambda ch, b, N: ci([r['welfare'] for r in benchRows if r['channel'] == ch and r['budget'] == b and int(r['N']) == N])
    g = marginalGain([r for r in llmRows if r['study'] == 'main' and r['runner'] == 'llm'])
    return ['## 5. Team totals (post hoc)', '', '![team](report/team.png)', '',
            'Per-agent welfare must fall when patches have limited capacity; the team total shows whether more agents still add '
            'food. At fixed compute the two rank teams identically (the total is per-agent welfare times a constant). At fixed '
            f"world time (Phase 8) the blackboard team's total grows from {fmt(*tt('blackboard', 'time', 1), d=0)} with one agent to "
            f"{fmt(*tt('blackboard', 'time', 16), d=0)} at N = 16 and {fmt(*tt('blackboard', 'time', 64), d=0)} at N = 64, against "
            f"{fmt(*tt('none', 'time', 64), d=0)} without a channel at N = 64. On the Phase 10 task board each added agent still adds "
            f"value with the claim board (marginal gain {g[('board', 'blackboard', 8)]:.1f} per added agent from 4 to 8) but much "
            f"less without one ({g[('board', 'none', 8)]:.1f}).", '']


def followSection():
    "Section 6: the follow-up runs after Phase 10, when saved."
    if SF is None:
        return []
    e, n, l = SF['effort'], SF['numpy'], SF['llm']
    L = ['## 6. Follow-up runs after Phase 10 (exploratory)', '',
         '- **Hard board (D1):** paused. Claude Haiku 5.5 solved 91-98% of the puzzles it opened even at difficulty 10 and 12, so '
         'no level reached the planned 30-70% band; the puzzles are to be redesigned.']
    if e.get('Sonnet minus Haiku, effort medium', {}).get('n'):
        L.append(f"- **Model size at matched effort (D2):** Sonnet's blackboard benefit minus Haiku's at N = 4: effort low "
                 f"{fmt(e['Sonnet minus Haiku, effort low']['mean'], *e['Sonnet minus Haiku, effort low']['ci'], d=2)}, effort medium "
                 f"{fmt(e['Sonnet minus Haiku, effort medium']['mean'], *e['Sonnet minus Haiku, effort medium']['ci'], d=2)}.")
    if n['cells']:
        best = n['diff'].get((8, 'squads|beta=inf'))
        L.append(f"- **Rounds and soft territories, numpy (B-numpy):** at N = 8, squads that stay home earn "
                 f"{fmt(best['mean'], *best['ci'], d=3)} more per agent-second than the event-driven team; synchronous rounds alone "
                 f"cost welfare at every size, and at 32-64 agents no squad arm comes back to the event-driven level.")
    if l['diff'].get('rounds - events: welfare', {}).get('n'):
        sq = [k for k in l['diff'] if k.startswith('squads') and k.endswith(': welfare')]
        L.append(f"- **Rounds and squads, LLM (B-LLM, N = 8):** rounds minus event-driven "
                 f"{fmt(l['diff']['rounds - events: welfare']['mean'], *l['diff']['rounds - events: welfare']['ci'], d=2)}" +
                 (f"; squads minus rounds {fmt(l['diff'][sq[0]]['mean'], *l['diff'][sq[0]]['ci'], d=2)}" if sq else '') +
                 ' (welfare per agent-turn).')
    return L + ['', 'Details: `specs/multiagent/speedup/README.md`, `results/multiagent/followup/*/report.md`.', '']


def clueSection():
    "Section 7: Phase 11, the clue board, when saved."
    if SC is None:
        return []
    m, b, li = SC['main'], SC['benefit'], SC['liar']
    w = lambda ch, N: m[(ch, N)]['welfare']
    return ['## 7. Phase 11: the clue board (exploratory)', '',
            'Each subtask\'s answer is fixed by two modular clues ("x mod 7 = 3") dealt to different agents, so nobody can solve '
            'it alone and sharing (which costs a turn) is load-bearing. Claude Haiku 5.5, 4 channels x N 2, 4, 8, seeds 900-904; '
            'plan frozen before the runs (`CLUE_PLAN`).', '',
            f"- **Sharing is load-bearing for LLM teams too:** the blackboard adds {fmt(b[('blackboard', 4)]['mean'], *b[('blackboard', 4)]['ci'], d=2)} "
            f"welfare per agent-turn over no channel at N = 4 (blackboard {w('blackboard', 4)['mean']:.2f}, none {w('none', 4)['mean']:.2f}), "
            f"and keeps it to N = 8 ({fmt(b[('blackboard', 8)]['mean'], *b[('blackboard', 8)]['ci'], d=2)}).",
            f"- **Messages decay with team size**, as for rule agents: benefit {b[('messages', 2)]['mean']:.2f}, {b[('messages', 4)]['mean']:.2f}, "
            f"{b[('messages', 8)]['mean']:.2f} at N = 2, 4, 8.",
            f"- **The coordinator fails with LLM agents** (benefit {b[('hierarchical', 4)]['mean']:.2f} at N = 4), although it was the "
            'best channel for rule agents at scale: it routes a clue only to agents who have that subtask open when it is shared, '
            'and Haiku ignored its suggestion in 62% of its opens, so few shared clues reached anyone (routed clues showed in 74 of 800 observations at N = 4).',
            f"- **Numpy predicts LLM** well here: Spearman rho {SC['numpy']['rho']:.2f} [{SC['numpy']['ci'][0]:.2f}, {SC['numpy']['ci'][1]:.2f}] "
            'over the 12 (channel, N) cells; the coordinator cells are the main misses.',
            f"- **Liar:** one false-clue liar among 4 costs the honest agents {fmt(li['honest loss, blackboard']['mean'], *li['honest loss, blackboard']['ci'], d=2)} "
            f"on the blackboard and {fmt(li['honest loss, messages']['mean'], *li['honest loss, messages']['ci'], d=2)} with messages; the "
            'blackboard-minus-messages sign agrees with H3, but its interval includes zero (3 seeds).',
            '- **Framing** (team vs own reward wording) changed nothing clear.', '',
            'Details: `specs/multiagent/phase11/README.md`, `results/multiagent/clue/full/report.md`.', '']


def coopSection():
    "Section 8: Phase 12, Track A, when saved."
    if SA is None:
        return []
    e = SA['effect']
    f = lambda v, ch, N: fmt(e[(v, ch, N)]['mean'], *e[(v, ch, N)]['ci'], d=2)
    return ['## 8. Phase 12, Track A: better instructions for Claude (exploratory)', '',
            'Three changes to the Phase 11 clue board for Claude Haiku 5.5, compared paired on seed with the Phase 11 runs '
            '(seeds 900-904; plan frozen before the runs, `TRACKA_PLAN`). Welfare per agent-turn, change from Phase 11:', '',
            f"- **Telling agents to follow the coordinator made the team worse:** {f('A1', 'hierarchical', 4)} at N = 4, "
            f"{f('A1', 'hierarchical', 8)} at N = 8. Haiku then followed it almost always, but opened subtasks it knew nothing "
            'about and waited for clues the coordinator does not pass on.',
            f"- **Passing on the coordinator's collected clues helped:** {f('A2', 'hierarchical', 4)} at N = 4, "
            f"{f('A2', 'hierarchical', 8)} at N = 8, though the coordinator still trails the blackboard.",
            f"- **Showing who works on what did little:** {f('A3', 'blackboard', 4)} on the blackboard at N = 4.", '',
            'A coordinator helps by moving information, not by giving orders. Track B (RL training of an open model on the '
            'same board) is section 9. Details: `specs/multiagent/phase12/README.md`, `results/multiagent/coop/full/report.md`.', '']


def rlSection():
    "Section 9: Phase 12, Track B, when saved."
    if SB is None:
        return []
    m, g, s, i, x, p = SB['main'], SB['gain'], SB['schemes'], SB['info'], SB['cross'], SB['phase11']
    d = lambda v: fmt(v['mean'], *v['ci'], d=2)
    w = lambda k: d(m[k]['welfare'])
    if (R / 'rl/eval/coop_main.png').exists():
        shutil.copy(R / 'rl/eval/coop_main.png', out / 'rl_main.png')
    return ['## 9. Phase 12, Track B: training an open model to cooperate (exploratory)', '', '![rl](report/rl_main.png)', '',
            'Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct on the same clue board (4 agents, blackboard, 15 boards; plan frozen before the runs, `RL_PLAN` '
            'version 2): a warm start imitating the rule agents, then 60 steps of RL on a LoRA adapter under three rewards: '
            'individual (own solves), team (the team\'s score) and credit (the solves that one\'s moves enabled). One training run '
            'per reward. Welfare per agent-turn:', '',
            f"- **Imitation did the teaching:** untrained {m['untrained']['welfare']['mean']:.3f}, warm start {w('warm')} "
            f"(Haiku minus warm start {fmt(-p['warm - Haiku']['mean'], -p['warm - Haiku']['ci'][1], -p['warm - Haiku']['ci'][0], d=2)}).",
            f"- **RL did not beat the warm start** (change from it): credit {d(g['credit'])}, individual {d(g['individual'])}, "
            f"team {d(g['team'])}.",
            f"- **Individual reward taught selfishness:** shares per held clue fell from {i['warm']['sharePerHeld']['mean']:.2f} "
            f"to {i['individual']['sharePerHeld']['mean']:.2f}, and {i['individual']['soloShare']['mean']:.0%} of its solves were "
            f"guesses ({i['individual']['wrongPerSolve']['mean']:.1f} wrong answers per solve).",
            '- **Team reward was unstable:** with no way to tell whose move helped, training collapsed mid-run and the stopping '
            'rule halted it at step 56; the evaluated adapter is that run\'s last, degenerate one.',
            f"- **Credit reward kept cooperation intact:** credit minus individual {d(s['credit - individual'])}, minus team "
            f"{d(s['credit - team'])}; with three trained agents and one Haiku it was the best partner "
            f"({d(x['credit cross3 - all Haiku'])} against an all-Haiku team; warm start {d(x['warm cross3 - all Haiku'])}).", '',
            'Better instructions (Track A) and imitation helped; RL did not improve cooperation, and the wrong reward destroyed '
            'it. Credit assignment is what kept RL from harming the team. Details: `specs/multiagent/phase12/README.md`, '
            '`results/multiagent/rl/eval/report.md`.' + (' **Revised by section 10:** a second training seed of credit reward gained '
                                                          'about 0.1 over the warm start where the first gained nothing; with two '
                                                          'seeds per design, whether RL beats imitation is not settled.' if SB13 else ''), '']


def fixSection():
    "Section 10: Phase 13 (fixes for Claude teams; RL with the loophole priced), when saved."
    if SF13 is None:
        return []

         f"lower belief diversity: the herding side of H2.",

import numpy as np
from explRL.clue_runs import *
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig
from explRL.llm_grid import llmCell, quickGrid

W = dict(m=3, r=1, R=105)
cfg = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=40, world=W)
r = runClueNumpy(cfg, 900)[0]
for k in ('welfare', 'teamWelfare', 'teamRate_0', 'solved', 'guesses', 'shares', 'sharePerHeld', 'redundantShares',
          'assisted', 'shareToUse', 'pooledShare', 'sharerReward', 'nonSharerReward'):
    assert k in r, k
assert abs(r['teamWelfare'] - r['welfare'] * 4 * 40) < 1e-9 and r['shares'] > 0 and 0 < r['pooledShare'] < 1
assert abs(sum(r[f'teamRate_{k}'] for k in range(4)) * 10 - r['teamWelfare']) < 1e-9          # 40 turns = 4 periods of 10
assert runClueNumpy(cfg, 900) == runClueNumpy(cfg, 900)                     # deterministic per seed
none = runClueNumpy(LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='none', N=4, turns=40, world=W), 900)[0]
assert none['shares'] == 0 and none['solved'] == 0          # no channel, no guessing: no agent ever holds all clues (r m <= N (m - 1))
liar = runClueNumpy(LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=4, nLiar=1, turns=40, world=W), 900)[0]
assert liar['falseShares'] > 0 and liar['welfareHonest'] != liar['welfare']

# hand-made: the share-to-use time and assisted solves on a scripted sequence
from explRL.clueboard import ClueBoardEnv
b = ClueBoardEnv(1, 3, m=3, r=1, R=105, life=100)
k = b.open[0]; s = b.tasks[k]; solver = 0
miss = [j for j, hs in enumerate(s.holders) if solver not in hs]
b.apply(solver, ('open', k), 0.0)
for t, j in enumerate(miss, start=1):
    b.apply(next(iter(s.holders[j])), ('share', (k, j, s.task.clue(j)[1])), float(t))
b.apply(solver, ('submit', s.task.x), 5.0)
from explRL.clue_runs import _shareToUse
assert b.solveLog[0][3] and _shareToUse(b) == np.mean([5.0 - t for t in range(1, len(miss) + 1)])

# runClueAny: clue cells to the clue runners, other cells unchanged
c = llmCell('clueNumpy', 'clueNumpy', 'clue', 4, 900, runner='numpy', task='clue', channel='blackboard', turns=10, world=W)
row = runClueAny(c)[0]
assert row['study'] == 'clueNumpy' and row['task'] == 'clue' and 'shares' in row
other = [x for x in quickGrid() if x['runner'] == 'numpy'][0]
assert runClueAny(other) == __import__('explRL.llm_grid', fromlist=['runAnyCell']).runAnyCell(other)

# LLM runs with the fake client: rows with the information and interface columns; turn log
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply
rows, log = runClue(LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=6, world=W), 900,
                    LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply)))
r = rows[0]
assert r['calls'] == 24 and len(log) == 24 and r['invalid'] < 24 and 'shares' in r and 'reportShare' in r
rl, _ = runClue(LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='messages', N=4, nLiar=1, turns=6, world=W), 900, LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply)))
assert rl[0]['calls'] == 18 and rl[0]['falseShares'] > 0
c = llmCell('clue', 'clue', 'clue', 4, 900, task='clue', channel='hierarchical', turns=4, world=W)
row = runClueAny(c)[0]
assert row['study'] == 'clue' and row['calls'] == 16

# Track A options travel in cfg.world (AC-2); without them the rows are unchanged
base = runClue(LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='hierarchical', N=4, turns=6, world=W), 900, LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply)))
again = runClue(LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='hierarchical', N=4, turns=6, world=dict(W)), 900, LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply)))
assert base == again
for opt in (dict(hint='follow'), dict(passPooled=True), dict(showOpen=True)):
    rows, log = runClue(LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='hierarchical', N=4, turns=6, world={**W, **opt}), 900,
                        LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply)))
    assert rows[0]['calls'] == 24
    if 'showOpen' in opt:
        assert all('Teammates working on:' in x['obs'] for x in log)
    b, ch = clueSetup(LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='hierarchical', N=4, world={**W, **opt}), 900)
    assert ch.passPooled == ('passPooled' in opt)

import json
from explRL.scale_grid import *
from explRL.bench_grid import rowKey
from explRL.clue_grid import BOARD, CLUE_SETTINGS
from explRL.coop_grid import coopHash
from explRL.fix_grid import FIX_ARMS, fixEstimate, fixGrid, requestKey
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig, cellRow

key = lambda c: rowKey(cellRow(c, LLMConfig.fromDict(c['cfg']), dict(episode=0)))
lv = lambda c: c['level']
# Part A (AC-3): 2 new arms x {clean, one liar} x N 4 x seeds 900-909, 40 turns, Phase 13's board and settings
t = trustGrid()
assert len(t) == 2 * 2 * 10 and len({key(c) for c in t}) == len(t) and all(c['study'] == 'trustA' for c in t)
assert {lv(c) for c in t} == {'recordPrivate', 'recordPrivate|liar', 'verifyPublic', 'verifyPublic|liar'}
for c in t:
    cfg, w = c['cfg'], c['cfg']['world']
    assert (cfg['channel'], cfg['turns'], cfg['model'], c['N'], cfg['nLiar']) == ('blackboard', 40, HAIKU, 4, lv(c).endswith('|liar'))
    assert {k: w[k] for k in BOARD} == {k: CLUE_SETTINGS[k] for k in BOARD}
    assert {k: v for k, v in w.items() if k not in BOARD} == FIX_ARMS[lv(c).split('|')[0]]
for x in {lv(c) for c in t}:
    assert sorted(c['seed'] for c in t if lv(c) == x) == list(range(900, 910))     # shared seeds
# ... the same cells as Phase 13's A2 arms except the arm's setting (study, level and the option differ)
f13 = {(c['level'], c['seed']): c for c in fixGrid()}
for c in t:
    ref = f13[(lv(c).replace('recordPrivate', 'record').replace('verifyPublic', 'verify'), c['seed'])]
    strip = lambda c: {k: v for k, v in c['cfg']['world'].items() if k not in ('record', 'check')}
    assert {k: v for k, v in c['cfg'].items() if k != 'world'} == {k: v for k, v in ref['cfg'].items() if k != 'world'}
    assert strip(c) == strip(ref) and requestKey(c) != requestKey(ref)
e = scaleEstimate(t)
assert e['calls'] == e['newCalls'] == 20 * 160 + 20 * 120 == 5600 and 1.2 < e['newCost'] < 2.2, e   # about $1.70

# Part B (AC-3): N 8, 16, 32; clean baseline and request; baseline and record with N // 4 liars; seeds 900-904
g = scaleGrid()
assert len(g) == 4 * 3 * 5 and len({key(c) for c in g}) == len(g) and all(c['study'] == 'scaleB' for c in g)
assert {c['N'] for c in g} == {8, 16, 32} and {c['seed'] for c in g} == set(range(900, 905))
assert all(c['cfg']['nLiar'] == (c['N'] // 4 if lv(c).endswith('|liar') else 0) for c in g)
assert {c['cfg']['nLiar'] for c in g if lv(c).endswith('|liar')} == {2, 4, 8}
assert {lv(c) for c in g} == {'baseline', 'request', 'baseline|liar', 'record|liar'}
assert all(c['cfg']['turns'] == 40 and c['cfg']['channel'] == 'blackboard' for c in g)
for x in {(lv(c), c['N']) for c in g}:
    assert sorted(c['seed'] for c in g if (lv(c), c['N']) == x) == list(range(900, 905))
# the N 8 clean baseline and request cells equal Phase 13's (same requests: cached); nothing else is
same = [c for c in g if requestKey(c) in {requestKey(x) for x in fixGrid()}]
assert sorted((lv(c), c['N'], c['seed']) for c in same) == sorted((a, 8, s) for a in SCALE_CLEAN for s in range(900, 905))
for c in same:
    ref = next(x for x in fixGrid() if requestKey(x) == requestKey(c))
    assert ref['N'] == 8 and ref['level'] == lv(c) and ref['cfg'] == c['cfg']
# the board grows with N: 2N + 2 open subtasks
from explRL.clue_runs import clueSetup
for N in SCALE_N:
    b, _ = clueSetup(LLMConfig.fromDict(next(c for c in g if c['N'] == N)['cfg']), 900)
    assert len(b.open) == 2 * N + 2
# calls: (N - liars) x 40 per cell; 39 200 in all, about 33 000 new; the pilot's two cells are cached for the main run
calls = lambda N, liar: (N - liar * (N // 4)) * 40
eg = scaleEstimate(g)
assert eg['calls'] == 5 * sum(2 * calls(N, 0) + 2 * calls(N, 1) for N in SCALE_N) == 39200
assert eg['newCalls'] == eg['calls'] - 5 * 2 * calls(8, 0) - calls(32, 0) - calls(32, 1) == 33760, eg
p = scalePilotGrid()
assert [(lv(c), c['N'], c['seed'], c['cfg']['nLiar']) for c in p] == [('baseline', 32, 900, 0), ('baseline|liar', 32, 900, 8)]
assert {requestKey(c) for c in p} <= {requestKey(c) for c in g} and all(c['study'] == 'scalePilot' for c in p)
ep = fixEstimate(p)
assert ep['calls'] == ep['newCalls'] == 32 * 40 + 24 * 40 == 2240
# the cost rule (FR-B2): full grid within $40, else N 32 on seeds 900-902, else stop and ask
cut = scaleGrid(seeds32=range(900, 903))
assert len(cut) == 4 * (5 + 5 + 3) and {c['seed'] for c in cut if c['N'] == 32} == {900, 901, 902}
nf, nc = scaleEstimate(g)['newCalls'], scaleEstimate(cut)['newCalls']
assert costRule(40.0 / nf)['verdict'] == 'run' and costRule(40.0 / nf)['cells'] == g
r = costRule(40.0 / nf * 1.01)
assert r['verdict'] == 'cut' and r['cells'] == cut and r['projected']['full'] > 40 >= r['projected']['cut']
r = costRule(40.0 / nc * 1.01)
assert r['verdict'] == 'stop' and r['cells'] is None
# quick grids: every cell kind, a few turns
assert {lv(c) for c in trustQuick()} == {lv(c) for c in t} and all(c['cfg']['turns'] == 6 for c in trustQuick())
assert len(scaleQuick()) == 12 and all(c['cfg']['turns'] == 3 for c in scaleQuick()) and all(c['cfg']['turns'] == 40 for c in g)
# the plans: version 1 (TRUST_PLAN frozen before Part A, hash pinned; SCALE_PLAN after the pilot), JSON-serialisable
from explRL.coop_grid import coopHash
assert TRUST_PLAN['frozen'] is True and coopHash(TRUST_PLAN) == '6d2818ae84c2'
assert SCALE_PLAN['frozen'] is True and coopHash(SCALE_PLAN) == 'b886baefb2ef'
for P in (TRUST_PLAN, SCALE_PLAN):
    assert P['version'] == 1 and P['exploratory'] is True
    assert coopHash(json.loads(json.dumps(P))) == coopHash(P)
assert set(TRUST_PLAN['analyses']) == {'lossRecovered', 'publicity', 'cost', 'difference', 'noLiarCost', 'mechanism'}
assert TRUST_PLAN['holm'] == ['recordPrivate', 'verifyPublic'] and TRUST_PLAN['arms']['world']['recordPrivate'] == dict(record='private')
assert set(SCALE_PLAN['analyses']) == {'request', 'record', 'baseline', 'forecast'}
assert SCALE_PLAN['costRule'] == dict(SCALE_PLAN['costRule'], budget=40.0, cutN=32, cutSeeds=[900, 902])
assert SCALE_PLAN['bands'] == dict(invalid=0.05, N=32) and SCALE_PLAN['holm'] == dict(request=[8, 16, 32], record=[8, 16, 32])
print(f"trustGrid {e['calls']} calls ${e['newCost']:.2f}; scaleGrid {eg['newCalls']} new calls (profile ${eg['newCost']:.2f}); "
      f"pilot {ep['calls']} calls (profile ${ep['cost']:.2f})")

import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV, runGrid, writeCSV
from explRL.followup_grid import (FOLLOWUP_PLAN, chooseBeta, chooseHard, effortGrid, followupHash, followupQuick, hardGrid,
                                  hardPilotGrid, roundsGrid, roundsNumpyGrid, runFollowupCell)
from explRL.followup_report import summaries, writeFigures, writeReport
from explRL.llm_budget import PRICES, Budget
from explRL.llm_grid import quickGrid
from explRL.llm_sched import mergeTiming, runWorkload, timingSummary
from explRL.team_time import teamRateCell, teamRateGrids
from explRL.train import demo_artifact_dir

DN = 'multiagent/followup'
WORKERS = min(8, os.cpu_count() or 1)          # fake-client and numpy workloads
LLM_WORKERS = 32                               # live workloads (decision SQ1; raised after the D1 pilot if retries allow)
CAP = 150.0
LLM = demo_artifact_dir(None, 'multiagent/llm')
LIVE = os.environ.get('EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE') == '1'
LIVE_SPEC = dict(kind='live', cache=str(LLM / 'cache'), cap=CAP, ledger=str(LLM / 'spend.jsonl'))
P10 = LLM / 'full' / 'runs.csv'


def gitCommit():
    try:
        return subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or 'unknown'
    except OSError:
        return 'unknown'


def run(mode, grids, spec, p10, workers=None):
    "Run a workload through runWorkload; write runs.csv, turns.jsonl, timing.jsonl, report.md, figures, metrics.json."
    out = demo_artifact_dir(mode, DN)
    logs = out / 'turns'
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    workers = workers or (LLM_WORKERS if spec.get('kind') == 'live' else WORKERS)
    t0 = time.time()
    res = runWorkload(grids, spec, workers, str(logs), run=runFollowupCell)
    rows, wall = res['rows'], time.time() - t0
    writeCSV(rows, out / 'runs.csv')
    with open(out / 'turns.jsonl', 'w') as f:
        for p in sorted(logs.glob('*.jsonl')) if logs.exists() else []:
            f.write(p.read_text())
    timing = timingSummary(mergeTiming(logs, out / 'timing.jsonl'), wall)
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    llm = [r for r in rows if r['runner'] == 'llm']
    models = sorted({r['model'] for r in llm})
    meta = dict(mode=mode, planHash=followupHash(), commit=gitCommit(), models=models, cap=CAP, wall=wall,
                pricesChecked=', '.join(sorted({PRICES[m]['checked'] for m in models})) or '-',
                cost=float(sum(r['cost'] for r in llm)), calls=int(sum(r['calls'] for r in llm)), retries=timing['retries'],
                spent=Budget(CAP, spec['ledger']).spent() if spec.get('ledger') else 0.0)
    arms = {}
    for key, sec in timing['runWall'].items():
        arms.setdefault(key.split('|')[2], []).append(sec)
    meta['runWall'] = {lv: sum(v) / len(v) for lv, v in arms.items()}
    S = summaries(rows, p10)
    writeReport(out / 'report.md', S, meta)
    writeFigures(out, rows, p10, S)
    (out / 'metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(meta, done=res['done'], refused=res['refused'], stopped=res['stopped'],
                                                      pooled=res['pooled'], workers=workers, timing=timing,
                                                      plan=FOLLOWUP_PLAN), indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str) + '\n')
    print(f"{mode}: {len(rows)} rows, {meta['calls']} calls, ${meta['cost']:.2f} for these runs, ${meta['spent']:.2f} spent "
          f"in all, {wall:.0f} s, {timing['callsPerSecond']:.1f} calls/s, {timing['retries']} retries; stopped: {res['stopped']}")
    return rows, S, meta, timing

title: explRL
text:
explRL began as a Python port of the navigation model in A neural circuit architecture for rapid learning in goal-directed navigation by Chuntao Dan, Brad K. Hulse, Ramya Kappagantula, Vivek Jayaraman and Ann M. Hermundstad (Neuron, 2024; open access): brain-inspired agents that explore a novel environment while mapping its value landscape, combining autonomous navigation, unsupervised environment mapping and reinforcement learning coupled with internal drives. The starting code was ported and modified from Ann M. Hermundstad’s MATLAB scripts, and the package reproduces the paper’s flexible policy (Fig. 2d-e), its pre-structured policy (Fig. 2h) and its circuit model (Figs. 3-5).
From Phase 5 on, the repository became a research program on teams of agents: numpy teams of explorer agents sharing a foraging world (Phases 5-9), then teams of up to 64 Claude Haiku 5.5 agents, and reinforcement learning of a 3B open model, on tasks no single agent can solve (Phases 10-18). The question throughout is what keeps a large team effective and safe when some of its members are wrong or lying.

title: explRL
section: Multi-agent research: large teams of language-model agents
text:
Multi-agent research: large teams of language-model agents
The results are written up in two preprints by Chuntao Dan and Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic): Guards, Squads and Incentives: Keeping Large Teams of Language-Model Agents Effective and Safe and Simulate First? What Cheap Rule-Agent Worlds Predict About Teams of Language-Model Agents. The highlights page redraws their main figures from the saved per-seed results. Five findings, strongest first:

Verification works as an assigned role. A quarter of the team assigned as guards, who post, confirm and contest clues and never solve, recovered 72% of the damage done by an equal number of liars with no ground truth (a track record computed from the true answers recovered 34%), and beat the unprotected team at every size from 8 to 64 Claude Haiku 5.5 agents.
Splitting a large team makes verification scale. Guards can contest only the clues they hold, so their advantage shrank as teams grew; squads of eight with their own guards made it grow instead, from 0.26 at 16 agents to 0.34 at 64, in all eight seeds.
Larger teams are more gullible. The share of answers built on a false clue rose from 0.79 at 8 agents to 0.91 at 32: agents treat a posted clue as settled.
Copies of one model do not divide labour on their own. No agent volunteered for an unassigned role, team-reward RL of a 3B model did not create one, and the reward decided whether trained copies kept cooperating.
Move information; do not add work. Mechanisms that pass on or certify information at no cost in turns helped; those that add work to every agent’s turn or demand obedience backfired.

Every analysis plan was frozen and committed before its runs, every API reply is cached so reruns are byte-identical, and every number and figure in the preprints is regenerated from the saved results (paper/make_assets.py, paper2/make_assets.py, tools/figures.py). Figures show mean ± SEM, with an asterisk at p < 0.05. The literature review checks each claim against published work.

title: explRL
text:
How to use
This package is in early development (alpha). Single agents (the paper’s three variants): the flexible policy (explRL.basis, flexibleAgent, policy-gradient RL), the pre-structured setpoint policy with bump jumps (explRL.prestructured) and the circuit model with Hebbian compass and goal weights (explRL.circuit); shared pieces are explRL.params, explRL.envs (heading and zone arenas), explRL.train and the explRL.core loaders. Teams: explRL.multi and explRL.members run teams on one event queue; the foraging benchmark and its safety study are in the explRL.bench_* and explRL.safety_* modules; the clue board, its channels and its runners in explRL.clueboard, explRL.clue_agents and explRL.clue_runs; colony rules, guards and squads in explRL.clue_colony, explRL.colony_agents and explRL.colony_board; the Claude client and its response cache in explRL.llm_client; RL of the 3B model in explRL.clue_rl and explRL.rl_torch; and the publication figures in explRL.figs_team and explRL.figs_rl. The documentation site lists every module.
For the full Fig. 2d-e reproduction, see Running the experiments above.
Example (build an agent and arena, then train briefly):

from math import pi
from explRL.core import loadAgent, loadEnv
from explRL.train import train_agent, evaluatePolicy

agent = loadAgent(goal=pi, seed=0)
env = loadEnv(goal=pi)
hist = train_agent(agent, env, Ttot=2.0)   # the paper uses 240 s
policy = evaluatePolicy(agent)            # drift rate, fixation duration and turn bias per heading

Example (rule agents on an 8-agent clue board, offline and deterministic: with no channel nobody can solve, a shared board pools the clues, and two scripted liars on that board cost the honest agents more than it gains them):

from explRL.clue_runs import runClueNumpy
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig

for channel, nLiar in (('none', 0), ('blackboard', 0), ('blackboard', 2)):
    cfg = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel=channel, N=8, nLiar=nLiar, turns=40, world=dict(m=2, r=1, R=30))
    r = runClueNumpy(cfg, 900)[0]
    print(f"{channel}, {nLiar} liars: honest welfare {r['welfareHonest']:.3f} per agent-turn, {r['solved']} subtasks solved")
# none, 0 liars: honest welfare 0.000 per agent-turn, 0 subtasks solved
# blackboard, 0 liars: honest welfare 0.500 per agent-turn, 73 subtasks solved
# blackboard, 2 liars: honest welfare -0.217 per agent-turn, 8 subtasks solved

import json
from explRL.clue_policy import *
from explRL.clue_agents import ClueBoard
from explRL.clue_text import CLUE_SCHEMA, TextClueEnv
from explRL.clueboard import ClueBoardEnv
from explRL.llm_agent import LLMMember
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply

# renderPrompt equals what LLMMember sends, for notes and full memory, framings and with or without history
b = ClueBoardEnv(1, 4, m=2, r=1, R=30); env = TextClueEnv(b); ch = ClueBoard()
for memory in ('notes', 'full'):
    for framing in ('own', 'team'):
        m = LLMMember(None, env, ch, memory, framing); m.id = 2
        for notes, past in (('', []), ('try T3', ['turn 0: opened T3, earned 0.00.', 'turn 1: waited, earned 0.00.'])):
            m.notes, m.past = notes, list(past)
            obs, system, blocks = m.prepare(b, 1.0)
            assert renderPrompt(env, obs, memory, notes, past, framing) == (system, blocks), (memory, framing, notes)
# parseReply: whole JSON, embedded JSON, junk
assert userText([{'type': 'text', 'text': 'a'}, {'type': 'text', 'text': 'Now:\nb'}]) == 'a\n\nNow:\nb'
assert parseReply('{"action": "wait"}') == {'action': 'wait'}
assert parseReply('Sure! {"action": "open", "target": "T1"} done') == {'action': 'open', 'target': 'T1'}
assert parseReply('[1, 2]') is None and parseReply('no json {here') is None and parseReply(None) is None
r = asReply('{"notes": "x", "action": "wait"}', usage=dict(output_tokens=5))
assert r.parsed['action'] == 'wait' and r.usage['output_tokens'] == 5 and r.cost == 0 and r.stopReason == 'end_turn'
# scripted and Claude (fake client) policies return one reply per request, in order
pol = scriptedPolicy(lambda s, bl: json.dumps(dict(action='wait', n=len(bl))))
out = pol([('s', [1]), ('s', [1, 2])])
assert [x.parsed['n'] for x in out] == [1, 2]
client = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
reqs = [renderPrompt(env, env.observe(i, 2.0, ch)) for i in range(4)]
seq = [client.complete(s, bl, CLUE_SCHEMA, task='clue').text for s, bl in reqs]
assert [x.text for x in claudePolicy(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply)), 3)(reqs)] == seq
# defaults unchanged: the clue schema and task 'clue', the same request as a direct call; a schema and task can be passed
c1, c2 = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply), timing=[]), LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
claudePolicy(c1)(reqs[:1]); c2.complete(*reqs[0], CLUE_SCHEMA, task='clue')
assert c1.client.requests == c2.client.requests == [c2.request(*reqs[0], CLUE_SCHEMA)] and c1.timing[0]['task'] == 'clue'
S = {'type': 'object', 'additionalProperties': False, 'required': ['vote', 'notes'],
     'properties': {'vote': {'type': 'string', 'enum': ['A', 'B']}, 'notes': {'type': 'string'}}}
c3 = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(['{"vote": "A", "notes": ""}']), timing=[])
assert claudePolicy(c3, 2, S, 'profile')(reqs[:2])[1].parsed['vote'] == 'A'
assert c3.client.requests[0]['output_config']['format']['schema'] == S and {x['task'] for x in c3.timing} == {'profile'}

import numpy as np
from explRL.rl17_train import *
from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17Config


# With the [train] extra, no download: at the defaults trainRL17 equals trainRL (metrics and final adapter) on the tiny model;
# a mixed step with liars and clipped passes runs; its checkpoint carries configHash17
import importlib.util
if all(importlib.util.find_spec(m) for m in ('transformers', 'peft', 'tokenizers')):   # the [train] extra; the docs build runs cells with imports and lacks it
    import json
    import tempfile
    import torch
    from dataclasses import asdict
    from explRL.clue_rl import RLConfig, trainRL
    import explRL.rl17_train as T
    from explRL.tiny_model import tinyModel
    from safetensors.torch import load_file
    _tr = T.trainingReturns
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        tiny = tinyModel(d + '/tiny')
        kw = dict(steps=2, seedsPerStep=2, group=3, turns=3, ckptEvery=1, maxNew=24, lr=1e-3, haltRun=99)
        import explRL.clue_rl as C
        for mod in (C, T):                       # the tiny model's replies are invalid: the same random returns stand in for both
            rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
            mod.trainingReturns = (lambda r: (lambda ro, *a: _tr(ro, *a) + r.normal(size=np.shape(ro.returns))))(rng)
            if mod is C:
                trainRL(RLConfig(tiny, f'{d}/a', **kw))
            else:
                trainRL17(RL17Config(tiny, f'{d}/b', **kw))
        strip = lambda p: [{k: v for k, v in json.loads(x).items() if 'Seconds' not in k and k not in ('cut', 'longest')} for x in open(p)]
        assert strip(f'{d}/a/metrics.jsonl') == strip(f'{d}/b/metrics.jsonl')
        wa, wb = load_file(f'{d}/a/final/adapter_model.safetensors'), load_file(f'{d}/b/final/adapter_model.safetensors')
        assert wa.keys() == wb.keys() and all(torch.equal(wa[k], wb[k]) for k in wa)
        T.trainingReturns = (lambda r: (lambda ro, *a: _tr(ro, *a) + r.normal(size=np.shape(ro.returns))))(np.random.default_rng(1))
        cm = RL17Config(tiny, f'{d}/m', **{**kw, 'seedsPerStep': 4}, mixN=((4, 0.5), (8, 0.5)), liarShare=0.5, epochs=2, clip=0.2, kl=0.0, lrFixed=1e-3,
                        valueOnly=True, tokenClip=True, maxLen=4096)
        trainRL17(cm)
        m = [json.loads(x) for x in open(f'{d}/m/metrics.jsonl')]
        assert [x['step'] for x in m] == [1, 2] and all(x['samples'] > 0 and np.isfinite(x['loss']) for x in m)
        assert all(x['cut'] == 0 and np.isfinite(x['klAll']) and 0 < x['longest'] <= 4096 for x in m)   # pilot v3's fix runs; nothing cut at 4096
        # Phase 18 Part B's fix: every token's k3 capped, so the logged KL (value tokens and all) can never exceed the cap
        ck = RL17Config(tiny, f'{d}/k', **{**kw, 'lr': 5e-2}, kl=0.04, lrFixed=5e-2, valueOnly=True, tokenClip=True, maxLen=4096,
                        klClamp=1e-4, haltKLRun=2)
        trainRL17(ck)
        mk = [json.loads(x) for x in open(f'{d}/k/metrics.jsonl')]
        assert all(x['kl'] <= 1e-4 + 1e-12 and x['klAll'] <= 1e-4 + 1e-12 for x in mk), mk
        # Phase 18: a step on the colony board (two holders, colluding liars) through `world`
        cw = RL17Config(tiny, f'{d}/w', **{**kw, 'steps': 1, 'seedsPerStep': 2}, mixN=((8, 1.0),), liarShare=0.5, maxLen=4096,
                        world=(('colony', True), ('r', 2), ('fault', 'collude')))
        trainRL17(cw)
        assert json.load(open(f'{d}/w/config.json'))['hash'] == T.configHash17(cw) != T.configHash17(RL17Config(**{**asdict(cw), 'world': ()}))
        recs = [json.loads(x) for x in open(f'{d}/w/turns/step-0001.jsonl')]
        assert recs and all(r['N'] == 8 and 'Clues shared on the board:' in r['obs'] and '(agent ' not in r['obs'] for r in recs)
        assert {r['nLiar'] for r in recs} == {0, 2}
        assert json.load(open(f'{d}/m/config.json'))['hash'] == T.configHash17(cm)
        T.trainingReturns = _tr
        C.trainingReturns = _tr

title: colony4_report
text:
Tests

import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

# synthetic rows with known effects: guardDeal +0.10 and failFlag +0.02 (noisy) over colonyGuards at 64; squads -0.05;
# colonyGuards' advantage over plain 0.20 at 16, 0.16 at 64; guardDeal's gain at 16 is 0.04, so its 16-to-64 change is +0.06
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
def row(arm, fault, N, s, hp):
    return dict(level=f'{arm}|{fault}', N=N, seed=s, honestPooled=hp, welfareHonest=hp * 1.3, contamination=0.5)
R4, RR = [], []
for s in range(1800, 1808):
    e = rng.normal(0, 0.005)
    RR += [row('plain', 'independent', 16, s, 0.02 + e), row('colonyGuards', 'independent', 16, s, 0.22 + e),
           row('plain', 'independent', 64, s, -0.09 + e), row('colonyGuards', 'independent', 64, s, 0.07 + e),
           row('colonyGuards', 'independent', 8, s, 0.28 + e), row('colonyGuards', 'clean', 16, s, 0.36 + e)]
    R4 += [row('guardDeal', 'independent', 64, s, 0.17 + e), row('failFlag', 'independent', 64, s, 0.07 + e + (0.03 if s % 2 else -0.01)),
           row('squads', 'independent', 64, s, 0.02 + e), row('guardDeal', 'independent', 16, s, 0.26 + e),
           row('failFlag', 'independent', 16, s, 0.22 + e), row('squads', 'independent', 16, s, 0.22 + e),
           row('guardDeal', 'clean', 16, s, 0.33 + e), row('failFlag', 'clean', 16, s, 0.36 + e),
           row('guardDealFlag', 'independent', 16, s, 0.27 + e), row('squadsAll', 'independent', 64, s, 0.2 + e)]
S = stage4Summaries(R4, RR, nboot=200)
h = S['hyp']
assert abs(h['H18_13']['estimate'] - 0.10) < 1e-9 and h['H18_13']['p'] == 1 / 256 and h['H18_13']['supported'] and h['H18_13']['robust']
assert abs(h['H18_13']['pHolm'] - 3 / 256) < 1e-12                      # the smallest p of three, times 3
assert abs(h['H18_14']['estimate'] - 0.01) < 1e-9 and h['H18_14']['p'] > 1 / 256
assert h['H18_15']['estimate'] < 0 and not h['H18_15']['supported'] and h['H18_15']['robust']
assert abs(S['did']['guardDeal']['estimate'] - 0.06) < 1e-9 and abs(S['did']['squads']['estimate'] + 0.05) < 1e-9
assert abs(S['advantage']['colonyGuards'][16] - 0.20) < 1e-9 and abs(S['advantage']['colonyGuards'][64] - 0.16) < 1e-9
assert abs(S['squads8']['estimate'] + 0.26) < 1e-9 and abs(S['cleanCost']['guardDeal']['estimate'] + 0.03) < 1e-9
assert abs(S['combined']['squadsAll']['estimate'] - 0.13) < 1e-9 and 'guardDeal|independent N 64' in S['cells']
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    writeStage4(Path(d) / 'report.md', S, dict(planHash='x', commit='y', mode='quick'))
    txt = (Path(d) / 'report.md').read_text()
assert 'H18_13 guardDeal' in txt and '16 to 64 agents' in txt

test_fail(lambda: circuitAgent(0, small, CircuitRL(small), p), contains='nCirc')
test_fail(lambda: circuitAgent(0, flexiblePolicy(), CircuitRL(pol), p), contains='circuitPolicy')
ag = circuitAgent(37, pol, CircuitRL(pol), p, rng=np.random.default_rng(0))
test_eq((ag.a, ag.c), (5, 5))

Saccades, moves, jumps and fixations:

sac = ag.sampleSaccade()
test_eq(type(sac), Saccade)
assert sac.steps >= 1 and 0 < sac.size < 2 * pi
test_eq(sac.steps, max(1, int(np.ceil(sac.size / (2 * pi / N)))))
a0, c0 = ag.a, ag.c
ag.move(1)
test_eq((ag.a, ag.c), ((a0 + 1) % N, (c0 - 1) % N))
ag.move(-1)
test_eq((ag.a, ag.c), (a0, c0))

act = ringActivity(ag.a, N, False)
always = np.zeros((N, N)); always[:, ag.c] = 1.0          # pJ = 1 at c
ag.policy.wC = always
assert ag.maybeJump(act)
test_eq(ag.c, (c0 + N // 2) % N)
never = np.zeros((N, N)); never[:, (ag.c + N // 2) % N] = 1.0   # pJ = 0 at c
ag.policy.wC = never
assert not ag.maybeJump(act)
assert ag.sampleFixation() > 0

AC-6: the CW rate over 20 000 draws matches dS; pJ is 0.5 for equal net weights.

wG6 = sinGoal(0.4, grid(N)[4], N)
pol6 = circuitPolicy(wG6, wC)
ag6 = circuitAgent(0, pol6, CircuitRL(pol6), p, rng=np.random.default_rng(123))
dS = outputs(wG6, ag6.c, p)['dS']
cw = sum(ag6.sampleSaccade().direction > 0 for _ in range(20000))
test_close(cw / 20000, dS, eps=0.01)
test_close(jumpProb(np.ones((N, N)) * 0.3, act, 0), 0.5)

Each switch turns its update off; the updates change weights when on.

pol2 = circuitPolicy(wG, wC.copy())
rl2 = CircuitRL(pol2, learnC=False, learnG=False, jumps=False)
ag2 = circuitAgent(3, pol2, rl2, p, rng=np.random.default_rng(1))
act2 = ringActivity(ag2.a, N, False)
rl_on = CircuitRL(pol2)
rl_on.updateCompass(ag2, act2, 0.5)
assert not np.allclose(pol2.wC, wC)
w_before = pol2.wG.copy()
rl_on.updateGoal(ag2, 1, 10)
assert not np.allclose(pol2.wG, w_before)
w_before = pol2.wG.copy()
rl_on.updateGoal(ag2, 0, 10)
test_close(pol2.wG, w_before)

from explRL.circuit_train import train_circuit
from explRL.envs import ZoneArena
wC_before, wG_before = pol2.wC.copy(), pol2.wG.copy()
h = train_circuit(ag2, ZoneArena(), Ttot=20.0)
test_close(pol2.wC, wC_before)
test_close(pol2.wG, wG_before)
assert not h.jumped.any()

Draws happen in a fixed order, so one seed gives the same draws:

def run_draws(seed):
    pol = circuitPolicy(wG, wC.copy())
    ag = circuitAgent(2, pol, CircuitRL(pol), p, rng=np.random.default_rng(seed))
    sac = ag.sampleSaccade()
    ag.move(sac.direction)
    return sac.direction, sac.size, ag.maybeJump(ringActivity(ag.a, N, True)), ag.sampleFixation()
test_eq(run_draws(7), run_draws(7))
assert run_draws(7) != run_draws(8)
