from types import SimpleNamespace
from explRL.clue_colony import *
from explRL.clue_colony import _value
from explRL.clueboard import ClueBoardEnv
from explRL.clue_agents import ClueBoard

b = ClueBoardEnv(0, 4, m=2, r=2, R=30)
ch = ClueBoard()
k0, k1 = b.open[0], b.open[1]
p0 = b.tasks[k0].task.primes
t0 = b.tasks[k0].task.clue(0)[1]
ch.post(0, k0, (0, p0[0], t0), 1)                    # the true value, twice by agent 0 (counts once), once by agent 2
ch.post(0, k0, (0, p0[0], t0), 2)
ch.post(2, k0, (0, p0[0], t0), 3)
ch.post(1, k0, (0, p0[0], (t0 + 1) % p0[0]), 4)       # a false value: contested
ch.post(3, k1, (1, b.tasks[k1].task.primes[1], 0), 5)
tal = tally(ch, b)
assert [(r, sorted(s)) for r, s, _ in tal[k0][0]] == [(t0, [0, 2]), ((t0 + 1) % p0[0], [1])]
assert leading(tal, k0, 0)[0] == t0 and leading(tal, k0, 1) is None and contestedCount(tal) == 1
line = colonyLine(b, tal)
assert line.startswith('Clues shared on the board: ') and line.count('contested') == 1
assert f'T{k0}: x mod {p0[0]} = {t0} (2 agents, confirmed) | x mod {p0[0]} = {(t0 + 1) % p0[0]} (1 agent, unconfirmed), contested' in line
assert '(1 agent, confirmed)' in colonyLine(b, tal, q=1) and colonyLine(b, {}) == 'Clues shared on the board: none'
kn = knownColony(3, b, ch)
assert all(kn[k][j] == r for k in b.open for j, r in b.held(3, k).items())        # own clues win
if 0 not in b.held(3, k0):
    assert kn[k0][0] == t0                                                       # else the most senders
# a tie between values: the newest wins
ch2 = ClueBoard()
ch2.post(0, k0, (0, p0[0], 1 % p0[0]), 1)
ch2.post(1, k0, (0, p0[0], 0), 2)
assert tally(ch2, b)[k0][0][0][0] == 0
# rules: replaced only where set; guard sentence only in guard slots
txt = 'intro ' + SHARE_AGAIN + '\n\nmore'
env = lambda **kw: SimpleNamespace(**{**dict(colony=False, confirm=False, guards=0, nLiar=0, fault='independent', volunteer=False), **kw})
assert colonyRules(env(), txt, 0) == txt
assert COLONY_RULES in colonyRules(env(colony=True), txt) and SHARE_AGAIN not in colonyRules(env(colony=True), txt)
assert CONFIRM_RULES in colonyRules(env(confirm=True), txt)
g = env(colony=True, guards=2, nLiar=2)
assert list(guardSlots(g)) == [2, 3] and colonyRules(g, txt, 2).endswith(GUARD_RULE)
assert GUARD_RULE not in colonyRules(g, txt, 4) and GUARD_RULE not in colonyRules(g, txt, None)
for bad in (dict(colony=True, confirm=True), dict(guards=-1), dict(guards=1.5), dict(fault='x'), dict(guards=6), dict(guards=2, volunteer=True)):
    try:
        checkOptions(bad, N=8, nLiar=2)
        raise AssertionError(bad)
    except ValueError:
        pass
assert checkOptions(dict(colony=True, guards=2, fault='collude'), N=8, nLiar=2) and checkOptions(dict(colony=True, volunteer=True, fault='adaptive'))
# Stage 3: the deceiver sentence only for the liar slots of an adaptive cell, the volunteer sentence only for honest slots
a = env(colony=True, nLiar=2, fault='adaptive', volunteer=True)
assert DECEIVER_RULE in colonyRules(a, txt, 1) and VOLUNTEER_RULE not in colonyRules(a, txt, 1)
assert VOLUNTEER_RULE in colonyRules(a, txt, 2) and DECEIVER_RULE not in colonyRules(a, txt, 2)
assert DECEIVER_RULE not in colonyRules(env(colony=True, nLiar=2), txt, 0)                 # scripted liars get no text
assert colonyRules(a, txt, None) == colonyRules(env(colony=True), txt, None)


# AC-2 in use: with the same replies, rollout rows and turn logs equal runClue's with each Phase 18 option, the guard
# sentence reaches exactly the guard slots' system text, and the colony board line replaces the plain one
from explRL.clue_policy import claudePolicy
from explRL.clue_roll import coopRows, rollout
from explRL.clue_runs import runClue
from explRL.colony_agents import scriptedFaults
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig

fake = lambda: LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
W = dict(m=2, r=2, R=30)
for opt, nLiar in ((dict(colony=True), 0), (dict(confirm=True), 2), (dict(colony=True, guards=2, fault='collude'), 2),
                   (dict(fault='error'), 2), (dict(colony=True, q=3), 1), (dict(fault='adaptive'), 2),
                   (dict(colony=True, volunteer=True), 2), (dict(colony=True, volunteer=True, fault='adaptive'), 2)):
    cfg = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=8, turns=6, nLiar=nLiar, memory='notes', world={**W, **opt})
    ref, refLog = runClue(cfg, 901, fake())
    ro = rollout(cfg, [901], claudePolicy(fake()), scriptedFaults(cfg.world, nLiar), 'notes', keepPrompts=True)
    row = coopRows(cfg, ro)[0]
    assert {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k in ref[0]} == ref[0], opt
    mine = sorted((x for lg in ro.logs[0] for x in lg), key=lambda x: (x['t'], x['agent']))
    assert [dict(x, episode=0) for x in mine] == sorted(refLog, key=lambda x: (x['t'], x['agent'])), opt
    sys_ = {i: ps[0][0] for i, ps in enumerate(ro.prompts[0]) if ps}
    g = opt.get('guards', 0)
    assert all((GUARD_RULE in s) == (nLiar <= i < nLiar + g) for i, s in sys_.items()), opt
    adaptive = opt.get('fault') == 'adaptive'
    assert all((DECEIVER_RULE in s) == (adaptive and i < nLiar) for i, s in sys_.items()), opt
    assert all((VOLUNTEER_RULE in s) == (bool(opt.get('volunteer')) and i >= nLiar) for i, s in sys_.items()), opt
    assert set(sys_) == set(range(0 if adaptive else nLiar, 8)), opt                       # adaptive liars are Claude agents too
    assert all((COLONY_RULES in s) == bool(opt.get('colony')) and (CONFIRM_RULES in s) == bool(opt.get('confirm')) for s in sys_.values())
    if opt.get('colony'):
        obs = [x['obs'] for x in mine]
        assert all('(agent ' not in o for o in obs)                                 # the tally replaces the plain list

Run iterations (saccade, jump, fixation; Algorithm 3) from t0 until t0 + Ttot (default params.Ttot), as a one-member team.

from math import pi
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_close
from explRL.params import Params
from explRL.core import loadCircuitAgent
from explRL.envs import ZoneArena

p = Params()
N = p.nCirc
env = ZoneArena()
quiet = dict(learnC=False, learnG=False, jumps=False)
hist = train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(params=p, seed=0, **quiet), env, Ttot=5.0)
n = len(hist.t)
assert n > 0
for f in fields(CircuitHistory):
    test_eq(len(getattr(hist, f.name)), n)
assert hist.t[-1] < 5.0 <= endTime(hist, p.tS)
assert np.all(np.diff(hist.t) > 0)
h2 = train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(params=p, seed=0, **quiet), env, Ttot=5.0, t0=100.0)
test_close(h2.t[0], 100.0)
assert h2.t[-1] < 105.0 <= endTime(h2, p.tS)
both = concatHistory([hist, h2])
test_eq(len(both.t), n + len(h2.t))
test_eq(len(train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(seed=0), env, Ttot=0.0).t), 0)

AC-7: one seed gives one history; the mirror sum only changes by N/2, and only on jumps.

h0 = train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(seed=1, **quiet), env, Ttot=30.0)
h1 = train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(seed=1, **quiet), env, Ttot=30.0)
test_close(h0.t, h1.t); test_eq(h0.a, h1.a)
h3 = train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(seed=2, **quiet), env, Ttot=30.0)
assert len(h3.t) != len(h0.t) or not np.allclose(h0.a, h3.a)
assert np.all(h0.mirror == h0.mirror[0])
hj = train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(seed=5, learnC=False, learnG=False, jumps=True), env, Ttot=60.0)
assert hj.jumped.any()
d = np.diff(hj.mirror) % N
assert np.all((d == 0) | (d == N // 2))
assert np.all((d == N // 2) == hj.jumped[1:])

Measures on a hand-built history:

hand = CircuitHistory(
    t=np.array([0.0, 1.0, 2.0]), a=np.array([8, 8, 24]), c=np.array([0, 0, 0]),
    direction=np.array([1, -1, 1]), steps=np.array([1, 1, 1]), jumped=np.array([False, False, False]),
    valence=np.array([1, -1, 1]), fixDur=np.array([0.5, 1.0, 0.5]),
    thetaG=np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0]), strength=np.array([0.3, 0.4, 0.5]), mirror=np.array([8, 8, 24]))
test_close(heldValue(hand, hand.strength, 0.2, [0.0, 0.9, 2.5], p.tS), [0.2, 0.3, 0.4])
test_close(piScore(hand), (0.5 - 1.0 + 0.5) / 2.0)
test_close(goalArena(hand, N), [pi / 2, pi / 2, -pi / 2])
test_close(goalSafeDistance(hand, env), [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
ro = readout(hand, N)
test_eq(ro['count'].sum(), 3)
k = int(np.flatnonzero(ro['count'])[0])        # all three sit at their goal (relative heading 0)
test_eq(ro['count'][k], 3)
test_close(ro['fixDur'][k], 2.0 / 3)
test_close(ro['turnBias'][k], (-1 + 1) / 2)    # next saccades of iterations 0 and 1

pJ along a map, the most stable compass heading, and probes:

za, zs = ZoneArena(symmetric=False), ZoneArena(symmetric=True)
wC = np.zeros((N, N)); wC[0, 0] = 1.0
mjp = mapJumpProb(wC, za, mirror=0)
test_eq(len(mjp), N)
test_close(mjp[0], jumpProb(wC, za.ringActivity(0), 0))
pja = mapJumpProb(np.random.default_rng(0).uniform(0, 1, (N, N)), zs, 3)
test_close(pja[:N // 2] + pja[N // 2:], np.ones(N // 2))

wS = np.ones((N, N)); wS[:, 27] = 0.0            # compass 27 (arena 5 on map 0) never jumps
test_close(stablestCompass(wS, za, 0), grid(N)[27])

agp = loadCircuitAgent(seed=9)
wG0, wC0, st = agp.policy.wG.copy(), agp.policy.wC.copy(), agp.rng.bit_generator.state
pr = probe(agp, env, T=20.0, seed=99)
test_eq(set(pr), {'history', 'PI', 'jumpRate'})
test_close(agp.policy.wG, wG0); test_close(agp.policy.wC, wC0)
test_eq(agp.rng.bit_generator.state, st)
assert agp.rl.learnC and agp.rl.learnG
test_close(pr['jumpRate'], pr['history'].jumped.mean())

Golden fixture (Phase 5, AC-1): a 300 s run (seed 0, symmetric scene), a second 200 s segment of the same agent from t0 = 500, and a 60 s probe, saved from the training loop before it moved to runTeam, must match exactly, field by field and dtype by dtype, including the final weights and the probe’s PI and jump rate.

from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
while not (root / 'pyproject.toml').exists() and root != root.parent:
    root = root.parent
fx = np.load(root / 'nbs' / 'fixtures' / 'phase5' / 'circuit.npz')
import platform
EXACT = (platform.system(), platform.machine()) == ('Darwin', 'arm64')   # where the fixtures were recorded: bit for bit
same = lambda x, y: (np.asarray(x).dtype == np.asarray(y).dtype and np.shape(x) == np.shape(y) and
                     (np.array_equal(x, y) if EXACT else np.allclose(x, y, rtol=0, atol=1e-10)))   # elsewhere: last-bit rounding (~1e-13 on Linux x86)
def sameAsFixture(h, prefix):
    for f in fields(h):
        x, y = getattr(h, f.name), fx[prefix + f.name]
        assert same(x, y), prefix + f.name

zs, agf = ZoneArena(symmetric=True), loadCircuitAgent(seed=0)
sameAsFixture(train_circuit(agf, zs, Ttot=300), 'seg0_')
sameAsFixture(train_circuit(agf, zs, Ttot=200, t0=500), 'seg1_')
prf = probe(agf, zs, T=60, seed=7)
sameAsFixture(prf['history'], 'probe_')
assert same(agf.policy.wG, fx['wG']) and same(agf.policy.wC, fx['wC'])
assert same(prf['PI'], fx['probe_PI']) and same(prf['jumpRate'], fx['probe_jumpRate'])

Tests

import numpy as np
from explRL.cluetask import CLUE_PAIRS
from explRL.clueboard import *

# AC-3 dealing: no agent holds all clues whenever r m <= N (m - 1); a solo agent holds all; r holders per clue
for m, R in CLUE_PAIRS:
    for r in (1, 2):
        for N in (1, 2, 3, 4, 8):
            b = ClueBoardEnv(7, N, m=m, r=r, R=R)
            for s in b.tasks.values():
                assert all(len(hs) == min(r, N) for hs in s.holders)
                full = [i for i in range(N) if all(i in hs for hs in s.holders)]
                if N == 1:
                    assert full == [0]
                elif r * m <= N * (m - 1):
                    assert not full, (m, r, N)

# scoring: open costs a turn; only the first correct answer scores; wrong answers pay; shares are logged
b = ClueBoardEnv(1, 4, m=3, r=1, R=105, life=100, penalty=0.5)
k = b.open[0]; s = b.tasks[k]
r, dt, loc, info = b.apply(0, ('open', k), 0.0)
assert (r, dt, loc, info['kind'], info['result']) == (0.0, 1.0, k, 'travel', 'opened')
b.apply(1, ('open', k), 0.0)
p, res = s.task.clue(1)
b.noteSubmit(0, 7)
assert b.apply(0, ('submit', (s.task.x + 1) % 105), 1.0)[0] == -0.5
b.apply(2, ('share', (k, 1, res)), 1.0); b.apply(3, ('share', (k, 1, res)), 2.0); b.apply(3, ('share', (k, 2, (s.task.clue(2)[1] + 1) % s.task.clue(2)[0])), 3.0)
assert [(x[1], x[5], x[6]) for x in b.shareLog] == [(2, False, False), (3, True, False), (3, False, True)]
r, _, _, info = b.apply(0, ('submit', s.task.x), 4.0)
assert r == s.value and info['result'] == 'solved' and k not in b.open
assert b.apply(1, ('submit', s.task.x), 4.0)[3]['result'] == 'late'
assert b.solveLog == [(4.0, 0, k, not all(0 in hs for hs in s.holders))] and b.submits[0][3] == 7
assert b.counts == dict(solved=1, wrong=1, late=1, opens=2, shares=3)
assert b.apply(2, ('share', (999, 0, 0)), 5.0)[3]['result'] == 'invalid' and b.apply(2, ('wait', None), 6.0)[3]['result'] == 'wait'
assert len(b.ledger) == len(b.netRows) and np.isclose(sum(b.netRows), b.netByAgent().sum()) and b.pooledBound() > 0
assert all(len(row) == 10 for row in b.ledger) and b.held(0, b.open[0]) == {j: b.tasks[b.open[0]].task.clue(j)[1] for j, hs in enumerate(b.tasks[b.open[0]].holders) if 0 in hs}

# rewards: individual, team and credit give the same team total (delivered plus pending)
def play(scheme):
    e = ClueBoardEnv(2, 3, m=3, r=1, R=105, life=100, scheme=scheme)
    k = e.open[0]; s = e.tasks[k]; solver = 0
    missing = [j for j, hs in enumerate(s.holders) if solver not in hs]
    t, rews = 0.0, []
    rews.append(e.apply(solver, ('open', k), t)[0]); t += 1
    for j in missing:
        sharer = next(iter(s.holders[j]))
        rews.append(e.apply(sharer, ('share', (k, j, s.task.clue(j)[1])), t)[0]); t += 1
    rews.append(e.apply(solver, ('submit', (s.task.x + 1) % 105), t)[0]); t += 1
    rews.append(e.apply(solver, ('submit', s.task.x), t)[0]); t += 1
    return sum(rews) + e.pending.sum(), e, rews, missing
tot = {sc: play(sc)[0] for sc in ('individual', 'team', 'credit')}
assert np.isclose(tot['individual'], tot['team']) and np.isclose(tot['individual'], tot['credit'])
_, e, rews, missing = play('credit')

import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

import numpy as np

from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV, runGrid, writeCSV
from explRL.clue_grid import (CLUE_GRIDS, CLUE_OPTIONAL, CLUE_PLAN, CLUE_SETTINGS, chooseClueSettings, clueHash,
                              clueNumpyGrid, cluePilotGrid, clueQuick, clueSweep, sweepIncentives)
from explRL.clue_report import summaries, writeFigures, writeReport
from explRL.clue_runs import runClueAny
from explRL.llm_budget import PRICES, Budget
from explRL.llm_sched import mergeTiming, runWorkload, timingSummary
from explRL.train import demo_artifact_dir

DN = 'multiagent/clue'
WORKERS = min(8, os.cpu_count() or 1)          # fake-client and numpy workloads
LLM_WORKERS = 32                               # live workloads (as the follow-up runs)
OPTIONAL = False                               # effort and scale arms (K6: off)
CAP = 150.0
LLM = demo_artifact_dir(None, 'multiagent/llm')
LIVE = os.environ.get('EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE') == '1'
LIVE_SPEC = dict(kind='live', cache=str(LLM / 'cache'), cap=CAP, ledger=str(LLM / 'spend.jsonl'))
SETTINGS = ('m', 'r', 'R', 'guess')


def gitCommit():
    try:
        return subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or 'unknown'
    except OSError:
        return 'unknown'


def run(mode, grids, spec, workers=None):
    "Run a workload through runWorkload; write runs.csv, turns.jsonl, timing.jsonl, report.md, figures, metrics.json."
    out = demo_artifact_dir(mode, DN)
    logs = out / 'turns'
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    workers = workers or (LLM_WORKERS if spec.get('kind') == 'live' else WORKERS)
    t0 = time.time()
    res = runWorkload(grids, spec, workers, str(logs), run=runClueAny)
    rows, wall = res['rows'], time.time() - t0
    writeCSV(rows, out / 'runs.csv')
    with open(out / 'turns.jsonl', 'w') as f:
        for p in sorted(logs.glob('*.jsonl')) if logs.exists() else []:
            f.write(p.read_text())
    timing = timingSummary(mergeTiming(logs, out / 'timing.jsonl'), wall)
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    llm = [r for r in rows if r['runner'] == 'llm']
    models = sorted({r['model'] for r in llm})
    meta = dict(mode=mode, planHash=clueHash(), commit=gitCommit(), models=models, cap=CAP, wall=wall,
                settings=', '.join(f'{k} = {CLUE_SETTINGS[k]}' for k in SETTINGS),
                pricesChecked=', '.join(sorted({PRICES[m]['checked'] for m in models})) or '-',
                cost=float(sum(r['cost'] for r in llm)), calls=int(sum(r['calls'] for r in llm)), retries=timing['retries'],
                spent=Budget(CAP, spec['ledger']).spent() if spec.get('ledger') else 0.0)
    S = summaries(llm, [r for r in rows if r['study'] == 'clueNumpy'])
    writeReport(out / 'report.md', S, meta)
    writeFigures(out, S)
    (out / 'metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(meta, done=res['done'], refused=res['refused'], stopped=res['stopped'],
                                                      pooled=res['pooled'], workers=workers, timing=timing,
                                                      plan=CLUE_PLAN), indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str) + '\n')
    if spec.get('kind') == 'live':             # the first (live) run's metrics and timing; a cached rerun overwrites the others
        for f in ('metrics.json', 'timing.jsonl'):
            live = out / f.replace('.', '_live.')
            if not live.exists():
                shutil.copy(out / f, live)
    print(f"{mode}: {len(rows)} rows, {meta['calls']} calls, ${meta['cost']:.2f} for these runs, ${meta['spent']:.2f} spent "
          f"in all, {wall:.0f} s, {timing['callsPerSecond']:.1f} calls/s, {timing['retries']} retries; stopped: {res['stopped']}")
    return rows, S, meta, timing

# returns, advantages and samples are tested in rl_adv; the loop's control logic in rl_control
# seeds: new boards every step, each played `group` times; configuration identity

from explRL.coop_grid import RL_PLAN
P12 = dict(individual='542eb4f99c29', team='be13d2c8afb3', credit='c02fa4f72378')
v2 = lambda sc, **kw: RLConfig('/content/drive/MyDrive/explRL_rl/warm_model', f'/content/drive/MyDrive/explRL_rl/runs_v2/{sc}',

# With the [train] extra, no download: two RL steps on the tiny random model (whose replies are all invalid, so random
# returns stand in to give nonzero advantages), then resume at step 3, a refused configuration, and per-role adapters
import importlib.util
if all(importlib.util.find_spec(m) for m in ('transformers', 'peft', 'tokenizers')):   # the [train] extra; the docs build runs cells with imports and lacks it
    import shutil
    import tempfile
    from pathlib import Path
    from explRL.tiny_model import tinyModel
    _rng, _tr = np.random.default_rng(0), trainingReturns   # trainRL here looks it up in this namespace
    trainingReturns = lambda ro, *a: _tr(ro, *a) + _rng.normal(size=np.shape(ro.returns))
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            tiny = tinyModel(d + '/tiny')
            for perRole in (False, True):
                cfg = RLConfig(tiny, f'{d}/rl{perRole}', steps=2, seedsPerStep=2, group=3, turns=3, ckptEvery=1, maxNew=24, perRole=perRole, lr=1e-3)
                trainRL(cfg)
                trainRL(RLConfig(**{**asdict(cfg), 'steps': 3}))
                m = [json.loads(x) for x in open(f'{d}/rl{perRole}/metrics.jsonl')]
                assert [x['step'] for x in m] == [1, 2, 3] and all(x['samples'] > 0 and np.isfinite(x['loss']) for x in m), m
                assert m[0]['kl'] == 0 and m[-1]['kl'] > 0                    # the fresh adapter starts at the warm-start model
                assert sorted(p.name for p in Path(f'{d}/rl{perRole}/turns').iterdir()) == ['step-0001.jsonl', 'step-0002.jsonl', 'step-0003.jsonl']
                assert json.load(open(f'{d}/rl{perRole}/config.json'))['versions']['torch']
                try:
                    trainRL(RLConfig(**{**asdict(cfg), 'lr': 2e-3, 'steps': 4}))
                    raise AssertionError('a checkpoint of another configuration must be refused')
                except ValueError:
                    pass
                # the tiny model's replies are all invalid: the stopping rule halts at step 3, and a halted run is not resumed
                assert 'invalid replies' in json.load(open(f'{d}/rl{perRole}/halted.json'))['reason']
                trainRL(RLConfig(**{**asdict(cfg), 'steps': 5}))
                assert len(open(f'{d}/rl{perRole}/metrics.jsonl').readlines()) == 3
            # a disconnect after step 3 but before its checkpoint: the redone step is logged once, not twice
            cfg = RLConfig(tiny, f'{d}/resume', steps=3, seedsPerStep=2, group=3, turns=3, ckptEvery=2, maxNew=24, lr=1e-3, haltRun=99)
            trainRL(cfg)
            shutil.rmtree(f'{d}/resume/ckpt-0003')
            trainRL(cfg)
            assert [json.loads(x)['step'] for x in open(f'{d}/resume/metrics.jsonl')] == [1, 2, 3]
            # the KL-targeted learning rate: with a target no step can meet, every step is undone and the adapter stays at zero
            from safetensors.torch import load_file
            cfg = RLConfig(tiny, f'{d}/ctl', steps=2, seedsPerStep=2, group=3, turns=3, ckptEvery=2, maxNew=24, lr=1e-3,
                           klTarget=1e-12, rejectFactor=1.0, haltRun=99)
            trainRL(cfg)
            m = [json.loads(x) for x in open(f'{d}/ctl/metrics.jsonl')]
            assert all(x['rejected'] and x['stepKL'] > 0 for x in m) and m[1]['lr'] == m[0]['lrNext'] < m[0]['lr'], m
            assert all(not v.any() for k, v in load_file(f'{d}/ctl/final/adapter_model.safetensors').items() if 'lora_B' in k)
            # Phase 13: per-turn advantages (the real ones, plus noise, as the tiny model's turns all tie) and the wrong-answer
            # penalty: two steps, then resume at step 3; no roll-back key without haltJump
            _ta = turnAdvantages
            turnAdvantages = lambda ro, *a: [[list(np.add(x, _rng.normal(size=len(x)))) for x in b] for b in _ta(ro, *a)]
            cfg = RLConfig(tiny, f'{d}/turn', steps=2, seedsPerStep=2, group=3, turns=3, ckptEvery=1, maxNew=24, lr=1e-3, haltRun=99,
                           advantage='turn', wrongPenalty=2.5)
            trainRL(cfg)
            trainRL(RLConfig(**{**asdict(cfg), 'steps': 3}))
            m = [json.loads(x) for x in open(f'{d}/turn/metrics.jsonl')]
            assert [x['step'] for x in m] == [1, 2, 3] and all(x['samples'] > 0 for x in m) and 'rolledBack' not in m[0], m
            assert json.load(open(f'{d}/turn/config.json'))['advantage'] == 'turn' and 'haltJump' not in json.load(open(f'{d}/turn/config.json'))
            # a forced jump (stub invalid shares, in call order: the metrics of step 1, then step 2's rollouts 0.9 (rolled back:
            # weights and optimizer restored, learning rate halved, the step played again) and 0.0 ...), then resume
            _is, shares = invalidShare, iter([0.0, 0.9, 0.0] + [0.0] * 20)
            invalidShare = lambda rows: next(shares)
            cfg = RLConfig(tiny, f'{d}/jump', steps=3, seedsPerStep=2, group=3, turns=3, ckptEvery=1, maxNew=24, lr=1e-3, haltRun=99,
                           haltJump=0.15)
            trainRL(cfg)
            m = [json.loads(x) for x in open(f'{d}/jump/metrics.jsonl')]
            assert [x['rolledBack'] for x in m] == [0, 1, 0] and m[1]['lr'] == m[0]['lrNext'] / 2 and m[2]['lr'] == m[1]['lrNext'], m
            trainRL(RLConfig(**{**asdict(cfg), 'steps': 4}))
            assert [json.loads(x)['step'] for x in open(f'{d}/jump/metrics.jsonl')] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
            invalidShare = _is
            # the real invalid share (the tiny model's replies are all invalid): step 2 jumps, is rolled back, jumps again: halt;
            # the final adapter is the one before step 1's update (zero)
            cfg = RLConfig(tiny, f'{d}/halt', steps=3, seedsPerStep=2, group=3, turns=3, ckptEvery=1, maxNew=24, lr=1e-3, haltRun=99,
                           haltJump=0.15)
            trainRL(cfg)
            assert [json.loads(x)['step'] for x in open(f'{d}/halt/metrics.jsonl')] == [1]
            assert json.load(open(f'{d}/halt/halted.json'))['reason'].startswith('jump')
            assert all(not v.any() for k, v in load_file(f'{d}/halt/final/adapter_model.safetensors').items() if 'lora_B' in k)
    finally:
        trainingReturns = _tr
        turnAdvantages = globals().get('_ta', turnAdvantages)
        invalidShare = globals().get('_is', invalidShare)

    return [json.loads(x) for x in open(p)] if p.exists() else []


def runColony(mode, grids, spec, plan=COLONY_PLAN, workers=None, prior=(), analyse=None, run=runColonyCell):
    """Cells through runWorkload (runColonyCell): runs.csv, turns.jsonl, timing.jsonl, report.md, colony.png, metrics.json;
    the analysis reads `prior` rows too (Stage 2: Stage 1's, for the tests and the trend over 8-64); `analyse(rows, prior)` ->
    (summary, write(path, S, meta)) replaces the Stage 1 analysis (the 32-agent deviation)."""
    live = spec.get('kind') == 'live'
    out = demo_artifact_dir(mode, COLONY)
    logs = out / 'turns'
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    res = runWorkload(grids, spec, workers or (LLM_WORKERS if live else WORKERS), str(logs), run=run)
    wall = time.time() - t0
    rows = res['rows']
    writeCSV(rows, out / 'runs.csv')
    with open(out / 'turns.jsonl', 'w') as f:
        for p in sorted(logs.glob('*.jsonl')) if logs.exists() else []:
            f.write(p.read_text())
    res['timing'] = timingSummary(mergeTiming(logs, out / 'timing.jsonl'), wall)
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    if analyse is None:
        S, write = colonySummaries(list(prior) + rows, plan, nboot=plan['nboot'] if live else 200), writeColony
    else:
        S, write = analyse(rows, prior)
    meta = dict(mode=mode, planHash=coopHash(plan), commit=gitCommit(), model=HAIKU, cap=float(spec.get('cap', CAP)), wall=wall,
                pricesChecked=PRICES[HAIKU]['checked'], cost=float(sum(r['cost'] for r in rows)),
                calls=int(sum(r['calls'] for r in rows)), spent=Budget(spec.get('cap', CAP), spec['ledger']).spent() if spec.get('ledger') else 0.0)
    write(out / 'report.md', S, meta)
    if analyse is None:
        figColony(out, S)
    (out / 'metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(meta, done=res['done'], refused=res['refused'], stopped=res['stopped'],
                                                      timing=res['timing'], summary=S), indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str) + '\n')
    if live:
        for f in ('metrics.json', 'timing.jsonl'):
            if not (out / f.replace('.', '_live.')).exists():
                shutil.copy(out / f, out / f.replace('.', '_live.'))
    print(f"{mode}: {len(rows)} rows, {meta['calls']} calls, ${meta['cost']:.2f} for these runs, ${meta['spent']:.2f} spent in all, "
          f"{wall:.0f} s; stopped: {res['stopped']}")
    return rows, S, meta


def pilotCheck(rows):
    "Invalid rate, tokens and cost per call, and the plain board's honest loss (clean - liars) at the pilot seed."
    calls = sum(r['calls'] for r in rows) or 1
    v = {r['level']: r for r in rows}
    return dict(invalid=sum(r['invalid'] for r in rows) / calls, costPerCall=sum(r['cost'] for r in rows) / calls,
                inputPerCall=sum(r['inputTokens'] + r['cacheReadTokens'] + r['cacheWriteTokens'] for r in rows) / calls,
                outputPerCall=sum(r['outputTokens'] for r in rows) / calls,
                plainLoss=v['plain|clean']['welfareHonest'] - v['plain|independent']['welfareHonest'])

section: Tracing check (--flags llm, $0): Phase 18’s contamination against Phase 15’s (AC-6)
text:
Tracing check (--flags llm, $0): Phase 18’s contamination against Phase 15’s (AC-6)
Phase 14’s baseline cells with liars at N 8, 16 and 32, replayed from the cache: the outcome-based contamination (colony_trace: answers built on a lie) against Phase 15’s exposure-based one (liar_report.mechanics). AC-6 (revised after measuring): never above Phase 15’s in any cell, and rising with N as Phase 15’s does; the gap is exposure without uptake.

from explRL.liar_report import mechanics
from explRL.liar_trace import cacheOnlyClient, traceRun
from explRL.colony_trace import replay, traceBoard
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig
from explRL.scale_grid import scaleGrid

if not (LLM / 'cache').exists():
    print('skipped: no response cache')
else:
    means = {}
    for N in (8, 16, 32):
        pairs15 = []
        for c in [c for c in scaleGrid() if c['N'] == N and c['level'] == 'baseline|liar']:
            cfg = LLMConfig.fromDict(c['cfg'])
            tr = traceRun(cfg, c['seed'], cacheOnlyClient(cfg, LLM / 'cache'))
            rp = replay(cfg, c['seed'], cacheOnlyClient(cfg, LLM / 'cache'))
            assert rp.rows == tr.rows                                   # the replay is the run
            pairs15.append((mechanics(tr.trace, tr.board, tr.nLiar)['contaminated'], traceBoard(rp.board, rp.answers, rp.nLiar)['contamination']))
        a, b = np.array(pairs15).T
        assert (b <= a + 1e-12).all(), N
        means[N] = (a.mean(), b.mean())
        print(f'N {N}: Phase 15 {a.mean():.3f}, Phase 18 {b.mean():.3f}, gap per cell {np.round(a - b, 3)}')
    assert means[32][1] > means[8][1] and means[32][0] > means[8][0]   # the same trend

    texts = lambda i: {t['facts'][k]['text'] for k in t['held'][i]}

    assert [r['success'] for r in again] == [r['success'] for r in rows]

text:
Tests

import numpy as np
from collections import deque
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_close
from explRL.credit import Credit, ScoutBandit, runCredit
from explRL.harness import Blackboard
from explRL.harness_runs import HarnessConfig, benchWorld

# Credit: first harvester at a patch is its discoverer; later harvests by others pay it beta x harvest;
# its own later harvests and empty or non-patch stays pay nothing; a patch move starts a new discovery
w = benchWorld(nPatches=1, nDanger=0, intake=(2.0,), patchSites=[0], dangerSites=[], Tmove=40.0)
w.reset(0, 3)
cr = Credit(3, beta=0.5)
test_eq(cr.stay(w, 0, 0, 0.8, 1), None)               # agent 0 discovers, in scout mode
test_eq(cr.stay(w, 0, 0, 0.8, 0), None)               # its own later harvest: no credit
test_eq(cr.stay(w, 1, 0, 0.8, 0), 0)                  # agent 1 harvests: pays agent 0
test_eq(cr.stay(w, 2, 5, 0.8, 0), None)               # not a patch
test_eq(cr.stay(w, 2, 0, 0.0, 0), None)               # nothing harvested
test_eq(cr.take(0), [(1, 0.4)]); test_eq(cr.take(0), [])
test_eq(cr.stats[0]['discovered'], 1); test_close(cr.stats[0]['credited'], 0.4)
w.advance(40.0)                                        # the patch moves: a new discovery is possible
new = int(w.site[0])
test_eq(cr.stay(w, 2, new, 0.8, 0), None); test_eq(cr.stats[2]['discovered'], 1)
c0 = Credit(3, beta=0.0); c0.stay(w, 0, new, 0.8, 0)
test_eq(c0.stay(w, 1, new, 0.8, 0), None); test_eq(c0.take(0), [])

# ScoutBandit scout mode: goes to the least-known location (nearest first), then stays there once
sb = ScoutBandit(Blackboard(4, n=1), Credit(1), w=1.0)
wd = benchWorld(L=4, nPatches=1, nDanger=0, intake=(1.0,), patchSites=[0], dangerSites=[]); wd.reset(0, 1)
sb.id, sb._world, sb._t = 0, wd, 0.0
sb.rates = [deque([1.0]), deque([1.0, 1.0]), deque(), deque([-2.6])]
sb.nMode[:] = (20, 20); sb.modeS[:] = (0.0, 9.0); sb.modeT[:] = (10.0, 10.0)    # scouting has paid more
test_eq(sb.act({'location': 0, 'travel': wd.layout.T[0]}), 2); test_eq(sb.mode, 1)
test_eq(sb.act({'location': 2, 'travel': wd.layout.T[2]}), 2); test_eq(sb.mode, 1)
sb.rates[2].append(0.5); sb.rates[1].append(1.0)                    # now 3 (n = 1) is least known, but bad
test_eq(sb.act({'location': 1, 'travel': wd.layout.T[1]}), 0)       # so from 1 the scout picks 0 (n = 1, nearest, lower index)
# credit received is added to the mode that made the discovery
sb.credit.inbox[0].append((1, 0.7)); before = sb.modeS.copy()
sb._takeCredit()
test_close(sb.modeS - before, [0.0, 0.7]); test_eq(sb.credit.take(0), [])

# runs: deterministic; beta = None is plain CommBandit (same history as runHarness); welfare excludes credit
cfg = HarnessConfig(channel='blackboard', T=120.0)
a, b = runCredit(cfg, 8, 0, beta=1.0), runCredit(cfg, 8, 0, beta=1.0)
test_eq(a[1].records, b[1].records); test_eq(a[3]['credited'], b[3]['credited'])
assert a[3]['discovered'] > 0 and len(a[3]['scoutShare']) == 8
from explRL.harness_runs import runHarness
test_eq(runCredit(cfg, 8, 0, beta=None)[1].records, runHarness(cfg, 8, 0)[1].records)
test_close(a[3]['welfare'], a[3]['harvest'] - a[3]['dangerCost'])

import math, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from explRL.bench_grid import rowKey
from explRL.fix_report import *

# AC-5, synthetic rows with known effects. A1: request +0.3 pooled share, table +0, evidence +0.06 (same seed)
def row(study, level, N, seed, **m):
    return dict(study=study, factor='arm', level=level, channel='blackboard', N=N, seed=seed, budget='turns', episode=0,
                runner='llm', **m)
b = lambda s, N: 0.35 + 0.02 * (s % 4) + 0.05 * (N == 4)
wf = lambda s: 0.6 + 0.01 * (s % 3)
seeds = range(900, 910)
# Phase 11 rows: baseline for seeds 900-904 (main and liar grids), and a wrong value at 905 the new run must override
p11 = [row('clue', 'clue', N, s, pooledShare=b(s, N), welfare=wf(s), welfareHonest=wf(s)) for N in (4, 8) for s in range(900, 906)]
p11 = [dict(r, pooledShare=0.0) if r['seed'] == 905 else r for r in p11]
p11 += [row('clueLiar', 'liar', 4, s, welfareHonest=wf(s) - 0.4, nLiar=1) for s in range(900, 903)]
p11 += [dict(row('clue', 'clue', 4, s, pooledShare=0.9, welfare=0.0, welfareHonest=0.0), channel='messages') for s in seeds]
rows = [row('fixA', 'baseline', N, s, pooledShare=b(s, N), welfare=wf(s), welfareHonest=wf(s), sharePerHeld=0.2)
        for N in (4, 8) for s in range(905, 910)]
rows += [row('fixA', 'baseline|liar', 4, s, welfareHonest=wf(s) - 0.4, welfare=0.0) for s in range(903, 910)]
rows += [row('fixA', a, N, s, pooledShare=b(s, N) + d, welfare=wf(s), welfareHonest=wf(s), sharePerHeld=0.5)
         for a, d in (('request', 0.3), ('table', 0.0), ('evidence', 0.06)) for N in (4, 8) for s in seeds]
# A2: honest loss 0.1 (record), 0.4 (verify), 0.3 (warn) against the baseline's 0.4; record costs 0.05 with no liar
for a, loss, cost in (('record', 0.1, -0.05), ('verify', 0.4, 0.0), ('warn', 0.3, 0.0)):
    rows += [row('fixA', a, 4, s, welfare=wf(s) + cost, welfareHonest=wf(s) + cost, pooledShare=0.5) for s in seeds]
    rows += [row('fixA', a + '|liar', 4, s, welfare=0.0, welfareHonest=wf(s) + cost - loss) for s in seeds]
# A3: baseline wins 20% of episodes, the solo agent 90%, factsFirst 40% (same episodes), table 20%, dissent 30%
def prow(level, s, success, votesA=2):
    return row('profileA', level, 4, s, success=success, votesA=votesA, uniquePosted=0.5, factsPosted=6, opinions=2, invalid=0)
won = dict(baseline=lambda s: s % 5 == 0, factsFirst=lambda s: s % 5 in (0, 1), table=lambda s: s % 5 == 0,
           dissent=lambda s: s % 10 in (0, 5, 1), solo=lambda s: s % 10 != 9)
prof = [prow(f'{a}|{v}', s, int(f(s))) for a, f in won.items() for v in ('classic', 'lone') for s in range(5000, 5100)]
logm = {rowKey(r): dict(asks=3, checks=0, checkedFalse=0) for r in rows if r['level'] == 'request'}
S = fixSummaries(rows, p11, logm, prof)
mb = lambda N: sum(b(s, N) for s in seeds) / 10
for N in (4, 8):
    assert abs(S['A1'][f'request|{N}']['gap'] - 0.3 / (1 - mb(N))) < 1e-9 and S['A1'][f'request|{N}']['n'] == 10
    assert abs(S['A1'][f'table|{N}']['gap']) < 1e-9 and abs(S['A1'][f'evidence|{N}']['gap'] - 0.06 / (1 - mb(N))) < 1e-9
    v = S['A1'][f'request|{N}']
    assert v['ci'][0] <= v['gap'] <= v['ci'][1] and v['primary'] and v['kind'] == 'affordance'
assert not S['A1']['evidence|4']['primary'] and math.isnan(S['A1']['evidence|4']['pHolm']) and S['A1']['evidence|4']['kind'] == 'instruction'
assert S['A1']['request|4']['pHolm'] >= S['A1']['request|4']['p'] and S['A1']['table|4']['pHolm'] == 1.0
assert abs(S['A2']['record']['gap'] - 0.75) < 1e-9 and abs(S['A2']['verify']['gap']) < 1e-9 and abs(S['A2']['warn']['gap'] - 0.25) < 1e-9
assert S['A2']['record']['n'] == 10 and S['A2']['record']['primary'] and not S['A2']['warn']['primary']
assert abs(S['A2cost']['record']['mean'] + 0.05) < 1e-9 and abs(S['A2cost']['verify']['mean']) < 1e-9
for v in ('classic', 'lone'):
    assert abs(S['A3'][f'factsFirst|{v}']['gap'] - 0.2 / 0.7) < 1e-9 and S['A3'][f'table|{v}']['gap'] == 0
    assert abs(S['A3'][f'dissent|{v}']['gap'] - 0.1 / 0.7) < 1e-9 and S['A3'][f'factsFirst|{v}']['n'] == 100
    lo, hi = S['A3'][f'factsFirst|{v}']['ci']
    assert lo < 0.2 / 0.7 < hi and 0 < lo and S['A3'][f'factsFirst|{v}']['pHolm'] < 0.05
# mechanism: asks from the logs, shares per held clue, votes against the hidden best; the clean N 4 baseline in both parts
assert S['mechanism']['A1']['request|4']['asks'] == 3 and S['mechanism']['A1']['request|4']['sharePerHeld'] == 0.5
assert 'baseline|4' in S['mechanism']['A1'] and 'baseline|4' in S['mechanism']['A2'] and 'record|liar|4' in S['mechanism']['A2']
assert 'record|4' not in S['mechanism']['A1'] and math.isnan(S['mechanism']['A1']['baseline|4']['asks'])
assert S['mechanism']['A3']['baseline|classic']['votesAgainst'] == 2 and S['mechanism']['A3']['baseline|classic']['success'] == 0.2
# missing parts stay empty; rows read back from CSV (strings) give the same numbers
assert fixSummaries([], p11)['A1'] == {} and fixSummaries(rows, p11)['A3'] == {}
str_rows = [{k: str(v) for k, v in r.items()} for r in rows]
assert fixSummaries(str_rows, p11)['A2']['record']['gap'] == S['A2']['record']['gap']
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    meta = dict(mode='quick', planHash='abc123', commit='x', model='claude-haiku-5-5', pricesChecked='2026-10-12', cost=0.0,
                spent=47.22, cap=150, calls=0, wall=1.0)
    text = writeFix(Path(d) / 'report.md', S, meta).read_text()
    assert text.index('abc123') < text.index('## A1') < text.index('## A2') < text.index('## A3') and 'Exploratory' in text
    assert '| arm | kind | loss recovered [95% CI] |' in text and '| request|4 | affordance | ' in text and '| warn | instruction |' in text and 'No-liar cost' in text and 'control |' in text
    assert '## A1' not in writeFix(Path(d) / 'r3.md', S, meta, ('A3',)).read_text()
    assert figFix(Path(d), S).stat().st_size > 0
    assert figFix(Path(d), dict(S, A1={}, A2={})).stat().st_size > 0

# fixLogMetrics on hand-made logs: valid asks, checks (valid replies with action 'check'), checks that found a false clue
import json
rec = lambda key, a, valid, report=None, obs='': dict(key=key, kind='turn', valid=valid, report=report, obs=obs,
                                                      response=json.dumps(dict(action=a, target='T1', answer=0, clue='', notes='')))
logs = [rec('k1', 'ask', True, ['ask', 1]), rec('k1', 'ask', False), rec('k1', 'check', True),

        rec('k2', 'share', True, ['share', 1, 7, 4]), dict(key='k2', kind='beliefs', response='{}'),
        dict(rec('k2', 'wait', False), response='not json')]

A toy world where agent i’s actions always take durations[i], and members that repeat fixed actions.

from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_fail


class ToyWorld:
    def __init__(self, durations): self.durations, self.counts = list(durations), None
    def reset(self, seed, n): self.counts = [0] * n
    def observe(self, i): return self.counts[i]
    def apply(self, i, action, t=None):
        self.counts[i] += 1
        return float(action), self.durations[i], i, {}


class ToyMember(Member):
    def __init__(self, actions): self.actions, self.k, self.learnCalls = list(actions), 0, 0
    def act(self, obs):
        self.k += 1
        return self.actions[(self.k - 1) % len(self.actions)]
    def learn(self, obs, action, reward, info): self.learnCalls += 1

Order and ties (AC-3): durations 1.0, 1.5, 1.0 for 3 s give eight events.

w = ToyWorld([1.0, 1.5, 1.0]); w.reset(0, 3)
ms = [ToyMember([1.0]) for _ in range(3)]
h = runTeam(ms, w, 3.0, t0=0.0)
test_eq([r.agent for r in h.records], [0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 1, 0, 2])
test_eq([r.t for r in h.records], [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.0])
test_eq([len(h.forAgent(i)) for i in range(3)], [3, 2, 3])
test_eq([m.learnCalls for m in ms], [3, 2, 3])
test_eq([m.id for m in ms], [0, 1, 2])

w1 = ToyWorld([0.5]); w1.reset(0, 1)
h1 = runTeam([ToyMember([2.0])], w1, 2.0, t0=10.0)
test_eq([r.t for r in h1.records], [10.0, 10.5, 11.0, 11.5])
test_eq({r.reward for r in h1.records}, {2.0})

Errors (AC-4).

test_fail(lambda: runTeam([], w, 1.0), contains='at least one')
bad = ToyMember([1.0]); bad.timeUnit = 'sample'
test_fail(lambda: runTeam([ToyMember([1.0]), bad], w, 1.0), contains='time unit')
w0 = ToyWorld([0.0]); w0.reset(0, 1)
test_fail(lambda: runTeam([ToyMember([1.0])], w0, 1.0), contains='> 0')

TeamEnv (AC-5): schedule, done flags, the end, reproducibility, and the same history as runTeam (FR-11).

def drive(seed):
    env = TeamEnv(ToyWorld([1.0, 1.5, 1.0]), 3, 3.0)
    test_eq(env.reset(seed), [0, 0, 0])
    order, dones = [], []
    while (i := env.next_agent()) is not None:
        order.append(i)
        dones.append(env.step(float(i + 1))[1])
    return env, order, dones

env, order, dones = drive(0)
test_eq(order, [0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 1, 0, 2])
test_eq(dones, [False] * 5 + [True] * 3)
test_fail(lambda: env.step(1.0), contains='done')
test_eq(drive(0)[0].history.records, env.history.records)

wr = ToyWorld([1.0, 1.5, 1.0]); wr.reset(0, 3)
test_eq(runTeam([ToyMember([float(i + 1)]) for i in range(3)], wr, 3.0).records, env.history.records)

JSONL (AC-6) and seeds (AC-7).

th = TeamHistory([('n', 'x', 'flag')])
th.add(Record(0, np.int64(3), 0.5, 'step', np.int64(7), np.float64(0.25), (np.int64(1), np.float64(2.5), np.bool_(True))))
th.add(Record(0, 3.5, 0.5, 'step', 8, -1.0, (2, 3.0, False)))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in th.toJSONL(Path(d) / 'sub' / 'h.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
test_eq(len(rows), 2)
test_eq(set(rows[0]), {'agent', 't', 'dt', 'kind', 'location', 'reward', 'extras'})
test_eq((rows[0]['t'], rows[0]['location'], rows[0]['reward']), (3, 7, 0.25))
test_eq(rows[0]['extras'], {'n': 1, 'x': 2.5, 'flag': True})
test_eq(rows[1]['extras'], {'n': 2, 'x': 3.0, 'flag': False})

test_eq([g.integers(1 << 30) for g in spawnRngs(0, 3)], [g.integers(1 << 30) for g in spawnRngs(0, 3)])
test_eq(len({g.random() for g in spawnRngs(0, 3)}), 3)
assert spawnRngs(1, 1)[0].random() != spawnRngs(0, 1)[0].random()

import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from explRL.figs_team import *

# the helpers: SEM ignores nan; the sign-flip p of 8 all-positive pairs is the exact two-sided 2/256; permutation p is exact for small samples
assert abs(sem([1.0, 2.0, 3.0, float('nan')]) - 1 / np.sqrt(3)) < 1e-12 and np.isnan(sem([1.0]))
assert abs(signP([0.1] * 8) - 2 / 256) < 1e-12 and np.isnan(signP([]))
assert abs(permP([0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]) - 2 / 20) < 1e-12 and permP([0.5, 0.6], [0.5, 0.6]) == 1.0

# every figure draws from compact data with string keys, at web and printed size, and saves byte-identical files
seeds = [str(s) for s in range(8)]
gs = {'colonyGuards': {'8': {s: 0.2 + 0.01 * int(s) for s in seeds}, '64': {s: 0.1 + 0.01 * int(s) for s in seeds}},
      'squads': {'16': {s: 0.3 for s in seeds}}}
g = {k: {a: {N: {s: 0.1 * j + 0.01 * int(s) for s in seeds} for N in ('8', '16')} for j, (a, *_) in enumerate(GUARD_ARMS)}
     for k in ('honestPooled', 'contamination')}
t = dict(record=[[4, 0.3, 0.05, 0.004], [8, 0.3, 0.06, 0.06]], request=[[8, -0.16, 0.02, 0.06]],
         contaminated={'haiku': {'8': [0.78, 0.8, 0.79], '16': [0.9, 0.88, 0.89]}, 'numpy': {'8': [0.97] * 3, '16': [0.98] * 3}})
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    for f, d in ((guardsScale, gs), (guards, g), (trustScale, t)):
        for paper in (False, True):
            p1, p2 = Path(tmp) / f'{f.__name__}{paper}1.png', Path(tmp) / f'{f.__name__}{paper}2.png'
            f(d, p1, paper=paper), f(d, p2, paper=paper)
            assert p1.stat().st_size > 1000 and p1.read_bytes() == p2.read_bytes()
fig = guardsScale(gs)                                   # no path: the figure comes back for display
assert len(fig.axes) == 1 and len(fig.axes[0].texts) == 4   # three significant points starred, and the footnote
# the trend: every seed falls by 0.1 over three doublings (exact two-sided p 2/256); one size gives no trend
b, p = trend(gs['colonyGuards'])
assert abs(b + 0.1 / 3) < 1e-12 and abs(p - 2 / 256) < 1e-12 and all(np.isnan(trend(gs['squads'])))
labels = [t.get_text() for t in fig.axes[0].get_legend().get_texts()]
assert labels == ['guards (one board): -0.033 per doubling (p = 0.008)', 'squads of 8 with guards']

bias = np.stack([r['eval']['turnBias'] for r in runs])

for ax, data, label in zip(axes, [fix, bias], ['mean fixation duration (s)', 'turn bias (+ = CW)']):

text:
Summary
With the paper’s Table 1 parameters and no tuning, 20 runs of 240 s (seeds 0-19) gave:

AC-5: mean fixation duration 0.68 s within ±30 degrees of the goal, versus 0.11 s near the opposite heading.
AC-6: turn bias +0.91 for headings 10-90 degrees counter-clockwise of the goal and -0.92 for headings 10-90 degrees clockwise of it, so saccades point toward the goal.
AC-7: residency near the goal rose from 0.49 in the first quarter of the run to 0.78 in the last quarter.
AC-8: all weights stayed finite.

This matches the qualitative shape of Fig 2d-e: long fixations at the goal and saccades biased toward it. The 20 runs take about 35 s on a laptop.

import json
import numpy as np
from explRL.llm_env import *
from explRL.harness import Blackboard, Lead, MessageBus
from explRL.harness_runs import benchWorld
from explRL.multi import spawnRngs

names = locationNames(64, 7)
assert names == locationNames(64, 7) and len(set(names)) == 64 and names != locationNames(64, 8)
assert all(n.isalpha() and n[0].isupper() and len(n) == 4 for n in names)

w = benchWorld(); w.reset(3, 2)
env = TextForagingEnv(w, names)
# the rules are well above the 512-token prompt-cache minimum (at a conservative 5 characters per token)
assert len(env.rules()) / 5 > 512, len(env.rules())
assert 'staying anywhere takes 1 seconds' in env.rules()
w5 = benchWorld(tStay=5.0); w5.reset(3, 2)
assert 'staying anywhere takes 5 seconds' in TextForagingEnv(w5, names).rules() and 'earned 4 over the 5 seconds' in TextForagingEnv(w5, names).rules()
obs = env.observe(0, 0.0)
loc = w.loc[0]
assert f'You are at {names[loc]}' in obs
for j in range(64):     # every other location is listed by name with its travel time
    assert j == loc or f'{names[j]} {w.layout.T[loc, j]:.1f} s' in obs

# parsing: names are case-insensitive; anything unusable is 'stay' and invalid
other = names[(loc + 3) % 64]
assert env.parse(dict(action='go', target=other.upper(), reportLocation='', reportValue=0, notes=''), 0) == \
    ((loc + 3) % 64, None, True)
assert env.parse(dict(action='stay', target='', reportLocation=other, reportValue=0.7, notes=''), 0) == \
    (loc, ((loc + 3) % 64, 0.7), True)
for bad in [None, 'text', dict(action='go', target='Nowhere'), dict(action='jump'),
            dict(action='stay', reportLocation=other, reportValue=float('nan'))]:
    t, rep, ok = env.parse(bad, 0)
    assert t == loc and rep is None and (not ok or bad.get('action') == 'stay')

# a scripted team through the text interface leaves the same ledger as the same moves made directly
def moves(k):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(k)
    return [('go', names[int(rng.integers(64))]) if rng.random() < 0.3 else ('stay', '') for _ in range(40)]
def play(text):
    w = benchWorld(); w.reset(5, 2); e = TextForagingEnv(w, names); q, n = [(0.0, 0), (0.0, 1)], [0, 0]
    while q:                                     # event order: earliest start first, ties to the lower index
        q.sort(); t, i = q.pop(0)
        a, tg = moves(i)[n[i]]
        if text:
            e.observe(i, t)
            target, _, _ = e.parse(dict(action=a, target=tg, reportLocation='', reportValue=0, notes=''), i)
        else:
            target = w.loc[i] if a == 'stay' else names.index(tg)
        dt = w.apply(i, target, t)[1]
        n[i] += 1
        if n[i] < 40:
            q.append((t + dt, i))
    return w.ledger
assert json.dumps(play(True), default=str) == json.dumps(play(False), default=str) and len(play(True)) == 80

# channels: reports reach the board, two teammates' inboxes, or the lead; the observation shows them
w = benchWorld(); w.reset(1, 3); env = TextForagingEnv(w, names)
bb = Blackboard(64, None, 0.01, 3)
assert env.post(0, (5, 0.9), 1.0, bb, {}) and 'Board' in env.observe(1, 2.0, bb) and f'{names[5]} 0.90' in env.observe(1, 2.0, bb)
assert env.shown[1] == {5} and 'empty' in env.observe(0, 2.0, bb)            # own reports are not shown back
env.home[2] = {40, 41}                                                         # squads: home locations listed first
listed = [x.split(' ')[0] for x in env.observe(2, 2.0).split('\n')[1].split(': ', 1)[1].split(', ')]
assert set(listed[:2]) == {names[40], names[41]} and len(listed) == 63
mb = MessageBus(3, 2, 10.0, np.inf, spawnRngs(9, 3))
assert env.post(0, (6, 1.1), 1.0, mb, {}) and not env.post(0, (6, 1.1), 2.0, mb, {})   # once per period
o1, o2 = env.observe(1, 3.0, mb), env.observe(2, 3.0, mb)
assert f'agent 0 says {names[6]} 1.10' in o1 and f'agent 0 says {names[6]} 1.10' in o2
assert 'messages:' in env.summary(1, 3.0, w.loc[1], 0.0, None, dict(kind='stay'))
lead = Lead(64, 3)
assert 'The coordinator suggests' in env.observe(0, 3.0, lead) and lead.assigned[0] is not None
env.post(0, (7, 1.0), 3.0, lead, dict(nHere=1))
assert lead.table.view(-1, 3.0)[1][7] > 0
# exploration: a move to a location nobody pointed to
env.observe(1, 4.0, bb)
assert env.explored(1, 9, dict(kind='travel')) and not env.explored(1, 5, dict(kind='travel'))
assert not env.explored(1, 9, dict(kind='stay'))

from explRL.liar_report import *
from explRL.liar_grid import nChange

# nChange is tools/scale_forecast.py's change
import importlib.util, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path('..') if pathlib.Path('../tools').exists() else pathlib.Path('.')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sf', root / 'tools/scale_forecast.py')
sf = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(sf)
rng = np.random.default_rng(3)
for _ in range(5):
    lo, hi = rng.normal(0, 1, 5), rng.normal(0.5, 1, 7)
    assert nChange(lo, hi) == sf.change(lo, hi)


# AC-3: on real numpy pairs the eight terms sum to the honest loss to 1e-12
runs = traceCells(forecastCells(sizes=(8, 32), seeds=range(2000, 2004)))
from explRL.liar_grid import _pairs
P = _pairs(runs)
for N, seeds in P.items():
    for sd, d in seeds.items():
        A = lossAccount(d['clean'], d['liar'])
        assert abs(A['total'] - A['loss']) < 1e-12, (N, sd, A)
        assert A['h'] <= 0 and A['g'] <= 0 and A['a'] >= 0          # per-capita and liar-only solves enter negatively
        m = mechanics(d['liar'].trace, d['liar'].board, d['liar'].nLiar)
        assert m['relayPerLie'] == 0 and not m['honestErrors'] > 0   # rule agents share only clues they hold (nan: no shares)
        assert 0 <= m['contaminated'] <= 1 and 0 < m['liarHeld'] < 1 and 0 <= m['suppressed'] <= 1


# AC-3: the measures and the accounting on a hand-made run (two agents, agent 0 a liar)
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
from explRL.liar_trace import Entry, TraceRun
task = lambda v, holders, by=-1: NS(value=v, holders=holders, solvedBy=by)
lb = NS(nAgents=3, penalty=0.5,
        shareLog=[(0., 0, 1, 0, 5, False, True), (1., 1, 1, 0, 5, False, True), (2., 2, 1, 0, 3, False, False),
                  (3., 0, 2, 1, 4, False, True), (3., 1, 3, 0, 1, False, True)],
        submits=[(1., 1, 1, None, 'wrong'), (2., 2, 2, None, 'wrong'), (4., 1, 1, None, 'solved'), (5., 2, 3, None, 'solved')],
        solveLog=[(4., 1, 1, True), (5., 2, 3, False)],
        tasks={1: task(2, [frozenset({0}), frozenset({2})], 1), 2: task(1, [frozenset({1}), frozenset({2})]),
               3: task(3, [frozenset({1}), frozenset({2})], 2), 4: task(1, [frozenset({0}), frozenset({1})], 0)})
tr = [Entry(1., 1, 1, {0: (5, False)}, True, 1, 4), Entry(2., 2, 2, {}, False, 1, 4),
      Entry(4., 1, 1, {0: (3, True)}, False, 0, 3), Entry(5., 2, 3, {0: (1, True)}, False, 0, 2)]
m = mechanics(tr, lb, 1)
assert m['contaminated'] == 0.25 and m['wrongContam'] == 1.0 and m['wrongClean'] == 1 / 3
assert m['relayPerLie'] == 0.5 and m['relayAny'] == 0.5 and m['honestErrors'] == 1 / 3    # agent 1 relays (1, 0, 5); (3, 0, 1) is an error
lb2 = NS(**{**vars(lb), 'shareLog': [(0., 1, 3, 0, 1, False, True), (1., 0, 3, 0, 1, False, True)]})
m2 = mechanics(tr, lb2, 1)
assert m2['relayAny'] == 0.0 and m2['relayPerLie'] == 0.0 and m2['honestErrors'] == 1.0   # the error came first: no relay
assert m['suppressed'] == 0.5          # slots first posted by the liar: (1, 0) (a true post followed) and (2, 1) (none)
assert m['liarHeld'] == 0.5 and m['solvedLiarHeld'] == 1.0 and m['solvedOther'] == 0.5
assert m['recoverRounds'] == 3.0 and m['contamUnsolved'] == 0.0
assert abs(m['falseVisible'] - (1 / 4 + 1 / 4) / 4) < 1e-12
# accounting by hand: clean board (no liars), 3 honest agents, T 10: solved 1 (2), 2 (1), 4 (1); one wrong answer
cb = NS(nAgents=3, penalty=0.5, shareLog=[], submits=[(3., 0, 2, None, 'wrong')], solveLog=[],
        tasks={1: task(2, lb.tasks[1].holders, 0), 2: task(1, lb.tasks[2].holders, 1), 3: task(3, lb.tasks[3].holders),
               4: task(1, lb.tasks[4].holders, 2), 5: task(2, [frozenset({1}), frozenset({2})], 1)})
wC, wL = (2 + 1 + 1 + 2 - 0.5) / 30, (2 + 3 - 0.5 * 2) / 20
A = lossAccount(TraceRun([dict(welfareHonest=wC)], [], [], cb, 0, 10), TraceRun([dict(welfareHonest=wL)], [], tr, lb, 1, 10))
expect = dict(a=0.5 / 20, b=0.5 / 20 - 0.5 / 30, c=1 / 30, d=0.0, e=1 / 30, f=2 / 30, g=-3 / 20, h=2 * (1 / 30 - 1 / 20))
assert all(abs(A[k] - v) < 1e-12 for k, v in expect.items()), A
assert abs(A['total'] - A['loss']) < 1e-12

import json
import numpy as np
from collections import deque
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_close
import explRL.episodes as ep
from explRL.episodes import LevelBandit, runEpisodes, LEVELS
from explRL.credit import Credit
from explRL.harness import Blackboard

# round robin with an agent offset for the first len(levels) episodes, then UCB over level values
ms = [LevelBandit() for _ in range(4)]
for i, m in enumerate(ms): m.id = i
for e in range(4):
    for m in ms: m.beginEpisode(None, None)
    test_eq([m.level for m in ms], [LEVELS[(e + i) % 4] for i in range(4)])
    for m in ms: m.epReward = 60.0 * (1 + m.k == 2); m.endEpisode(60.0)     # level index 1 earned 1/s, the rest 0
m = ms[0]; m.beginEpisode(None, None); test_eq(m.level, LEVELS[1])
m.cLevel = 100.0; m.n[:] = (9, 9, 1, 9); m.beginEpisode(None, None); test_eq(m.level, LEVELS[2])   # big bonus: least used
# credit received adds to the episode's value
cr = Credit(1, beta=1.0); lb = LevelBandit(); lb.id = 0; lb.beginEpisode(None, cr)
cr.inbox[0].append((0, 2.5)); lb._takeCredit(); test_close(lb.epReward, 2.5)
# reset: 'strategy' forgets the map and keeps level values; 'all' keeps both; 'none' forgets both
for keep, mapKept, valuesKept in (('strategy', False, True), ('all', True, True), ('none', False, False)):
    lb = LevelBandit(); lb.rates, lb.reports = [deque([1.0])], [deque([2.0])]; lb.S[:], lb.n[:], lb.e = 1.0, 1, 4
    lb.reset(keep)
    test_eq(lb.rates is not None, mapKept); test_eq(lb.reports is not None, mapKept)
    test_eq((lb.n.sum() > 0, lb.e > 0), (valuesKept, valuesKept))
# fixed arms never change level, so their levelStable is 1 after the first episode; runs are deterministic
rows = runEpisodes('fixed-2', 4, 1000, episodes=3, T=40.0)
test_eq([r['levelMean'] for r in rows], [2.0] * 3); test_eq([r['levelStable'] for r in rows][1:], [1.0, 1.0])
assert np.isnan(rows[0]['levelStable'])
a = runEpisodes('strategy', 4, 1000, episodes=5, T=40.0, beta=1.0)
test_eq(json.dumps(a), json.dumps(runEpisodes('strategy', 4, 1000, episodes=5, T=40.0, beta=1.0)))   # nan-safe
test_eq([r['episode'] for r in a], list(range(5)))
test_eq([r['levelMean'] for r in a][:4], [np.mean(LEVELS)] * 4)            # round robin: every level once per episode
assert sum(r['discoveries'] for r in a) > 0
# 'all' keeps one blackboard across episodes (rebased); the other arms build a new one each episode
made = []
class CountingBoard(Blackboard):
    def __init__(self, *a, **k): made.append(1); super().__init__(*a, **k)
ep.Blackboard = CountingBoard
for arm, boards in (('all', 1), ('strategy', 3), ('fixed-1', 3)):
    made.clear(); runEpisodes(arm, 4, 1000, episodes=3, T=40.0); test_eq(len(made), boards)
ep.Blackboard = Blackboard
try:
    runEpisodes('bogus', 2, 0)
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('expected ValueError')

import numpy as np
from explRL.colony_agents import *
from explRL.clueboard import ClueBoardEnv
from explRL.clue_agents import ClueBoard, ClueLiar, RuleAgent
from explRL.clue_colony import tally

def board(seed=0, N=4):
    b = ClueBoardEnv(seed, N, m=2, r=2, R=30)
    return b, ClueBoard()

def member(cls, ch, i, **kw):
    m = cls(ch, np.random.default_rng(i), **kw)
    m.id = i
    return m

# ViewAgent at its defaults chooses as RuleAgent
for seed in range(5):
    b, ch = board(seed)
    a, v = member(RuleAgent, ch, 1), member(ViewAgent, ch, 1)
    assert a.choose(b, 0.0) == v.choose(b, 0.0)

# ColonyAgent ignores an unconfirmed false value and posts its held clue against it
b, ch = board(1)
i = 2
k, j = next((k, j) for k in b.open for j in b.held(i, k))
p, r = b.tasks[k].task.clue(j)
ch.post(0, k, (j, p, (r + 1) % p), 1.0)                          # one false post by agent 0
b.opened[1] = k                                                  # a teammate works on k: the clue is needed
c = member(ColonyAgent, ch, i)
assert c.knownFor(b)[k][j] == r                                  # own value, the false one not counted
assert c._shareable(b, c.knownFor(b), 2.0) == ('share', (k, j, r))
assert member(ColonyAgent, ch, 3).knownFor(b)[k].get(j) in (None, r)   # an unconfirmed false value is never known
ch.post(i, k, (j, p, r), 2.0)
assert c._shareable(b, c.knownFor(b), 3.0) != ('share', (k, j, r))     # already its own: not again
# ConfirmAgent posts against a differing latest value
b2, ch2 = board(1)
ch2.post(0, k, (j, p, (r + 1) % p), 1.0)
b2.opened[1] = k
cf = member(ConfirmAgent, ch2, i)
assert cf._shareable(b2, cf.knownFor(b2), 2.0) == ('share', (k, j, r))
# GuardAgent never opens; ThresholdGuard switches at theta
for seed in range(10):
    b3, ch3 = board(seed, 8)
    g = member(GuardAgent, ch3, 4)
    assert all(g.choose(b3, float(t))[0] in ('share', 'wait') for t in range(3))
b4, ch4 = board(2, 8)
tg = member(ThresholdGuard, ch4, 5, theta=1)
base = member(ColonyAgent, ch4, 5)
assert tg.choose(b4, 0.0) == base.choose(b4, 0.0)               # nothing contested: a forager
kk = b4.open[0]
pp, rr = b4.tasks[kk].task.clue(0)
ch4.post(0, kk, (0, pp, rr), 1.0)
ch4.post(1, kk, (0, pp, (rr + 1) % pp), 1.0)
assert tg.choose(b4, 1.0)[0] in ('share', 'wait')               # one contested clue: a guard (never opens)

# ColludingLiar reposts a fellow liar's false value within its next two lying turns
b5, ch5 = board(3, 8)
l0, l1 = member(ColludingLiar, ch5, 0), member(ColludingLiar, ch5, 1)
a0 = l0.choose(b5, 0.0)                                          # liar 0 lies first (turn 1 is a lying turn)
assert a0[0] == 'share'
k0, j0, r0 = a0[1]
ch5.post(0, k0, (j0, b5.tasks[k0].task.primes[j0], r0), 0.0)
acts = []
for t in range(4):
    act = l1.choose(b5, float(t))
    acts.append(act)
assert ('share', (k0, j0, r0)) in acts[:3]

# MistakenAgent: about 30% of held clues misread, one value per clue, used in its answers
wrong, total = 0, 0
for seed in range(200):
    b6, ch6 = board(seed, 4)
    m = MistakenAgent(ch6, np.random.default_rng(seed))
    m.id = 1
    for k in b6.open:
        got, truth = m.heldFor(b6, k), b6.held(1, k)
        assert got == m.heldFor(b6, k)                          # kept consistently
        wrong += sum(got[j] != truth[j] for j in truth)
        total += len(truth)
        assert all(m.knownFor(b6)[k][j] == got[j] for j in got)
assert 0.25 < wrong / total < 0.35, wrong / total

# factories from a world
w = dict(colony=True, guards=2)
assert faultClass({}) is ClueLiar and faultClass(dict(fault='collude')) is ColludingLiar and faultClass(dict(fault='error')) is MistakenAgent
try:
    faultClass(dict(fault='adaptive'))
    raise AssertionError('numpy cannot play adaptive liars')
except ValueError:
    pass
assert scriptedFaults({}, 0) is None and scriptedFaults(dict(fault='adaptive'), 2) is None and set(scriptedFaults({}, 2)) == {0, 1}
assert faultMembers(dict(fault='adaptive'), 2, None, [], lambda: 'llm') == ['llm', 'llm']
assert memberClass(w, 2, 2).func is GuardAgent and memberClass(w, 3, 2).func is GuardAgent and memberClass(w, 4, 2).func is ColonyAgent
assert memberClass({}, 0).func is RuleAgent and memberClass(dict(confirm=True), 0).func is ConfirmAgent
assert memberClass(dict(colony=True, theta=1), 3, 2).func is ThresholdGuard

from explRL.clue_runs import runClueNumpy, runClue
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply

# replay equals the runners (numpy and fake LLM), with Phase 18 options
W = dict(m=2, r=2, R=30)
for opt, nL in (({}, 2), (dict(colony=True, fault='collude'), 2), (dict(colony=True, guards=2, fault='error'), 2), (dict(confirm=True), 0),
               (dict(fault='adaptive'), 2), (dict(colony=True, volunteer=True, fault='adaptive'), 2), (dict(colony=True, volunteer=True), 2)):
    cfg = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=8, turns=12, nLiar=nL, world={**W, **opt})
    if opt.get('fault') == 'adaptive' or opt.get('volunteer'):
        try:                                                      # numpy cannot play adaptive liars; volunteers are LLM-only
            replay(cfg, 905)
            assert opt.get('fault') != 'adaptive', opt
        except ValueError:
            pass
    else:
        assert replay(cfg, 905).rows == runClueNumpy(cfg, 905), opt
    fake = lambda: LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
    rp = replay(cfg, 905, fake())
    ref, log = runClue(cfg, 905, fake())
    assert rp.rows == ref and rp.log == log, opt
    t = colonyColumns(rp)
    assert set(t) >= {'contamination', 'reach', 'suppression', 'relay', 'freeRiding', 'misreport', 'pooledBound', 'honestPooled'}
    assert abs(t['honestPooled'] * t['pooledBound'] - t['welfareHonest'] * 8) < 1e-9

# hand-made board: one false value, an honest relay of it, a contaminated wrong answer, a contest, a suppressed holder
class Task:
    primes = (2, 3)
    def clue(self, j):
        return self.primes[j], (1, 2)[j]                              # x = 5: 5 % 2 = 1, 5 % 3 = 2
b = SimpleNamespace(nAgents=4, tasks={7: SimpleNamespace(task=Task(), holders=[frozenset({2, 3}), frozenset({1, 3})])},
                    shareLog=[(1.0, 0, 7, 1, 0, False, True),         # liar 0: x mod 3 = 0 (false)
                              (2.0, 2, 7, 1, 0, True, True),          # honest 2 relays it (2 does not hold clue 1)
                              (3.0, 3, 7, 1, 2, True, False)],        # honest 3 (a holder) contests with the truth
                    submits=[(4.0, 2, 7, 1, 'wrong'), (5.0, 1, 7, 1, 'solved')],
                    solveLog=[(5.0, 1, 7, True)],
                    ledger=[(1, 0.0, 1.0, 'travel', 7), (2, 1.0, 1.0, 'stay', -1), (2, 2.0, 1.0, 'stay', 7), (2, 3.0, 1.0, 'stay', -1),
                            (3, 0.0, 1.0, 'stay', -1), (3, 1.0, 1.0, 'stay', -1), (3, 3.0, 1.0, 'stay', 7)])
t = traceBoard(b, {(4.0, 2): 3, (5.0, 1): 5}, nLiar=1)              # 3 % 3 == 0: agrees with the false value
assert t['contamination'] == 0.5 and t['reach'] == 1 and t['falseValues'] == 1
assert t['relay'] == 1 and t['confirmFalse'] == 1 and t['contestFalse'] == 1
assert t['suppression'] == 1                                          # holder 1 opened T7 and never posted the true clue 1
assert abs(t['misreport'] - 100 * 1 / 2) < 1e-12                      # honest shares: 2's false relay, 3's truth
assert abs(t['freeRiding'] - 2 / 3) < 1e-12
assert abs(t['openShare'] - 1 / 3) < 1e-12 and abs(t['shareShare'] - 2 / 3 / 3) < 1e-12           # agent 1 opened its one turn; 2 and 3 shared 1 of 3
assert abs(t['openShare'] + t['submitShare'] + t['shareShare'] + t['waitShare'] - 1) < 1e-12
# specialization: fixed roles score high, the shuffled null near 1
logsRole = [[]] + [[dict(action=['share' if i % 2 else 'open', 0])] * 40 for i in range(1, 9)]   # slot 0 faulty
si, sn = specIndex(logsRole, nLiar=1, seed=1)
assert si > 10 and 0.5 < sn < 1.5
rng = np.random.default_rng(3)
logsMix = [[]] + [[dict(action=['share' if rng.random() < 0.4 else 'open', 0]) for _ in range(40)] for _ in range(8)]
si2, sn2 = specIndex(logsMix, nLiar=1, seed=1)
assert si2 < 3 and 0.5 < sn2 < 1.5
assert np.isnan(specIndex([[dict(action=['open', 0])] * 5] * 3, 0)[0])            # nobody shares
assert isPhase18(dict(r=2)) and isPhase18(dict(r=1, colony=True)) and not isPhase18(dict(r=1, m=2))                           # agents 2 and 3: no solve, 2 of 3 turns idle; 1 solved

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)

def brute_so(world, N):
    P = world.nPatches
    best_y, best_n = -1.0, None
    from itertools import product
    # enumerate allocations with sum <= N
    def gen(rem, p, cur):
        if p == P:
            yield tuple(cur)
            return
        for k in range(rem + 1):
            cur.append(k)
            yield from gen(rem - k, p + 1, cur)
            cur.pop()
    for alloc in gen(N, 0, []):
        if sum(alloc) > N:
            continue
        yy = sum(yieldModel(world, p, alloc[p]) for p in range(P))
        if yy > best_y:
            best_y, best_n = yy, alloc
    return np.array(best_n, int), best_y

for _ in range(50):
    P = int(rng.integers(2, 5))
    intake = tuple(rng.uniform(0.5, 3.0, P))
    N = int(rng.integers(1, 8))
    ww = TeamPatchWorld(ringLayout(12), nPatches=P, nDanger=0, model='fixed', intake=intake,
                        patchSites=list(range(P)), c=1.5, Tmove=None)
    n_ifd, _ = idealFree(ww, N)
    if n_ifd.sum() < N:                                  # agents left outside: no patch pays them anything
        assert all(yieldModel(ww, q, n_ifd[q] + 1) / (n_ifd[q] + 1) <= 0 for q in range(P))
    for p in range(P):
        if n_ifd[p] == 0:
            continue
        own = yieldModel(ww, p, n_ifd[p]) / n_ifd[p]
        for q in range(P):
            if q == p:
                continue
            alt = yieldModel(ww, q, n_ifd[q] + 1) / (n_ifd[q] + 1)
            assert own >= alt - 1e-9
    n_so, y_so = socialOptimum(ww, N)
    bn, by = brute_so(ww, N)
    test_close(y_so, by)

wL = TeamPatchWorld(ringLayout(8), nPatches=4, nDanger=0, model='logistic', intake=(1.0,) * 4,
                    patchSites=[0, 1, 2, 3], K=100.0, g=0.2, Smin=1.0, c=1.0, Tmove=None)
cap = sum(int(wL.g * wL.K // (4 * wL.c)) for _ in range(wL.nPatches))
N = cap + 4
_, y_ifd = idealFree(wL, N)
_, y_so = socialOptimum(wL, N)
assert y_so > y_ifd

test_eq(gini(np.ones(4)), 0.0)

# pilot v3's value mask: values are 1; keys, punctuation, opening quotes and eos are 0 (a word-piece stand-in tokenizer)
import re
from explRL.rl17_update import _valueChars


class Pieces:
    "Tokens: runs of letters or digits, single other characters, with offsets (what a fast tokenizer returns)."
    eos_token_id = 0

    def __call__(self, s, add_special_tokens=False, return_offsets_mapping=False):
        m = [x.span() for x in re.finditer(r'[A-Za-z0-9]+| ?"",?|[^A-Za-z0-9]', s)]
        return dict(input_ids=list(range(1, len(m) + 1)), offset_mapping=m)


rep = '{"notes": "x mod 7", "action": "submit", "target": "", "answer": 18, "clue": ""}'
v = _valueChars(rep)
assert ''.join(c for c, f in zip(rep, v) if f) == 'x mod 7"submit""18"'       # contents plus closing quotes, the number
tk = Pieces()
pieces = [rep[a:b] for a, b in tk(rep)['offset_mapping']]
m = valueMask(tk, rep, eos=True)
assert len(m) == len(pieces) + 1 and m[-1] == 0                                 # eos: fixed by the schema
on = {p for p, f in zip(pieces, m) if f}
assert {'x', 'mod', '7', 'submit', '18', ' "",', ' ""'} <= on and not on & {'notes', 'action', 'target', 'answer', 'clue', '{', ':'}
assert valueMask(tk, 'not json', eos=True) == [1] * (len(tk('not json')['input_ids']) + 1)   # unconstrained text: all count
assert _valueChars('{"notes": "cut mid-va') is not None and _valueChars('{"notes": "cut mid-va')[-1]  # a cut reply
assert valueMask(tk, rep, eos=False) == m[:-1]


# the loss terms on hand-made numbers (torch only)
try:
    import torch
    lp, old = torch.tensor([-1.0, -2.0]), torch.tensor([-1.5, -2.5])          # mean ratio exp(0.5)
    assert torch.isclose(clippedTerm(lp, None, 2.0, None), torch.tensor(3.0))   # -A * mean log pi
    r = np.exp(0.5)
    assert torch.isclose(clippedTerm(lp, old, 2.0, 0.2), torch.tensor(-1.2 * 2.0))           # A > 0: clipped at 1 + eps
    assert torch.isclose(clippedTerm(lp, old, -2.0, 0.2), torch.tensor(float(r * 2.0)))      # A < 0: the unclipped ratio
    assert torch.isclose(clippedTerm(lp, lp, 2.0, 0.2), torch.tensor(-2.0))                  # ratio 1
    one = torch.ones(2)
    assert torch.isclose(tokenTerm(lp, None, 2.0, None, one), clippedTerm(lp, None, 2.0, None))   # no clip: as before
    # per token: a token that fell far is clipped on its own (the reply mean would let it fall clip x length nats)
    lo, od = torch.tensor([-10.0, -0.1]), torch.tensor([-0.1, -0.1])
    assert torch.isclose(tokenTerm(lo, od, -1.0, 0.2, one), torch.tensor((0.8 + 1.0) / 2))       # A < 0: no push below 0.8
    assert torch.isclose(tokenTerm(lo, od, -1.0, 0.2, torch.tensor([0.0, 1.0])), torch.tensor(1.0))   # masked token ignored
    g = lo.clone().requires_grad_(True)
    tokenTerm(g, od, -1.0, 0.2, one).backward()
    assert g.grad[0] == 0                                                                # the fallen token gets no gradient
except ImportError:
    pass

import json
from explRL.bench_grid import rowKey as rk
from explRL.clue_policy import claudePolicy
from explRL.clue_roll import coopRows, rollout
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig
import re, zlib
from explRL.clue_policy import scriptedPolicy
def guesser(system, blocks):
    "Opens the first listed subtask, then submits one of the candidates its known clues leave (trial and error)."
    o = blocks[-1]['text']
    m = re.search(r'Your open subtask: T(\d+), open\. Find x with 0 <= x < (\d+)\. Clues you know: (.*)\.', o)
    if not m:
        return json.dumps(dict(action='open', target=re.search(r'\): (T\d+)', o).group(1), answer=0, clue='', notes=''))
    cl = [tuple(map(int, c)) for c in re.findall(r'x mod (\d+) = (\d+)', m.group(3))]
    xs = [y for y in range(int(m.group(2))) if all(y % p == r for p, r in cl)]
    return json.dumps(dict(action='submit', target='', answer=xs[zlib.crc32(o.encode()) % len(xs)], clue='', notes=''))
fakePol = lambda: claudePolicy(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply)))
solos = 0
for ch, pol in (('hierarchical', fakePol()), ('blackboard', fakePol()), ('blackboard', scriptedPolicy(guesser))):
    cfg = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel=ch, N=4, turns=25, world=dict(m=2, r=1, R=30))
    ro = rollout(cfg, [900, 901], pol, memory='full')
    rows = coopRows(cfg, ro)
    recs = [dict(key=f'k{b}', **x) for b in range(2) for lg in ro.logs[b] for x in lg]
    lm = logMetrics(recs, 2)
    for b in range(2):
        assert lm[f'k{b}']['soloSolves'] == rows[b]['soloSolves']
        f1, f2 = lm[f'k{b}']['followShare'], rows[b]['followShare']
        assert (math.isnan(f1) and math.isnan(f2)) or f1 == f2
        solos += rows[b]['soloSolves']
assert solos > 0                                    # the guesser makes solo solves, so the agreement is not vacuous

env = TaskBoardEnv(0, 2, difficulty=1, life=10)
assert len(env.open) == 6 and env.observe(0)['opened'] is None
first = sorted(env.tasks[k].expire for k in env.open)
assert first == sorted(10 - 10 * k / 6 for k in range(6))
env.advance(5.0)
assert len(env.open) == 6 and env.serial == 9            # the three that expired by t = 5 (at 1.67, 3.33, 5) replaced
assert all(env.tasks[k].expire > 5.0 for k in env.open)

# opening costs a turn; only the first correct answer scores; wrong answers pay the penalty
env = TaskBoardEnv(1, 2, difficulty=1, life=100, penalty=0.5)
k = env.open[0]; task = env.tasks[k]
r, dt, loc, info = env.apply(0, ('open', k), 0.0)
assert (r, dt, loc, info['kind'], info['result']) == (0.0, 1.0, k, 'travel', 'opened') and env.observe(0)['opened'] == k
env.apply(1, ('open', k), 0.0)
r, *_ , info = env.apply(0, ('submit', task.puzzle.answer + task.puzzle.hi), 1.0)
assert r == -0.5 and info['result'] == 'wrong'
r, _, _, info = env.apply(0, ('submit', task.puzzle.answer), 2.0)
assert r == task.value and info['result'] == 'solved' and k not in env.open and len(env.open) == 6
r, _, _, info = env.apply(1, ('submit', task.puzzle.answer), 2.0)
assert r == 0.0 and info['result'] == 'late' and env.counts == dict(solved=1, wrong=1, duplicates=1, opens=2)
assert env.apply(1, ('wait', None), 3.0)[0] == 0.0 and env.apply(1, ('open', 999), 4.0)[3]['result'] == 'invalid'
assert env.duplicateTurns() == 2 and len(env.netRows) == len(env.ledger) and np.isclose(sum(env.netRows), env.netByAgent().sum())                          # agent 1 opened and answered agent 0's task
assert list(env.firstSolves()) == [1, 0] and np.allclose(env.netByAgent(), [task.value - 0.5, 0])
L = env.ledger
assert [x[3] for x in L] == ['travel', 'travel', 'stay', 'stay', 'stay', 'stay', 'stay'] and L[3][6] == task.value

# reward schemes: team shares every solve and penalty equally; totals match individual
def play(scheme):
    e = TaskBoardEnv(2, 2, difficulty=0, life=100, scheme=scheme)
    rs = []
    for t, (i, a) in enumerate([(0, ('open', e.open[0])), (1, ('open', e.open[1])), (0, 'ans'), (1, ('submit', -1)),
                                (0, ('wait', None)), (1, ('wait', None))]):
        if a == 'ans':
            a = ('submit', e.tasks[e.opened[0]].puzzle.answer)
        rs.append(e.apply(i, a, float(t))[0])
    return rs, e
ind, e1 = play('individual'); team, e2 = play('team'); diff, _ = play('difference')
assert diff == ind and np.isclose(sum(ind), sum(team)) and np.allclose(e1.netByAgent(), e2.netByAgent())
assert team[2] == e1.tasks[0].value / 2 if e1.tasks[0].solvedBy == 0 else True

# social optimum: top-N open values, two turns per attempt
env = TaskBoardEnv(3, 2, difficulty=1)
top = sorted((env.tasks[k].value for k in env.open), reverse=True)[:2]
assert env.socialOptimum(0.5) == 0.5 * sum(top) / 2

# the numpy board: submissions succeed with the given rate
sim = TaskBoardSim(4, 1, solveRate=1.0, difficulty=3)
sim.apply(0, ('open', sim.open[0]), 0.0)
assert sim.apply(0, ('submit', None), 1.0)[3]['result'] == 'solved'
sim = TaskBoardSim(4, 1, solveRate=0.0, difficulty=3)
sim.apply(0, ('open', sim.open[0]), 0.0)
assert sim.apply(0, ('submit', None), 1.0)[3]['result'] == 'wrong'

def default_world():
    lay = ringLayout(32) if MAIN == 'ring' else torusLayout(8)
    return TeamPatchWorld(lay, nPatches=4, nDanger=4, model='fixed', Tmove=120.0,
                          patchSites=[2, 10, 18, 26] if MAIN == 'ring' else [0, 7, 56, 63],
                          dangerSites=[6, 14, 22, 30] if MAIN == 'ring' else [8, 15, 48, 55])

def run_team(kind):
    w = default_world()
    w.reset(world_seed, nAgents)
    rngs = spawnRngs(seed, nAgents)
    members = [banditAgent() if kind == 'bandit' else randomAgent(r) for r in rngs]
    hist = runTeam(members, w, Ttot)
    return w, hist

def team_metrics(w, hist):
    L = ledgerArrays(w.ledger)
    tot, pas = welfare(L, nAgents, Ttot)
    harvest_by_agent = [float(L['harvest'][L['agent'] == i].sum()) for i in range(nAgents)]
    times, counts = occupancy(L, nAgents, w.nPatches, Ttot)          # 1 s grid (FR-19)
    n_ifd, _ = idealFree(w, nAgents)
    d = ifdDistance(counts, n_ifd, nAgents)
    moves = [k * w.Tmove for k in range(1, int(Ttot // w.Tmove) + 1) if k * w.Tmove < Ttot] if w.Tmove else []
    _, y_so = socialOptimum(w, nAgents)
    bins = np.arange(0.0, Ttot + 10.0, 10.0)
    rate = np.histogram(L['t'], bins=bins, weights=L['harvest'])[0] / 10.0   # team harvest/s, 10 s bins
    return dict(welfare=tot, perAgentSecond=pas, gini=gini(np.array(harvest_by_agent)),
                coverage=coverage(counts), dangerShare=dangerShare(L, w.danger, nAgents, Ttot),
                timeToIFD=timeToIFD(times, d, moves), welfareLoss=welfareLoss(tot, y_so, Ttot),
                times=times, ifd_d=d, moves=moves, bins=bins[:-1], rate=rate, so=y_so)

w_b, h_b = run_team('bandit')
w_r, h_r = run_team('random')
m_b, m_r = team_metrics(w_b, h_b), team_metrics(w_r, h_r)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 5), sharex=True)

    axes[1].plot(m['times'], m['ifd_d'], label=label)

axes[0].set_ylabel('team harvest / s'); axes[0].legend(fontsize=8)

Scaling preview (full run only)

SIZES = (1, 4, 16, 64)
NSEED = 10

def rates(kind, N, sd):
    "(welfare per agent-second over the run, team harvest/s in the first quarter)."
    w = default_world(); w.reset(sd, N)
    rngs = spawnRngs(seed + sd, N)
    members = [banditAgent() if kind == 'bandit' else randomAgent(r) for r in rngs]
    runTeam(members, w, Ttot)
    L = ledgerArrays(w.ledger)
    q = L['t'] < Ttot / 4
    return welfare(L, N, Ttot)[1], float(L['harvest'][q].sum()) / (Ttot / 4)

def boot_ci(vals, n=2000):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    vals = np.asarray(vals)
    boots = [rng.choice(vals, len(vals), replace=True).mean() for _ in range(n)]
    return float(np.percentile(boots, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(boots, 97.5))

scaling = {}
for N in SIZES:
    wref = default_world(); _, y_so = socialOptimum(wref, N); _, y_ifd = idealFree(wref, N)
    row = dict(so_yield=y_so, ifd_yield=y_ifd)
    for kind in ('bandit', 'random'):
        pas, firstQ = np.array([rates(kind, N, sd) for sd in range(NSEED)]).T
        row.update({f'{kind}_mean': float(pas.mean()), f'{kind}_ci': boot_ci(pas),
                    f'{kind}_firstQuarter': float(firstQ.mean())})
    scaling[str(N)] = row

# prototype checks re-run on the package world (AC-12): (1) no ceiling, (2) no floor
check1 = all(scaling[str(N)][f'{k}_firstQuarter'] < 0.9 * scaling[str(N)]['so_yield']
             for N in SIZES for k in ('bandit', 'random'))
check2 = all(scaling[str(N)]['bandit_ci'][0] > scaling[str(N)]['random_ci'][1] for N in SIZES)
scaling['check1_pass'] = check1
scaling['check2_pass'] = check2
print('check (1) no ceiling:', check1, ' check (2) no floor:', check2)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
xs = np.array(SIZES)
for kind in ('bandit', 'random'):
    m = np.array([scaling[str(x)][f'{kind}_mean'] for x in xs])
    lo, hi = np.array([scaling[str(x)][f'{kind}_ci'] for x in xs]).T
    ax.errorbar(xs, m, yerr=[m - lo, hi - m], capsize=3, label=kind)
ax.plot(xs, [scaling[str(x)]['so_yield'] / x for x in xs], 'k--', label='SO yield / N')
ax.plot(xs, [scaling[str(x)]['ifd_yield'] / x for x in xs], 'k:', label='IFD yield / N')
ax.set_xscale('log', base=2); ax.set_xlabel('team size'); ax.set_ylabel('welfare / agent-s'); ax.legend()
save_demo_figure('scaling', fig=fig, mode=artifact_mode, demo_name=DN)
plt.show()
